# Skill FEV-622：Automatic Rollback Controller

建议路径：

```text
skills/automatic-rollback-controller/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 回滚不是单一动作

必须区分：

```text
流量回滚
功能回滚
接口回滚
数据回滚
配置回滚
客户端安全模式
设备命令停止
```

## 2. 自动回滚触发器

### 立即回滚

```text
支付金额差异
重复扣款或重复订单
未授权操作
错误账号数据泄漏
不可逆设备命令异常
关键数据损坏
大规模崩溃
关键能力完全不可用
```

### 阈值回滚

```text
错误率显著上升
崩溃率上升
p95或p99严重退化
内存异常
页面空白率上升
登录失败率上升
订单转化异常
```

### 人工审核后回滚

```text
非关键视觉差异
轻微性能变化
低风险埋点变化
已批准产品差异
```

## 3. 回滚动作

```yaml
rollback_actions:
  disable_target_feature:
    method: remote_flag

  route_to_source:
    method: gateway_or_service_routing

  stop_target_writes:
    method: write_circuit_breaker

  enter_read_only:
    method: application_safe_mode

  disable_device_commands:
    method: command_gateway_block

  disable_payment:
    method: payment_gateway_block

  restore_previous_configuration:
    method: versioned_config

  notify_release_owners:
    method: incident_channel
```

## 4. 数据兼容性

上线前必须确保：

```text
旧系统能读取新系统产生的数据
新系统能读取旧系统数据
Schema变更可前向和后向兼容
新字段有默认值
删除字段经过双阶段迁移
```

禁止：

```text
先删除旧字段
→ 再希望旧系统可以回滚
```

## 5. 数据回滚原则

优先：

```text
停止新写入
切回旧实现
使用补偿事务
重放事件
人工审核关键数据
```

避免对生产数据库执行未经证明的全量逆向脚本。

## 6. 回滚演练场景

```text
目标页面空白
目标接口大量失败
支付重复意图
订单写入一半失败
账号状态污染
路由循环
客户端新版本无法启动
平台插件崩溃
设备命令超时
远程配置服务不可用
```

## 7. 回滚就绪门槛

```yaml
rollback_readiness:
  remote_disable_available: true
  source_still_operational: true
  schema_backward_compatible: true
  write_circuit_breaker_tested: true
  payment_kill_switch_tested: true
  device_command_kill_switch_tested: true
  recovery_runbook_tested: true
```

# Skill FEV-623：Validation Evidence Governor

建议路径：

```text
skills/validation-evidence-governor/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

管理所有验证证据的来源、可复现性、完整性和独立性。

## 2. 证据图谱

```ts
interface EvidenceNode {
  evidenceId: string;
  type: string;
  sourceCommit: string;
  targetCommit: string;
  validatorVersion: string;
  domainPackVersions: Record<string, string>;
  environmentHash: string;
  generatedBy: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  artifactHash: string;
  supportsClaims: string[];
  invalidatedBy?: string[];
}
```

## 3. 证据类型

```text
STATIC_FINDING
BUILD_RESULT
UNIT_TEST
CONTRACT_TEST
DIFFERENTIAL_TEST
PROPERTY_TEST
FUZZ_TEST
MUTATION_TEST
DEVICE_TEST
PERFORMANCE_TEST
ACCESSIBILITY_TEST
SECURITY_TEST
SHADOW_RESULT
CANARY_RESULT
ROLLBACK_DRILL
FORMAL_PROOF
MANUAL_APPROVAL
```

## 4. 证据可信度

```text
L0：模型推断
L1：静态分析
L2：可重复自动化测试
L3：源目标差分运行
L4：真机、故障或生产影子证据
L5：形式证明或大规模生产验证
```

模型推断可以用于：

```text
发现风险
生成测试
解释差异
```

不能单独用于：

```text
签发发布认证
批准关键差异
替代真机结果
```

## 5. 独立性要求

关键模块必须至少包含：

```text
Claude建设或修复证据
Codex独立攻击证据
客观工具运行结果
```

对于R5场景，还应要求：

```text
业务负责人确认不变量
安全或支付负责人审批
生产运维确认回滚能力
```

## 6. 证据失效

以下变化自动使证据全部或部分失效：

```text
关键源码变更
框架大版本变更
平台基础库变更
支付SDK变更
权限配置变更
路由核心变更
状态管理核心变更
Domain Pack规则变更
关键设备或OS范围扩展
```

## 7. 禁止证据操作

```text
禁止修改失败报告为通过
禁止删除未解释差异而无审批
禁止用新运行覆盖旧失败而不保留历史
禁止引用不匹配Commit的报告
禁止将模拟器证据标记为真机
禁止将人工截图标记为自动差分结果
```

## 1. E1：可构建和可启动

要求：

```text

无阻断级静态错误
```

输出：

```yaml
E1:
  source_build: pass
  target_build: pass
  installation: pass
  startup: pass
  critical_static_blockers: 0
```

E1只证明：

```text
系统可以运行
```

不证明功能一致。

---

## 2. E2：原测试和契约通过

要求：

```text
源原测试基线通过
目标迁移测试通过
API契约通过
路由契约通过
组件输入输出契约通过
关键业务不变量通过
```

输出：

```yaml
E2:
  source_original_tests: 100%
  target_migrated_tests: 100%
  contract_tests: 100%
  critical_invariants: 100%
```

E2仍不证明测试足够强。

---

## 3. E3：差分、属性、模糊和变异

要求：

```text
源目标差分执行
生产轨迹回放
属性测试
边界测试
模糊交互
请求竞态
专项变异测试
Codex独立反例搜索
```

门槛：

```yaml
E3:
  unexplained_differences: 0
  critical_property_tests: 100%
  critical_fuzz_scenarios: 100%
  critical_mutation_score: ">= project_threshold"
  critical_mutation_survivors: 0
  unresolved_counterexamples: 0
```

---

## 4. E4：设备、故障、性能、安全和恢复

要求：

```text
真机矩阵
应用生命周期
前后台
弱网
权限
低内存
进程恢复
插件和平台API
性能
无障碍
安全
数据隔离
故障注入
回滚演练
```

门槛：

```yaml
E4:
  critical_device_matrix: 100%
  critical_permission_flows: 100%
  critical_fault_scenarios: 100%
  confirmed_memory_leaks: 0
  critical_accessibility_flows: 100%
  security_invariant_failures: 0
  rollback_drill: pass
  unresolved_differences: 0
```

---

## 5. E5：生产影子和渐进切换

要求：

```text
足够规模和多样性的影子会话
所有关键用户路径被覆盖
未解释差异为零
关键副作用意图无差异
灰度阶段通过
自动回滚保持可用
关键算法或状态机有更强证据
```

E5不是固定请求数量，而应由：

```text
业务规模
输入多样性
风险等级
稀有场景覆盖
设备覆盖
平台覆盖
```

共同决定。

示例：

```yaml
E5:
  shadow:
    critical_journey_coverage: 100%
    unexplained_differences: 0
    duplicate_side_effect_intents: 0

  canary:
    completed_stages:
      - internal
      - read-only
      - low-risk-write
      - controlled-write

    critical_failures: 0
    rollback_events: 0

  production:
    rollback_readiness: pass
    evidence_freshness: pass
```

---

## 6. 认证不能平均评分

错误做法：

```text
视觉80分
性能90分
支付50分
平均73分
→ 通过
```

正确做法：

```text
视觉可按阈值
性能可按预算
支付、权限、金额和设备安全命令必须100%
```

认证门槛：

```yaml
certification_policy:
  weighted_average_allowed: false

  absolute_gates:
    unexplained_differences: 0
    unsupported_blocking: 0
    critical_invariant_failures: 0
    critical_mutation_survivors: 0
    duplicate_payment_or_order: 0
    unauthorized_actions: 0
    wrong_account_data: 0
    unsafe_device_commands: 0
```

---

## 7. 认证范围

每份认证必须声明：

```text
源Commit
目标Commit
源框架和版本
目标框架和版本
验证器版本
Domain Pack版本
设备和OS矩阵
平台基础库
API范围
用户路径
能力降级
测试数据范围
未覆盖范围
证据生成日期
失效条件
```

## 8. 认证状态

```text
NOT_EVALUATED
E1_CERTIFIED
E2_CERTIFIED
E3_CERTIFIED
E4_CERTIFIED
E5_CERTIFIED
CONDITIONALLY_CERTIFIED
BLOCKED
EXPIRED
REVOKED
```

## 9. 条件认证

只允许用于非关键差异：

```yaml
conditional_certification:
  allowed_differences:
    - approved_font_rendering_difference
    - approved_platform_share_alternative

  forbidden:
    - payment_difference
    - permission_difference
    - account_isolation_difference
    - unresolved_difference
```

## 10. 最终认证声明模板

```text
在以下明确边界内：

- 指定的源和目标代码版本；
- 指定的转换方向；
- 指定的项目Domain Packs；
- 指定的平台、设备、操作系统和运行时版本；
- 指定的能力支持矩阵；
- 指定的业务不变量、测试输入和生产观测范围；

目标系统已达到E5级高置信可观察行为一致。

所有关键不变量均100%通过；
所有专项关键变异均被检测；
所有未解释差异为零；
所有不支持能力和产品降级均已记录并批准；
影子、灰度和自动回滚证据均有效。

该认证不等同于对任意未来输入、任意未来平台版本和任意未观测环境的数学绝对等价证明。
```

# 七、Claude Code和Codex在Batch 6中的分工

## Claude Code

负责：

```text
扫描和理解两个仓库
生成Domain Profile
选择和配置验证器
生成验证DAG
补充测试和观测点
建立影子执行环境
建立Feature Flag和回滚控制
修复差异
生成证据报告
维护跨模块一致性
```

## Codex

负责独立攻击：

```text
质疑Domain Pack选择是否完整
寻找未识别关键业务流程
寻找关键不变量缺失
攻击影子副作用隔离
攻击灰度分群偏差
攻击回滚不可用路径
寻找Schema不兼容
寻找旧账号恢复
寻找重复订单、支付和设备命令
寻找平均分掩盖关键失败
验证证据是否与Commit匹配
```

Codex提示模板：

```text
你是前端仓库级迁移生产认证的独立对抗审查者。

不要接受已有E1–E5结论，也不要默认Domain Pack选择完整。

请重点寻找：

1. 未识别的项目类型和关键业务流程；
2. 未声明的身份、权限、支付、库存或设备命令不变量；
3. 源目标差分被规范化器错误忽略的情况；
4. 影子系统产生真实副作用的路径；
5. 灰度用户分群遗漏高风险设备或账号；
6. 回滚时旧系统不能读取新数据的情况；
7. 远程Feature Flag不可用时的失效路径；
8. 客户端新版本无法即时回退的风险；
9. 证据与源码Commit、依赖版本或设备环境不匹配；
10. E1–E5报告中未运行却被标记为通过的项目；
11. 关键变异存活；
12. 未解释差异被错误分类为有意改变。

输出：

- 最小反例；
- 受影响Domain Pack；
- 风险等级；
- 源结果；
- 目标结果；
- 生产影响；
- 回归测试；
- 变异算子；
- 是否必须阻断发布。
```

# 十、Batch 1–6完成后的最终系统

完成Batch 1–6后，整体系统为：

```text
6种前端技术
×
5个目标方向
=
30个有向专项验证器

+

8个项目类型Domain Packs

+

5个横切Overlay Packs

+

统一差分运行时

+

影子流量

+

渐进灰度

+

自动回滚

+

E1–E5生产认证
```

最终可形成四层产品：

```text
第一层：Conversion Engine
负责代码转换。

第二层：Directional Validation Systems
负责30个方向的框架和平台专项验证。

第三层：Domain Validation Packs
负责管理后台、商城、SSR、编辑器、媒体、地图和设备等业务语义。

第四层：Production Assurance Control Plane
负责影子流量、灰度、回滚、证据治理和E1–E5认证。
```

最终认证目标不是：

```text
大模型认为代码基本正确
```

而是：

```text
在明确的转换方向、业务Domain、设备平台、输入范围、
外部能力、版本范围和生产观测边界内：

关键业务不变量100%通过；
关键专项变异存活数为0；
源目标未解释差异为0；
不支持能力和降级全部显式登记；
影子副作用完全隔离；
灰度阶段无关键回归；
自动回滚路径已演练；
证据与代码和环境严格绑定。
```

只有达到这些条件，系统才可以签发：

> **E5级仓库迁移高置信可观察行为一致认证。**

下一阶段可进入 **Batch 7：30个验证器的统一 Semantic IR、Rule DSL、Mutation DSL、Scenario DSL、Evidence DSL 与可执行Schema设计**。

# Batch 7：统一Semantic IR、Rule DSL、Mutation DSL、Scenario DSL、Evidence DSL与可执行Schema

## 一、Batch 7目标

前六批已经建立：

```text
6种前端技术
30个有向专项验证器
8个项目类型Domain Packs
5个横切Overlay Packs
影子流量
灰度发布
自动回滚
E1-E5认证
```

Batch 7负责把这些规格统一成机器可读取、可校验、可编译、可执行、可版本化的语言体系。

最终形成：

```text
Source Repository
      ↓
Source Adapter
      ↓
Semantic IR
      ↓
Directional Rule DSL
      ↓
Target Mapping Contract
      ↓
Scenario DSL / Mutation DSL
      ↓
Source-Target Differential Runtime
      ↓
Evidence DSL
      ↓
Policy Evaluation
      ↓
E1-E5 Certification
```

核心设计原则：

```text
1. 技术无关语义优先于框架语法。
2. 规则必须可执行，不只是说明文档。
3. 所有断言必须可追溯到源代码、场景和证据。
4. 所有差异必须有分类和处置状态。
5. 所有不支持语义必须显式表达。
6. 任何自动规范化都必须受规则控制。
7. 关键认证不得依靠模型自然语言判断。
8. Schema、DSL和IR必须独立版本化。
```

# 三、统一语言栈

## 3.1 文件格式

规范源文件优先使用YAML：

```text
*.semantic.yaml
*.rules.yaml
*.mutations.yaml
*.scenarios.yaml
*.evidence.yaml
*.policy.yaml
```

执行时统一规范化为JSON：

```text
Authoring YAML
     ↓
Parse
     ↓
Canonical JSON
     ↓
Schema Validation
     ↓
Semantic Validation
     ↓
Compiled Execution Plan
```

YAML仅作为编辑格式。

所有哈希、签名和缓存都基于规范化后的Canonical JSON，而不是原始YAML文本。

---

## 3.2 Schema层

结构Schema：

```text
JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
```

负责：

```text
字段类型
必填字段
枚举
联合类型
引用
递归结构
扩展字段限制
基础格式验证
```

约束层：

```text
CUE
```

负责：

```text
跨字段约束
跨文档约束
范围合并
Domain Pack叠加
框架能力叠加
配置推导
兼容性判断
代码生成输入
```

发布策略层：

```text
Rego或等价策略引擎
```

负责：

```text
Release Gate
E1-E5准入
风险等级策略
审批要求
条件认证
自动回滚决策
```

---

## 3.3 顶层文档信封

所有DSL文档共享统一信封：

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticModule

metadata:
  name: checkout-page
  namespace: ecommerce
  version: 1.2.0

  labels:
    framework: vue3
    domain: ecommerce
    risk: R5

  annotations:
    owner: checkout-team
    sourceCommit: abc123
    generatedBy: semantic-ir-compiler/1.0.0

spec: {}
```

统一顶层字段：

```text
apiVersion
kind
metadata
imports
spec
extensions
```

`extensions`只允许使用注册命名空间：

```yaml
extensions:
  com.example.payment:
    pciScope: tokenized
```

禁止：

```yaml
unknownField: arbitrary-value
```

---

# 四、统一Semantic IR

## 4.1 Semantic IR定位

Semantic IR不是：

```text
Vue AST
React AST
WXML AST
ArkTS AST
Dart AST
```

也不是目标代码模板。

它表示源系统中与行为等价有关的语义：

```text
组件
状态
输入输出
更新规则
生命周期
导航
布局
交互
副作用
权限
能力
业务不变量
持久化
恢复
性能预算
可访问性
```

同一Semantic IR应能被多个目标后端消费。

---

## 4.2 IR分层

```text
Repository IR
├── Module IR
│   ├── Component IR
│   ├── State IR
│   ├── Effect IR
│   ├── Navigation IR
│   ├── UI IR
│   └── Capability IR
├── Domain IR
├── Invariant IR
└── Evidence Binding IR
```

### L0：Syntax Facts

直接从源代码提取：

```text
组件名
函数名
装饰器
Hook调用
路由调用
平台API调用
事件绑定
状态写入
```

### L1：Framework Semantics

由源适配器解释：

```text
React Effect
Vue watch
setData批次
ArkUI Monitor
Flutter didUpdateWidget
```

### L2：Platform-Neutral Semantics

统一表示：

```text
StateEffect
ResourceSubscription
RoutePush
RouteReplace
TwoWayBinding
PermissionRequest
PaymentIntent
```

### L3：Domain Semantics

例如：

```text
CreateOrder
ApplyCoupon
ApproveRequest
SendDeviceCommand
SaveDocument
```

### L4：Certification Semantics

例如：

```text
R5不可逆副作用
必须零差异
必须真机
必须后端确认
必须支持回滚
```

---

## 4.3 IR核心实体

```text
SemanticRepository
SemanticModule
SemanticComponent
SemanticState
SemanticInput
SemanticOutput
SemanticDerivedValue
SemanticEffect
SemanticResource
SemanticRoute
SemanticUIElement
SemanticGesture
SemanticCapability
SemanticInvariant
SemanticDomainOperation
SemanticPersistence
SemanticRecoveryContract
```

---

## 4.4 全局ID

所有实体必须有稳定ID：

```yaml
id: state://checkout/cart/items
```

建议格式：

```text
<kind>://<module>/<path>
```

支持的kind：

```text
module
component
state
input
output
derived
effect
resource
route
ui
gesture
capability
invariant
operation
evidence
```

示例：

```text
component://checkout/payment-form
state://checkout/order/total
effect://checkout/recalculate-total
route://checkout/payment
capability://platform/payment
invariant://checkout/order-total-exact
```

ID不得依赖：

```text
源码行号
数组位置
随机UUID
生成时间
```

因为这些值不能稳定支持差分和缓存。

---

## 4.5 Source Map

每个IR节点必须可回溯源代码：

```yaml
sourceMap:
  repository: source
  file: src/pages/checkout.vue
  language: typescript

  range:
    start:
      line: 42
      column: 3
    end:
      line: 68
      column: 4

  symbol: recalculateTotal
  astNodeId: optional-parser-id
```

生成型节点：

```yaml
sourceMap:
  generated: true
  derivedFrom:
    - state://checkout/cart/items
    - state://checkout/coupon
```

---

## 4.6 置信度和来源

```yaml
provenance:
  extraction:
    method: static-analysis
    confidence: 0.97

  semanticClassification:
    method: hybrid
    confidence: 0.88

  reviewed:
    status: approved
    reviewer: checkout-team
```

允许的方法：

```text
static-analysis
runtime-trace
test-derived
model-inferred
human-declared
hybrid
```

规则：

```text
model-inferred且低置信度
→ 不得成为唯一R4/R5认证依据
```

---

## 4.7 语义损失模型

每次转换必须表达损失风险：

```yaml
semanticLoss:
  level: none

  categories: []

  mitigation: []
```

可选等级：

```text
none
representational
behavioral-risk
approved-degradation
blocking
unknown
```

示例：

```yaml
semanticLoss:
  level: approved-degradation

  categories:
    - platform-share-interaction

  sourceBehavior:
    type: share-to-wechat-friend

  targetBehavior:
    type: operating-system-share-sheet

  approval:
    decisionId: PD-182
```

---

# 五、SemanticRepository Schema

## 5.1 顶层结构

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticRepository

metadata:
  name: commerce-web
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  framework:
    family: vue
    version: "3.5"

  runtime:
    language: typescript
    platform: web

  modules:
    - ref: modules/checkout.semantic.yaml
    - ref: modules/catalog.semantic.yaml

  routes:
    - ref: routes/routes.semantic.yaml

  capabilities:
    - ref: capabilities/platform.semantic.yaml

  domains:
    - ecommerce-payment
    - map-location

  overlays:
    - identity-permission
    - accessibility-i18n
```

---

## 5.2 类型系统

统一值类型：

```yaml
type:
  kind: object

  properties:
    status:
      type:
        kind: enum
        values:
          - DRAFT
          - SUBMITTED
          - PAID

    total:
      type:
        kind: decimal
        scale: 2
        currency: CNY
```

支持：

```text
boolean
integer
decimal
string
binary
date
datetime
duration
enum
array
tuple
map
set
object
union
optional
reference
opaque
resource-handle
```

禁止将金额默认为普通浮点数。

---

## 5.3 Null、Missing和Undefined

统一IR必须区分：

```text
MISSING
NULL
UNDEFINED
VALUE
```

示例：

```yaml
presence:
  states:
    - missing
    - null
    - value
```

原因是不同框架对：

```text
未声明字段
undefined
null
删除字段
默认值
```

处理不同。

---

## 5.4 状态所有权

```yaml
states:
  - id: state://checkout/form/address

    name: address

    type:
      ref: type://checkout/address

    ownership:
      scope: component
      owner: component://checkout/address-form

    lifetime:
      create: component-created
      destroy: component-destroyed

    persistence:
      mode: none

    visibility:
      exposedToRender: true
      exposedToChildren: true

    updateModel:
      atomicity: field
      batching: framework-managed
      equality: structural
```

Scope枚举：

```text
component
page
route
tab
application
session
account
device
persistent
server
```

---

## 5.5 状态更新操作

```yaml
operations:
  - id: operation://checkout/update-quantity

    kind: state-transition

    inputs:
      - name: skuId
        type: string
      - name: quantity
        type: integer

    reads:
      - state://checkout/cart/items

    writes:
      - state://checkout/cart/items

    transaction:
      atomic: true

    postconditions:
      - invariant://checkout/cart-quantity-valid
```

统一更新类型：

```text
assign
merge
patch
append
insert
remove
replace
clear
increment
decrement
transaction
emit
```

# 六、Component IR

## 6.1 组件定义

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticComponent

metadata:
  name: quantity-selector

spec:
  id: component://cart/quantity-selector

  componentKind: interactive

  inputs:
    - id: input://cart/quantity-selector/value
      name: value
      type: integer
      required: true

  outputs:
    - id: output://cart/quantity-selector/change
      name: change
      payload:
        kind: object
        properties:
          value:
            type: integer

  localState:
    - ref: state://cart/quantity-selector/draft-value

  derivedValues:
    - ref: derived://cart/quantity-selector/can-increment

  effects: []

  ui:
    root:
      ref: ui://cart/quantity-selector/root

  lifecycle:
    contracts: []
```

---

## 6.2 组件身份

```yaml
identity:
  strategy: business-key
  keyExpression:
    ref: state://cart/item/sku-id

  reuse:
    when:
      sameType: true
      sameKey: true

  reset:
    when:
      keyChanges: true
```

允许策略：

```text
position
business-key
object-identity
explicit-reset-key
singleton
route-instance
platform-managed
```

30个验证器必须把源框架身份规则转换为该模型。

---

## 6.3 父子通信

```yaml
binding:
  id: binding://checkout/dialog/visible

  kind: controlled-two-way

  parentState:
    ref: state://checkout/payment-dialog-visible

  childInput:
    ref: input://payment-dialog/visible

  childOutput:
    ref: output://payment-dialog/visible-change

  updateAuthority: parent

  childMutationAllowed: false
```

支持：

```text
one-way-input
callback-output
controlled-two-way
shared-reference
provider-consumer
store-subscription
imperative-command
```

---

# 七、Effect IR

## 7.1 Effect定义

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticEffect

metadata:
  name: load-product

spec:
  id: effect://product/load

  trigger:
    kind: dependency-change

    dependencies:
      - state://route/product-id
      - state://session/locale

    initialRun: true

  scheduling:
    phase: after-render
    debounceMs: 0
    orderingGroup: product-data

  reads:
    - state://route/product-id

  writes:
    - state://product/loading
    - state://product/data
    - state://product/error

  sideEffects:
    - capability://network/product-read

  concurrency:
    mode: latest-wins
    cancellation: required
    staleResultPolicy: discard

  cleanup:
    required: true
    actions:
      - cancel-request
```

---

## 7.2 Effect触发类型

```text
component-created
component-mounted
component-updated
component-destroyed
page-entered
page-visible
page-hidden
page-destroyed
application-foreground
application-background
dependency-change
event
timer
stream-event
navigation
manual-command
```

---

## 7.3 执行阶段

```text
before-render
during-render-forbidden
after-render
after-layout
after-frame
background
platform-callback
transaction-commit
```

---

## 7.4 并发模型

```text
all
latest-wins
first-wins
queue
drop-while-running
restartable
sequential
parallel-bounded
idempotent-retry
```

示例：

```yaml
concurrency:
  mode: latest-wins
  cancellation: required
  correlationKey:
    expression: productId
```

---

# 八、Lifecycle IR

## 8.1 生命周期契约

```yaml
lifecycleContracts:
  - id: lifecycle://product/subscription

    resource:
      ref: resource://product/status-stream

    acquire:
      phase: page-visible

    pause:
      phases:
        - application-background
        - page-hidden

    resume:
      phases:
        - application-foreground
        - page-visible

    release:
      phase: page-destroyed

    constraints:
      maximumActiveInstances: 1
      callbacksAfterRelease: 0
      duplicateAcquireAllowed: false
```

---

## 8.2 生命周期标准阶段

```text
process-created
application-created
application-foreground
application-inactive
application-background
route-created
route-entering
route-visible
route-covered
route-hidden
route-restored
route-destroyed
component-created
component-mounted
component-updated
component-deactivated
component-reactivated
component-destroyed
process-terminated
process-restored
```

---

# 九、Navigation IR

## 9.1 路由定义

```yaml
routes:
  - id: route://checkout/payment

    name: checkout-payment

    parameters:
      - name: orderId
        type: string
        required: true
        serialization: url-safe

    stack:
      type: root

    restoration:
      required: true

    entrySources:
      - internal
      - deep-link
      - share
```

```yaml
navigationOperations:

    action: push

    route:
      ref: route://checkout/payment

        from: state://checkout/order/id

    expectedStackEffect:
      delta: 1

        kind: enum

```

# 十一、Capability IR

## 11.1 能力定义

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticCapability

metadata:
  name: payment

spec:
  id: capability://platform/payment

  category: irreversible-side-effect
  risk: R5

  request:
    type:
      ref: type://payment/request

  result:
    type:
      ref: type://payment/result

  outcomes:
    - success
    - cancelled
    - rejected
    - failed
    - timeout
    - unknown

  idempotency:
    required: true
    keyField: paymentIntentId

  authority:
    finalResult: server

  environments:
    test:
      implementation: simulator

    shadow:
      implementation: intent-capture-only

    production:
      implementation: platform-native
```

---

## 11.2 能力映射

```yaml
capabilityMappings:
  - source:
      capability: capability://wechat/request-payment

    target:
      capability: capability://flutter/payment-plugin

    equivalence:
      class: business-equivalent

    requiredAdapters:
      - payment-gateway

    unsupportedOutcomes: []

    verification:
      realDeviceRequired: true
      shadowMode: intent-only
```

---

# 十二、Invariant IR

## 12.1 不变量定义

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SemanticInvariant

metadata:
  name: order-total-exact

spec:
  id: invariant://checkout/order-total-exact

  risk: R5
  severity: blocking

  scope:
    domains:
      - ecommerce-payment

  expression:
    language: fev-expr
    value: |
      order.total ==
        sum(cart.items[*].unitPrice * cart.items[*].quantity)
        - discounts.total
        + shipping.total
        + tax.total

  numeric:
    type: decimal
    tolerance: 0

  requiredEvidence:
    - differential-test
    - property-test
    - mutation-test
    - shadow-result

  releasePolicy:
    requiredPassRate: 1.0
    allowedFailures: 0
```

---

## 12.2 不变量类型

```text
state
transition
ordering
cardinality
identity
authorization
monetary
navigation
lifecycle
resource
performance
privacy
accessibility
platform-capability
recovery
```

---

# 十三、统一表达式语言FEV-Expr

## 13.1 设计目标

FEV-Expr只能表达纯函数式条件。

禁止：

```text
文件写入
网络调用
随机数
当前时间直接读取
外部进程
反射调用
任意代码执行
```

允许：

```text
布尔
比较
算术
集合
路径
量词
时间差
事件序列
状态快照
```

---

## 13.2 基础语法

```text
order.total == expected.total

count(network.calls where path == "/orders") == 1

forall item in cart.items:
  item.quantity >= 1

exists event in lifecycle.events:
  event.phase == "page-visible"

before(payment.intent, order.confirmation)

eventually(
  state.order.status == "PAID",
  within = 30s
)
```

---

## 13.3 支持函数

```text
count
sum
min
max
avg
distinct
contains
startsWith
endsWith
matches
abs
round
decimal
duration
before
after
eventually
always
never
changed
unchanged
sameIdentity
approximately
```

`approximately`不得用于：

```text
金额
权限
请求次数
业务ID
订单状态
路由栈
```

---

# 十四、Directional Rule DSL

## 14.1 定位

Rule DSL用于表达：

```text
源语义如何映射到目标语义
哪些模式必须拒绝
哪些场景必须生成
哪些变异必须启用
哪些差异允许规范化
哪些证据必须生成
```

---

## 14.2 Rule Pack顶层结构

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DirectionalRulePack

metadata:
  name: vue3-to-flutter-core
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  direction:
    source: vue3
    target: flutter

  compatibility:
    sourceVersions:
      - ">=3.3 <4.0"
    targetVersions:
      - ">=3.20 <4.0"

  imports:
    - fev://rules/common/state
    - fev://rules/flutter/widget-identity

  rules: []
```

---

## 14.3 Rule定义

```yaml
rules:
  - id: rule://vue3-flutter/watch-latest-wins

    title: Preserve latest-wins watch semantics

    category: effect-concurrency
    severity: blocking

    match:
      source:
        entityKind: effect

        predicates:
          - field: trigger.kind
            op: eq
            value: dependency-change

          - field: concurrency.mode
            op: eq
            value: latest-wins

    require:
      target:
        anyOf:
          - pattern: cancellable-listener
          - pattern: request-generation-token
          - pattern: switch-latest-stream

    forbid:
      target:
        - pattern: uncancelled-future-listener

    generate:
      scenarios:
        - scenario://common/request-reordering

      mutations:
        - mutation://flutter/remove-request-cancellation

    evidence:
      required:
        - static-finding
        - differential-test
        - mutation-test

    failure:
      classification: target-regression
      releaseImpact: block
```

---

## 14.4 Rule类型

```text
mapping
requirement
prohibition
normalization
scenario-generation
mutation-generation
evidence-requirement
capability-classification
manual-review
release-gate
```

---

## 14.5 Match表达式

```yaml
match:
  source:
    allOf:
      - entityKind: state
      - path: ownership.scope
        equals: component

      - anyOf:
          - annotation: vue.ref
          - annotation: vue.reactive

      - not:
          annotation: runtime-resource
```

支持：

```text
allOf
anyOf
not
exists
forall
path comparison
type assignability
annotation
source API
control-flow property
data-flow property
```

---

## 14.6 Require和Forbid

```yaml
require:
  target:
    allOf:
      - semanticProperty:
          path: ownership.scope
          equalsSource: ownership.scope

      - evidence:
          type: differential-test

forbid:
  target:
    - semanticProperty:
        path: persistence.mode
        equals: application-global
```

---

## 14.7 规范化规则

```yaml
normalization:
  - id: normalize://css/generated-class

    appliesTo:
      observation: semantic-tree

    path: nodes[*].attributes.class

    action: remove-generated-token

    constraints:
      mustNotAffect:
        - role
        - name
        - visible
        - enabled
        - actions
```

高风险字段不得配置通配忽略：

```text
network.calls[*]
payment.*
permission.*
navigation.stack
identity.*
```

---

## 14.8 Rule优先级

```text
platform-safety
domain-R5
directional-critical
domain
overlay
project-local
normalization
```

冲突处理：

```text
更严格规则胜出
```

例如：

```text
通用视觉规则允许2px误差
支付按钮热区Domain规则要求完全可操作
→ 支付规则胜出
```

---

# 十五、Rule DSL Schema片段

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://fev.openai.dev/schema/rule-pack/v1alpha1",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["apiVersion", "kind", "metadata", "spec"],
  "properties": {
    "apiVersion": {
      "const": "fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1"
    },
    "kind": {
      "const": "DirectionalRulePack"
    },
    "metadata": {
      "$ref": "common/metadata.schema.json"
    },
    "spec": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["direction", "rules"],
      "properties": {
        "direction": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": ["source", "target"],
          "properties": {
            "source": {
              "$ref": "common/framework.schema.json"
            },
            "target": {
              "$ref": "common/framework.schema.json"
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "rules": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "rule.schema.json"
          }
        }
      },
      "unevaluatedProperties": false
    }
  },
  "unevaluatedProperties": false
}
```

---

# 十六、Mutation DSL

## 16.1 定位

Mutation DSL用于描述：

```text
要故意注入什么缺陷
注入位置
前置条件
预期哪些测试应杀死该变异
变异是否改变语义
变异存活如何影响认证
```

---

## 16.2 Mutation Pack结构

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: MutationPack

metadata:
  name: flutter-state-lifecycle
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  appliesTo:
    frameworks:
      - flutter

  operators: []
```

---

## 16.3 Mutation Operator

```yaml
operators:
  - id: mutation://flutter/remove-dispose-cleanup

    title: Remove resource cleanup from dispose

    category: lifecycle-resource
    risk: R4
    severity: critical

    match:
      semantic:
        entityKind: lifecycle-contract

        predicates:
          - path: release.phase
            equals: component-destroyed

          - path: resource.kind
            in:
              - subscription
              - timer
              - controller

    transformation:
      level: semantic-ir

      operations:
        - op: remove
          path: release

    materialization:
      target:
        strategy: source-rewrite

        adapters:
          flutter:
            rewrite: remove-dispose-statement

    expectedDetection:
      scenarios:
        - scenario://common/component-destroyed
        - scenario://common/reenter-page

      assertions:
        - invariant://resources/no-callback-after-destroy
        - invariant://resources/max-one-active-instance

    survival:
      releaseImpact: block
```

---

## 16.4 变异层次

```text
semantic-ir
source-ast
target-ast
runtime-fault
environment
network
platform-api
storage
navigation
time
```

---

## 16.5 通用变异操作

```text
replace
remove
insert
duplicate
reorder
delay
drop
corrupt
truncate
change-type
change-scope
change-identity
change-routing-action
change-permission-result
change-lifecycle-phase
```

---

## 16.6 AST变异

```yaml
transformation:
  level: target-ast

  selector:
    language: dart
    pattern: |
      @StateClass.dispose() {
        $BODY
      }

  rewrite:
    pattern: |
      @StateClass.dispose() {
        $BODY_WITHOUT_CONTROLLER_DISPOSE
      }
```

AST变异必须通过框架插件执行。

禁止直接使用不稳定文本替换处理关键变异。

---

## 16.7 运行时故障变异

```yaml
- id: mutation://network/reorder-responses

  category: concurrency

  transformation:
    level: runtime-fault

    fault:
      type: response-reordering

      requests:
        match:
          endpoint: /api/search

      order:
        - request: second
        - request: first

  expectedDetection:
    invariants:
      - invariant://search/latest-query-wins
```

---

## 16.8 变异等价判断

某些变异可能不改变行为。

状态：

```text
killed
survived
equivalent-confirmed
invalid
not-executed
infrastructure-failure
```

`equivalent-confirmed`必须有：

```text
静态证明
或
人工审核
或
足够强的约束说明
```

不能由模型单独宣布。

---

## 16.9 Mutation Score

```text
critical mutation score
=
killed critical mutations
/
(valid critical mutations - confirmed equivalent mutations)
```

但认证同时要求：

```text
critical survivors = 0
```

不能只依赖总分。

---

# 十七、Scenario DSL

## 17.1 定位

Scenario DSL描述：

```text
环境
初始状态
Fixture
身份
权限
网络
操作步骤
检查点
期望不变量
源目标比较策略
清理
```

---

## 17.2 Scenario Pack

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ScenarioPack

metadata:
  name: ecommerce-checkout
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  parameters:
    - name: platform
      values:
        - source
        - target

  scenarios: []
```

---

## 17.3 完整场景示例

```yaml
scenarios:
  - id: scenario://checkout/payment-callback-lost

    title: Payment succeeds but client callback is lost

    risk: R5
    priority: critical

    tags:
      - checkout
      - payment
      - recovery

    appliesTo:
      domains:
        - ecommerce-payment

    environment:
      locale: zh-CN
      timezone: Asia/Shanghai
      theme: light

      screen:
        class: compact
        width: 390
        height: 844

      clock:
        mode: controlled
        start: "2026-07-30T00:00:00+08:00"

      random:
        seed: 41257

    identity:
      account:
        id: account-101
        roles:
          - customer

    permissions: {}

    fixtures:
      services:
        catalog:
          ref: fixture://catalog/default

        payment:
          script:
            - on: create-intent
              return:
                paymentIntentId: pi-1001

            - on: platform-pay
              effect:
                businessResult: success
                clientCallback: dropped

            - on: query-status
              return:
                status: PAID

    initial:
      route:
        id: route://checkout/confirmation

      state:
        order:
          id: order-1001
          status: SUBMITTED
          total:
            amount: "299.00"
            currency: CNY

    steps:
      - id: step-1
        action:
          tap:
            target:
              semanticId: ui://checkout/pay-button

      - id: step-2
        wait:
          until:
            event:
              type: payment-platform-completed
          timeout: 10s

      - id: step-3
        lifecycle:
          application: background

      - id: step-4
        lifecycle:
          application: foreground

      - id: step-5
        wait:
          until:
            state:
              path: order.status
              equals: PAID
          timeout: 30s

    checkpoints:
      - after: step-1

        assert:
          - expression: |
              count(payment.intents) == 1

      - after: step-5

        assert:
          - expression: |
              state.order.status == "PAID"

          - expression: |
              count(payment.intents) == 1

          - expression: |
              count(order.creations) == 0

    differential:
      compare:
        - domain-state
        - payment-intent
        - navigation
        - visible-state

      exact:
        - state.order.status
        - payment.intents[*].amount
        - payment.intents[*].currency

    cleanup:
      resetFixtures: true
```

---

## 17.4 Action类型

```text
tap
double-tap
long-press
input
clear-input
select
toggle
submit
scroll
drag
swipe

rotate
keyboard
focus
blur
navigate
back
open-deep-link
lifecycle
permission-response
network-change
advance-clock
process-kill
process-restore
custom-domain-action
```

---

## 17.5 元素定位

优先顺序：

```text
semantic-id
业务ID
可访问角色和名称
测试ID
稳定路径
坐标
```

坐标定位只能作为最后手段。

```yaml
target:
  anyOf:
    - semanticId: ui://checkout/pay-button

    - role: button
      name: 立即支付
```

禁止使用：

```text
第3个div
自动生成CSS类
随机Element ID
易变Widget树索引
```

---

## 17.6 Wait语义

```yaml
wait:
  until:
    allOf:
      - network:
          idleFor: 500ms

      - animation:
          settled: true

      - state:
          path: loading
          equals: false

  timeout: 5s
```

禁止在关键场景中仅使用固定睡眠：

```yaml
wait:
  duration: 3000ms
```

除非场景本身验证计时。

## 17.7 场景矩阵和参数化

```yaml
matrix:
  locale:
    - zh-CN
    - en-US

  network:
    - normal
    - slow
    - intermittent

  platform:
    - ios
    - android

  permission:
    - granted
    - denied

exclude:
  - platform: ios
    permission: platform-not-applicable
```

编译器展开为独立Scenario Instance，并生成稳定实例ID。

```yaml
  maximumDepth: 12

  coverage:
    transitions: 100%

```

# 十九、Evidence DSL

## 19.1 定位

Evidence DSL不只是测试报告格式。

它必须表达：

```text
提出了什么Claim
Claim属于哪个范围
由哪些Evidence支持
证据来自什么执行
证据是否完整
是否独立
何时失效
最终决策是什么
```

---

## 19.2 Evidence Bundle

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: EvidenceBundle

metadata:
  name: vue3-to-flutter-checkout-e5
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  scope:
    source:
      commit: abc123
      framework: vue3
      lockHash: sha256:source-lock

    target:
      commit: def456
      framework: flutter
      lockHash: sha256:target-lock

    validator:
      id: vue3-to-flutter-validator
      version: 1.3.0

    domainPacks:
      ecommerce-payment: 1.2.0

    environment:
      hash: sha256:env

  claims: []
  evidence: []
  decisions: []
```

---

## 19.3 Claim

```yaml
claims:
  - id: claim://checkout/payment-at-most-once

    statement:
      invariant:
        ref: invariant://checkout/payment-at-most-once

    risk: R5
    requiredLevel: E5

    acceptance:
      allowedFailures: 0
      requiredCoverage: 1.0

    evidenceRequirements:
      minimumIndependentProducers: 2

      types:
        - differential-test
        - mutation-test
        - device-test
        - shadow-result
```

---

## 19.4 Evidence Record

```yaml
evidence:
  - id: evidence://run/20260730/payment-shadow-001

    type: shadow-result

    claimRefs:
      - claim://checkout/payment-at-most-once

    producer:

      completedAt: "2026-07-30T01:00:00+08:00"
```

# 二十一、Certification Policy DSL

虽然Batch 7重点是五套DSL，但认证需要策略语言连接Evidence DSL。

示例：

```rego
package fev.certification.e5

default allow := false

blocking_claims := {
  claim.id |
  some claim in input.claims
  claim.risk == "R5"
  claim.status != "pass"
}

unresolved_differences := {
  diff.id |
  some diff in input.differences
  diff.classification == "UNRESOLVED"
}

critical_survivors := {
  mutation.id |
  some mutation in input.mutations
  mutation.severity == "critical"
  mutation.status == "survived"
}

allow if {
  count(blocking_claims) == 0
  count(unresolved_differences) == 0
  count(critical_survivors) == 0
  input.rollback.readiness == "pass"
  input.shadow.status == "pass"
  input.canary.status == "pass"
}
```

策略只负责决策。

它不能生成或修改原始证据。

# 二十三、Domain Pack DSL

Domain Pack使用相同构件：

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DomainPack

metadata:
  name: ecommerce-payment
  version: 1.2.0

spec:
  semanticTypes:
    - ref: types/order.yaml
    - ref: types/payment.yaml

  invariants:
    - ref: invariants/order-total.yaml
    - ref: invariants/payment-at-most-once.yaml

  scenarios:
    - ref: scenarios/payment.yaml

  mutations:
    - ref: mutations/payment.yaml

  evidenceRequirements:
    - ref: evidence/payment-e5.yaml

  releasePolicies:
    - ref: policies/payment.rego
```

叠加规则：

```text
Directional Rule Pack
∪ Domain Pack
∪ Overlay Pack
∪ Project Local Pack
```

冲突时采用更严格约束。

# 二十四、Validator Manifest

30个有向验证器分别拥有Manifest。

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ValidatorManifest

metadata:
  name: vue3-to-flutter-validator
  version: 1.3.0

spec:
  direction:
    source: vue3
    target: flutter

  adapters:
    source:
      plugin: vue3-semantic-adapter
      version: 1.2.0

    target:
      plugin: flutter-runtime-adapter
      version: 1.1.0

  semanticIR:
    version: v1alpha1

  rulePacks:
    - fev://rules/vue3-to-flutter/core@1.3.0
    - fev://rules/flutter/widget-identity@1.1.0

  mutationPacks:
    - fev://mutations/vue3/watch@1.0.0
    - fev://mutations/flutter/lifecycle@1.0.0

  scenarioPacks:
    - fev://scenarios/common/frontend@1.0.0

  capabilities:
    source:
      - web

    target:
      - android
      - ios

  requiredRuntimes:
    - differential-runtime
    - flutter-device-runner
```

# 二十五、Adapter Plugin接口

## 25.1 Source Adapter

```ts
interface SourceSemanticAdapter {
  id(): string;

  supportedVersions(): VersionRange;

  scanRepository(
    input: RepositoryInput
  ): Promise<RepositoryFacts>;

  compileSemanticIR(
    facts: RepositoryFacts,
    context: CompilationContext
  ): Promise<SemanticRepository>;

  instrument(
    repository: RepositoryInput,
    plan: InstrumentationPlan
  ): Promise<InstrumentedArtifact>;

  translateSourceLocation(
    semanticId: string
  ): Promise<SourceLocation[]>;
}
```

---

## 25.2 Runtime Adapter

```ts
interface PlatformRuntimeAdapter {
  start(
    configuration: RuntimeConfiguration
  ): Promise<RuntimeSession>;

  setEnvironment(
    environment: DeterministicEnvironment
  ): Promise<void>;

  setInitialState(
    state: StateSnapshot
  ): Promise<void>;

  executeAction(
    action: ScenarioAction
  ): Promise<ActionResult>;

  captureObservation(
    request: ObservationRequest
  ): Promise<Observation>;

  injectFault(
    fault: RuntimeFault
  ): Promise<void>;

  shutdown(): Promise<void>;
}
```

---

## 25.3 Mutation Adapter

```ts
interface MutationMaterializer {
  supports(operator: MutationOperator): boolean;

  apply(
    repository: RepositoryInput,
    mutation: MutationInstance
  ): Promise<MutatedRepository>;

  verifyApplied(
    original: RepositoryInput,
    mutated: MutatedRepository
  ): Promise<MutationVerification>;

  revert(): Promise<void>;
}
```

## 26.1 编译产物

```text
compiled/
├── semantic-graph.json
├── rule-index.json
├── scenario-plan.json
├── mutation-plan.json
├── evidence-plan.json
```

## 26.2 Execution Plan

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ExecutionPlan

metadata:
  name: vue3-to-flutter-checkout

spec:
  stages:
    - id: compile-source-ir
      executor: semantic-compiler

    - id: run-static-rules
      dependsOn:
        - compile-source-ir

    - id: run-differential-scenarios
      dependsOn:
        - run-static-rules

      matrix:
        scenarios:
          ref: compiled/scenario-plan.json

    - id: run-mutations
      dependsOn:
        - run-differential-scenarios

    - id: assemble-evidence
      dependsOn:
        - run-mutations

    - id: evaluate-e3-policy
      dependsOn:
        - assemble-evidence
```

# 二十七、静态检查器

## 27.1 必须检查

```text
未解析引用
重复ID
循环导入
非法版本范围
未注册扩展
无对应目标能力
无验证场景的关键规则
无杀伤测试的关键变异
无Claim绑定的证据
无Evidence要求的R4/R5不变量
宽泛规范化规则
不可执行表达式
死规则
互相冲突规则
永远不能满足的Release Gate
```

---

## 27.2 Lint错误级别

```text
info
warning
error
blocking
```

示例：

```text
FEV-RULE-0042
Blocking:
R5规则未声明requiredEvidence。
```

---

## 27.3 不安全规范化检测

以下配置直接阻断：

```yaml
normalization:
  path: "**"
  action: ignore
```

以下字段不能被忽略：

```text
payment
order
inventory
authorization
permission
identity
device-command
navigation-stack
request-count
persistent-state
```

# 二十八、版本设计

## 28.1 版本对象

```text
Semantic IR Version
DSL API Version
Schema Version
Rule Pack Version
Mutation Pack Version
Scenario Pack Version
Evidence Version
Adapter Version
Validator Version
```

必须分别管理。

---

## 28.2 版本兼容性

```text
PATCH：
不改变语义，只修复说明、错误信息或兼容实现。

MINOR：
增加可选字段、新规则、新操作符。

MAJOR：
删除字段、改变默认值、改变既有规则语义。
```

---

## 28.3 Schema迁移

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1beta1
kind: SchemaMigration

spec:
  from: v1alpha1
  to: v1beta1

  transformations:
    - rename:
        from: spec.effect.cleanupRequired
        to: spec.effect.cleanup.required

    - default:
        path: spec.effect.concurrency.mode
        value: all
```

迁移后必须生成：

```text
迁移前哈希
迁移后哈希
迁移规则版本
丢失字段
需要人工复核字段
```

---

## 28.4 证据兼容性

规则版本升级后，不一定所有旧证据都失效。

```yaml
evidenceCompatibility:
  ruleChange:
    type: stronger-requirement

  affectedClaims:
    - claim://payment-at-most-once

  action:
    invalidate:
      - mutation-test
      - shadow-result

    retain:
      - build-result
```

---

# 二十九、可重复性和确定性

## 29.1 Canonical JSON

规范化规则：

```text
UTF-8
对象键排序
数字规范表达
时间使用RFC 3339
Duration使用标准单位
禁止NaN和Infinity
删除非语义注释
保持数组语义顺序
```

## 29.2 内容哈希

```yaml
artifact:
  digest:
    algorithm: sha256
    value: "..."
```

哈希输入包括：

```text
Canonical DSL
Schema版本
导入包内容
编译器版本
插件版本
运行环境
```

## 29.3 随机性

```yaml
random:

  seed: 86219
```

所有Fuzz和场景生成必须记录Seed。

## 30.1 数据分类

```yaml
dataClassification:
  path: identity.user.email
  class: personal
  handling:
    storage: prohibited-in-evidence
    display: masked
    shadow: pseudonymized
```

分类：

```text
public
internal
confidential
personal
sensitive-personal
payment
credential
secret
```

## 30.2 Secret引用

```yaml
credentials:
```

DSL不能允许：

```text
任意Shell
任意JavaScript
任意Python
任意Dart
任意ArkTS
```

如需扩展，必须引用注册插件：

```yaml
action:

    id: plugin://company/custom-scanner
    version: 1.0.0
    input: {}
```

# 三十三、端到端示例：Vue 3 → Flutter商城

## 33.1 源语义

Vue 3代码：

```ts
watch(
  () => [cart.items, coupon.value],
  async () => {
    await recalculate()
  },
  {
    deep: true,
    immediate: true
  }
)
```

编译为：

```yaml
id: effect://checkout/recalculate-total

trigger:
  kind: dependency-change
  dependencies:
    - state://checkout/cart/items
    - state://checkout/coupon
  initialRun: true
  deepObservation: true

concurrency:
  mode: latest-wins
  cancellation: required

writes:
  - state://checkout/order/total
```

---

## 33.2 方向规则

```yaml
id: rule://vue3-flutter/deep-watch-recalculation

match:
  source:
    id: effect://checkout/recalculate-total

require:
  target:
    allOf:
      - pattern: immutable-cart-state
      - pattern: cancellable-total-recalculation
      - pattern: notifier-or-state-emission

generate:
  scenarios:
    - scenario://checkout/coupon-and-quantity-same-frame
    - scenario://checkout/recalculation-response-reordered

  mutations:
    - mutation://flutter/remove-state-emission
    - mutation://flutter/remove-cancellation
```

---

## 33.3 场景

```yaml
id: scenario://checkout/coupon-and-quantity-same-frame

steps:
  - action:
      input:
        target:
          semanticId: ui://cart/quantity
        value: "2"

  - action:
      tap:
        target:
          semanticId: ui://coupon/apply

assert:
  - expression: |
      state.order.total == expected.order.total

  - expression: |
      count(network.calls where operation == "recalculate") <= 2
```

---

## 33.4 变异

```yaml
id: mutation://flutter/remove-state-emission

transformation:
  level: target-ast
  operations:
    - remove:
        semanticPattern: state-notification

expectedDetection:
  scenarios:
    - scenario://checkout/coupon-and-quantity-same-frame

  invariants:
    - invariant://checkout/order-total-exact
```

---

## 33.5 证据

```yaml
claims:
  - id: claim://checkout/order-total-exact

evidence:
  - type: differential-test
    result:
      status: pass

  - type: mutation-test
    result:
      status: pass
      killedMutations:
        - mutation://flutter/remove-state-emission
        - mutation://flutter/remove-cancellation

  - type: device-test
    result:
      status: pass
      devices:
        - android-standard
        - ios-standard
```

最终形成完整追踪链：

```text
Source Code
→ Semantic Effect
→ Directional Rule
→ Generated Scenario
→ Generated Mutation
→ Runtime Observation
→ Evidence
→ Claim
→ E3/E4/E5 Decision
```

# 三十五、Rule Coverage要求

每条Blocking Rule至少必须绑定：

```text
1个正向场景
1个负向场景
1个专项变异
1个Claim
1项Evidence要求
```

检查：

```yaml
ruleCoverage:
  rule: rule://react-flutter/effect-cleanup

  positiveScenarios: 2
  negativeScenarios: 1
  mutations: 3
  claims: 1
  evidenceRequirements: 3

  status: complete
```

缺少任一项：

```text
RULE_NOT_CERTIFIABLE
```

# 三十九、Batch 7完成后的系统能力

Batch 7完成后，系统不再是：

```text
30套彼此独立的自然语言验证说明
```

而是：

```text
统一Semantic IR
+ 可执行Rule DSL
+ 可执行Mutation DSL
+ 可执行Scenario DSL
+ 可追溯Evidence DSL
+ 版本化Schema
+ 编译器
+ 静态检查器
+ 运行时
+ 认证策略
```

最终可以实现：

```text
同一条业务不变量
→ 在30个转换方向中复用

同一个高风险场景
→ 在6个平台运行时中执行

同一个专项变异
→ 由不同框架AST适配器具体落地

同一个Evidence Claim
→ 汇聚静态、差分、真机、影子和灰度证据

同一套E1-E5政策
→ 对不同转换方向做一致、可审计的发布决策
```

最终设计目标是：

> 把“前端仓库迁移是否等价”从依赖模型经验判断的问题，转换为一套具有稳定语义中间层、机器可执行规则、可生成反例、可追溯证据和明确生产准入条件的验证语言与编译系统。

下一批可进入 **Batch 8：Semantic IR编译器、六种Framework Adapter、差分Runtime、Rule Engine与Mutation Engine的代码仓库级实现Skills**。

Batch 8：Semantic IR编译器、六种Framework Adapter、差分Runtime、Rule Engine与Mutation Engine的代码仓库级实现Skills。

## Response:
这一批会把 Batch 7 的 DSL 和 Schema 落到真实代码仓库：核心编译与执行引擎采用确定性内核，六个框架通过插件协议接入，所有运行结果统一回写 Evidence Graph。

下面的设计将 30 个验证器实现为 **共享内核 + 六个框架 Adapter + 30 个规则包**，而不是维护 30 套重复代码。这样新增规则、修复运行时或升级 Evidence Schema 时，只需要改共享层或对应 Adapter。

# Batch 8：Semantic IR编译器、六种Framework Adapter、差分Runtime、Rule Engine与Mutation Engine代码仓库级实现Skills

## 一、Batch 8总体目标

Batch 8负责把前七批的设计落成可运行代码仓库：

```text
六种源框架代码
    ↓
六个Framework Adapter
    ↓
Repository Facts
    ↓
Semantic IR Compiler
    ↓
统一Semantic Graph
    ↓
30个Directional Rule Packs
    ↓
Scenario / Mutation / Observation Plans
    ↓
Differential Runtime
    ↓
Evidence Graph
    ↓
E1–E5认证输入
```

最终实现不应是：

```text
30个彼此复制的验证程序
```

而应是：

```text
1套Semantic IR Compiler
+ 1套Adapter SDK
+ 6个Framework Adapter
+ 1套Rule Engine
+ 1套Mutation Engine
+ 1套Differential Runtime
+ 30个Validator Manifest与Rule Pack
```

核心代码复用关系：

```text
                       ┌── Vue 2 Adapter
                       ├── Vue 3 Adapter
Semantic Compiler  ←───┼── React Adapter
                       ├── 微信小程序 Adapter
                       ├── ArkUI Adapter
                       └── Flutter Adapter
                               │
                               ▼
                       Unified Semantic IR
                               │
                 ┌─────────────┴─────────────┐
                 ▼                           ▼
           Rule Engine                Mutation Engine
                 │                           │
                 └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                               ▼
                    Differential Runtime
                               │
                               ▼
                         Evidence Graph
```

# 三、推荐实现技术栈

## 3.1 确定性核心

推荐使用Rust实现：

```text
Semantic IR Compiler
Semantic Graph
Schema Validator
FEV-Expr解释器
Rule Engine
Mutation Planner
Differential Comparator
Evidence Assembler
CLI核心
```

原因：

```text
类型安全
确定性
较低内存开销
适合并行任务
适合构建CLI和长期运行服务
可避免执行任意用户代码
便于生成单文件工具
```

Rust核心不负责理解所有框架语法，而负责统一协议和语义处理。

---

## 3.2 Web类Adapter

使用TypeScript实现：

```text
Vue 2 Adapter
Vue 3 Adapter
React Adapter
微信小程序Adapter的JS/WXML部分
```

原因：

```text
可以复用JavaScript和TypeScript AST生态
可直接处理SFC、JSX、TSX和配置文件
易于接入现有构建链
```

---

## 3.3 ArkUI Adapter

建议使用：

```text
TypeScript/ArkTS语法分析层
+ ArkTS项目扫描器
+ ArkUI运行时探针
+ HarmonyOS构建和设备桥
```

Parser必须抽象为可替换后端：

```text
官方编译器接口
或
兼容AST Parser
或
Tree-sitter类解析后端
```

不能把整个系统绑定到单一、不稳定的编译器私有API。

---

## 3.4 Flutter Adapter

使用Dart实现：

```text
Dart Analyzer桥
Flutter源码分析
Widget和State语义提取
代码Instrumentation
Integration Test运行桥
```

Rust核心通过插件协议调用Dart Adapter。

---

## 3.5 插件通信

默认采用：

```text
JSON-RPC 2.0
over
stdio
```

优点：

```text
本地插件简单
语言无关
便于隔离进程
日志和协议流可分离
易于录制和重放
```

远程设备实验室可以扩展：

```text
gRPC或HTTP执行服务
```

但本地Adapter SDK不应依赖远程基础设施。

---

# Skill FEV-800：FEV Monorepo Bootstrap

建议路径：

```text
skills/fev-monorepo-bootstrap/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

建立统一可构建、可测试、可缓存、可发布的多语言仓库。

## 2. 工作区

```yaml
workspaces:
  rust:
    root: .
    manifest: Cargo.toml

  node:
    packageManager: pnpm
    manifest: pnpm-workspace.yaml

  dart:
    root: dart
    workspaceMode: local-packages
```

## 3. 根命令

```text
task bootstrap
task build
task lint
task test
task test:unit
task test:conformance
task test:integration
task schemas:validate
task fixtures:update
task release:check
```

## 4. 工具链锁定

必须锁定：

```text
Rust工具链
Cargo.lock
Node版本
pnpm版本
pnpm-lock.yaml
Dart SDK范围
Flutter SDK范围
Schema版本
Adapter Protocol版本
```

生成：

```text
.tool-versions
rust-toolchain.toml
packageManager字段
环境Manifest
```

## 5. CI流水线

```text
Schema Validation
→ Rust Format/Lint
→ TypeScript Format/Lint
→ Dart Format/Analyze
→ Unit Tests
→ Golden Tests
→ Adapter Protocol Tests
→ Fixture Repository Tests
→ Differential Smoke Tests
→ Mutation Smoke Tests
→ Artifact Integrity Check
```

## 6. 禁止条件

```text
未锁定依赖版本
Adapter直接修改源仓库
测试共享不隔离临时目录
CI依赖开发者本机全局包
Golden更新无Review
```

# Skill FEV-801：Semantic IR Compiler Implementation

建议路径：

```text
skills/semantic-ir-compiler-implementation/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 编译器职责

Semantic IR Compiler负责：

```text
加载Repository Facts
解析Adapter输出
合并静态和动态信息
创建稳定Semantic ID
类型检查
解析引用
构建Semantic Graph
执行跨模块约束
生成Canonical IR
生成Instrumentation Plan
```

不负责：

```text
直接解析全部框架源码
执行目标应用
判断最终E1–E5通过
```

---

## 2. 编译阶段

```text
INGEST
→ VALIDATE_FACTS
→ NORMALIZE_FACTS
→ ASSIGN_STABLE_IDS
→ LOWER_FRAMEWORK_SEMANTICS
→ RESOLVE_TYPES
→ RESOLVE_REFERENCES
→ BUILD_DATAFLOW
→ BUILD_CONTROL_EFFECT_GRAPH
→ BUILD_COMPONENT_GRAPH
→ BUILD_NAVIGATION_GRAPH
→ BUILD_CAPABILITY_GRAPH
→ APPLY_DOMAIN_SEMANTICS
→ VALIDATE_INVARIANTS
→ CANONICALIZE
→ EMIT_IR
```

---

## 3. Compiler API

```rust
pub trait SemanticCompiler {
    fn compile(
        &self,
        input: CompileInput,
    ) -> Result<CompileOutput, CompileError>;
}

pub struct CompileInput {
    pub repository_facts: RepositoryFacts,
    pub adapter_manifest: AdapterManifest,
    pub schema_registry: SchemaRegistry,
    pub domain_packs: Vec<DomainPack>,
    pub overlay_packs: Vec<OverlayPack>,
    pub options: CompileOptions,
}

pub struct CompileOutput {
    pub repository: SemanticRepository,
    pub graph: SemanticGraph,
    pub diagnostics: Vec<Diagnostic>,
    pub instrumentation_plan: InstrumentationPlan,
    pub artifact_manifest: ArtifactManifest,
}
```

---

## 4. Repository Facts

Adapter不得直接生成最终认证IR。

先生成较低层Facts：

```rust
pub enum RepositoryFact {
    Component(ComponentFact),
    StateDeclaration(StateDeclarationFact),
    StateRead(StateReadFact),
    StateWrite(StateWriteFact),
    Function(FunctionFact),
    Effect(EffectFact),
    Route(RouteFact),
    EventBinding(EventBindingFact),
    PlatformCall(PlatformCallFact),
    Layout(LayoutFact),
    Capability(CapabilityFact),
    SourceMap(SourceMapFact),
}
```

原因：

```text
保留源框架事实
便于重新编译
便于Adapter升级
便于规则解释
避免Adapter自行决定所有语义
```

---

## 5. Semantic Graph

```rust
pub struct SemanticGraph {
    pub nodes: BTreeMap<SemanticId, SemanticNode>,
    pub edges: Vec<SemanticEdge>,
    pub indexes: SemanticIndexes,
}

pub enum SemanticEdgeKind {
    Contains,
    Reads,
    Writes,
    DerivesFrom,
    Triggers,
    Emits,
    Receives,
    NavigatesTo,
    CallsCapability,
    Owns,
    Provides,
    Consumes,
    Persists,
    Restores,
    SupportsInvariant,
}
```

使用：

```text
BTreeMap
稳定排序
确定性序列化
```

避免使用会导致输出顺序不稳定的数据结构。

---

## 6. 稳定ID算法

输入：

```text
框架
模块路径
语义实体类型
逻辑符号路径
显式业务Key
```

生成：

```text
state://checkout/cart/items
effect://checkout/recalculate-total
```

若匿名闭包无稳定名称：

```text
使用父级稳定ID
+ 语义角色
+ 结构化局部序号
```

局部序号必须基于AST语义顺序，不能基于字节偏移。

---

## 7. 类型检查

必须处理：

```text
Null
Undefined
Missing
Optional
Union
Generic容器
Decimal
DateTime
Opaque平台对象
Resource Handle
```

错误示例：

```text
FEV-TYPE-0017:
金额字段被推断为float，而Domain Pack要求decimal。
```

---

## 8. 数据流分析

至少建立：

```text
状态写入者
状态读取者
派生值依赖
Effect依赖
事件到状态
路由参数到状态
平台返回值到状态
```

输出：

```yaml
dataflow:
  state://checkout/order/total:
    writers:
      - effect://checkout/recalculate-total
    readers:
      - ui://checkout/total-label
      - capability://payment/create-intent
```

---

## 9. Effect分析

识别：

```text
初次执行
依赖变化
资源获取
资源释放
并发方式
请求取消
旧结果策略
```

不能确定时：

```yaml
concurrency:
  mode: unknown

semanticLoss:
  level: unknown
```

关键语义未知必须阻断高等级认证。

---

## 10. 编译器诊断

```rust
pub struct Diagnostic {
    pub code: String,
    pub severity: Severity,
    pub message: String,
    pub source_maps: Vec<SourceMap>,
    pub semantic_ids: Vec<SemanticId>,
    pub remediation: Option<String>,
}
```

级别：

```text
Info
Warning
Error
Blocking
```

---

## 11. 确定性要求

同一输入必须满足：

```text
Semantic IR字节完全一致
Semantic Graph哈希一致
Instrumentation Plan一致
诊断排序一致
```

测试：

```text
compile(input) == compile(input)
compile(shuffled_facts) == compile(original_facts)
```

# Skill FEV-802：Framework Adapter SDK

建议路径：

```text
skills/framework-adapter-sdk/SKILL.md
```

## 1. Adapter职责

Adapter负责：

```text
识别项目
扫描源文件
调用框架Parser
生成Repository Facts
生成源码位置
提供Instrumentation能力
启动框架运行时
捕获框架专项观测
应用框架专项Mutation
```

不负责：

```text
决定最终发布
修改Evidence结果
跳过不支持语义
自行忽略差异
```

---

## 2. Adapter Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AdapterManifest

metadata:
  name: vue3-semantic-adapter
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  framework: vue3

  protocol:
    version: 1.0.0

  capabilities:
    - repository-scan
    - semantic-facts
    - source-instrumentation
    - runtime-observation
    - mutation-materialization

  supportedVersions:
    - ">=3.0 <4.0"

  parserBackends:
    - vue-sfc
    - typescript
    - javascript
```

---

## 3. JSON-RPC方法

```text
adapter.initialize
adapter.detect
adapter.scan
adapter.extractFacts
adapter.createInstrumentationPlan
adapter.instrument
adapter.startRuntime
adapter.executeAction
adapter.captureObservation
adapter.injectFault
adapter.applyMutation
adapter.revertMutation
adapter.shutdown
```

---

## 4. 初始化

请求：

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "adapter.initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "1.0.0",
    "workspace": "/workspace/source",
    "artifactDirectory": "/workspace/artifacts",
    "options": {
      "readOnlySource": true
    }
  }
}
```

响应：

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "adapter": "vue3-semantic-adapter",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "capabilities": [
      "repository-scan",
      "semantic-facts"
    ]
  }
}
```

---

## 5. 插件进程隔离

Adapter必须运行在独立进程。

默认权限：

```text
读取指定仓库
写入指定Artifact目录
访问临时目录
禁止访问其他路径
禁止未声明网络
禁止读取Secret
```

网络访问必须通过显式Capability授权。

---

## 6. Adapter错误类型

```text
UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
PARSE_ERROR
BUILD_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
INSTRUMENTATION_ERROR
RUNTIME_START_ERROR
ACTION_UNSUPPORTED
OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE
MUTATION_UNSUPPORTED
PROTOCOL_ERROR
INTERNAL_ERROR
```

Adapter不得把：

```text
不支持
解析失败
无法观测
```

转换为空结果。

---

## 7. Source Map协议

```ts
interface AdapterSourceMap {
  file: string;
  start: {
    line: number;
    column: number;
  };
  end: {
    line: number;
    column: number;
  };
  symbol?: string;
  parserNodeId?: string;
}
```

行列统一：

```text
1-based line
0-based column
UTF-16或Unicode标度必须在Manifest中声明
```

---

## 8. Instrumentation策略

优先级：

```text
构建插件注入
AST安全改写
运行时Wrapper
依赖注入
测试环境代理
```

禁止优先：

```text
脆弱字符串替换
修改框架核心包
依赖未公开内部全局变量
```

---

# Skill FEV-809：Differential Runtime Engine

建议路径：

```text
skills/differential-runtime-engine/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

同时控制源和目标运行环境，执行同一场景，并比较可观察结果。

```text
Scenario Instance
       │
       ├── Source Runtime Session
       └── Target Runtime Session
                    │
                    ▼
            Lockstep Execution
                    │
                    ▼
             Checkpoint Capture
                    │
                    ▼
             Normalization
                    │
                    ▼
              Comparison
                    │
                    ▼
             Difference Record
```

---

## 2. Runtime Session接口

```rust
#[async_trait]
pub trait RuntimeSession {
    async fn initialize(
        &mut self,
        context: RuntimeContext,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;

    async fn apply_initial_state(
        &mut self,
        state: StateSnapshot,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;

    async fn execute(
        &mut self,
        action: ScenarioAction,
    ) -> Result<ActionResult, RuntimeError>;

    async fn wait_until(
        &mut self,
        condition: WaitCondition,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;

    async fn observe(
        &mut self,
        request: ObservationRequest,
    ) -> Result<ObservationBundle, RuntimeError>;

    async fn shutdown(
        &mut self,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>;
}
```

---

## 3. 确定性环境

统一控制：

```text
时间
随机数
网络
服务Fixtures
用户身份
权限
语言
时区
主题
屏幕尺寸
设备能力
Feature Flags
```

```rust
pub struct DeterministicEnvironment {
    pub clock: ControlledClock,
    pub random_seed: u64,
    pub network: NetworkFixturePlan,
    pub identity: IdentityFixture,
    pub permissions: PermissionFixture,
    pub locale: String,
    pub timezone: String,
    pub screen: ScreenProfile,
}
```

---

## 4. 执行模式

### Strict Lockstep

```text
源执行一步
目标执行一步
双方稳定
捕获检查点
比较
```

适合：

```text
关键R4/R5场景
短流程
状态机测试
```

### Asynchronous Lockstep

```text
双方执行同一意图
等待各自语义稳定条件
比较
```

适合：

```text
动画
网络
不同平台渲染时序
```

### Trace Replay

```text
源系统真实轨迹
→ 标准化Action
→ 目标重放
```

适合影子和历史会话。

---

## 5. 稳定条件

```text
网络空闲
动画完成
指定状态成立
页面路由稳定
渲染帧完成
无待处理平台回调
```

禁止使用统一固定睡眠替代所有稳定检测。

---

## 6. Observation Channels

```text
semantic-tree
layout-tree
visual
state
navigation
network
storage
database
file
platform-call
permission
identity
payment
sharing
lifecycle
gesture
focus
keyboard
performance
error
```

---

## 7. Comparator接口

```rust
pub trait ObservationComparator {
    fn channel(&self) -> ObservationChannel;

    fn compare(
        &self,
        source: &Observation,
        target: &Observation,
        policy: &ComparisonPolicy,
    ) -> ComparisonResult;
}
```

---

## 8. 比较器

```text
SemanticTreeComparator
LayoutComparator
VisualComparator
StateComparator
NavigationComparator
NetworkComparator
SideEffectComparator
LifecycleComparator
GestureComparator
PerformanceComparator
```

---

## 9. 规范化顺序

```text
Raw Observation
→ Platform Adapter Normalization
→ Framework Normalization
→ Directional Normalization
→ Domain Normalization
→ Comparison
```

每次规范化必须记录：

```yaml
normalizationTrace:
  - rule: normalize://flutter/generated-semantics-id
    beforeHash: ...
    afterHash: ...
```

---

## 10. 差异分类

Runtime只负责初步分类：

```text
exact-difference
threshold-difference
missing-observation
observation-error
environment-mismatch
normalization-applied
```

最终：

```text
target-regression
source-bug
intentional-change
approved-degradation
unresolved
```

由后续Triager结合证据判断。

---

## 11. 失败最小化

当场景失败时，自动尝试：

```text
删除无关步骤
缩短输入
减少状态字段
降低设备矩阵
固定随机Seed
最小化请求Fixture
```

生成Minimal Counterexample。

---

## 12. 并行安全

可以并行不同Scenario Instance。

同一Scenario中的源目标必须：

```text
隔离存储
隔离端口
隔离用户
隔离Fixture
隔离Artifact目录
```

## 1. Rule Engine职责

```text
加载Rule Packs

索引规则
匹配Semantic Graph
生成Finding
生成Scenario Requirement
生成Mutation Requirement
生成Evidence Requirement
生成Release Constraint
```

---

## 2. Rule编译

```text
Rule YAML
→ Schema Validation
→ FEV-Expr Parse
→ Type Check
→ Selector Compile
→ Index Planning
→ Rule Bytecode/Plan
```

---

## 3. 索引

按以下字段建立索引：

```text
entityKind
framework
annotation
source API
target API
risk
domain
capability
lifecycle phase
state scope
```

避免每条规则遍历完整Semantic Graph。

```rust
pub struct RuleIndexes {
    pub by_entity_kind: HashMap<EntityKind, Vec<RuleId>>,
    pub by_annotation: HashMap<String, Vec<RuleId>>,
    pub by_capability: HashMap<CapabilityId, Vec<RuleId>>,
    pub by_domain: HashMap<DomainId, Vec<RuleId>>,
}
```

索引可以使用HashMap，但最终输出必须稳定排序。

---

## 4. Rule执行结果

```rust
pub struct RuleFinding {
    pub rule_id: RuleId,
    pub status: FindingStatus,
    pub severity: Severity,
    pub matched_entities: Vec<SemanticId>,
    pub message: String,
    pub source_maps: Vec<SourceMap>,
    pub generated_requirements: GeneratedRequirements,
}
```

状态：

```text
pass
fail
not-applicable
unknown
manual-review
```

---

## 5. 更严格规则合并

约束合并示例：

```text
通用规则：
视觉误差 <= 3px

Domain规则：
支付按钮位置误差 <= 1px

项目规则：
支付按钮不得被遮挡
```

合并结果：

```text
<= 1px
且
不得被遮挡
```

不能采用最后写入覆盖。

---

## 6. Rule冲突

冲突示例：

```text
Rule A要求目标状态为组件级
Rule B要求同一状态为应用级
```

输出：

```text
FEV-RULE-CONFLICT-0008
```

Blocking规则冲突必须在运行前解决。

---

## 7. FEV-Expr解释器

必须：

```text
纯函数
无网络
无文件
无动态代码
有执行步数限制
有内存限制
```

```rust
pub struct ExprLimits {
    pub max_ast_nodes: usize,
    pub max_collection_items: usize,
    pub max_evaluation_steps: u64,
    pub max_string_length: usize,
}
```

---

## 8. Rule Coverage

Rule Engine生成：

```yaml
ruleCoverage:
  blockingRules: 326
  rulesWithPositiveScenario: 326
  rulesWithNegativeScenario: 326
  rulesWithMutation: 326
  rulesWithClaim: 326
```

任何Blocking Rule覆盖不完整：

```text
RULE_NOT_CERTIFIABLE
```

## 3. 隔离方式

```text
Git worktree
或
Overlay filesystem
```

每个Mutation Instance必须具有独立：

```text
源码目录
依赖缓存写层
构建目录
测试结果目录
```

不允许多个变异共享可写构建产物。

## 4. Materializer注册表

```text
Semantic IR Materializer
Vue 2 AST Materializer
Vue 3 AST Materializer
React AST Materializer
Mini Program AST Materializer
ArkUI AST Materializer
Flutter AST Materializer
Runtime Fault Materializer
Environment Fault Materializer
```

## 5. 应用验证

变异后必须确认：

```text
AST发生预期变化
Semantic IR发生预期变化
无额外意外修改
变异位置唯一或明确
```

生成：

```yaml
mutationVerification:
  operator: mutation://react/remove-effect-cleanup
  expectedChange:
    cleanupRemoved: true
  unrelatedChanges: 0
```

---

## 6. 编译失败分类

变异导致编译失败时：

```text
若操作符目标是语义缺陷而非语法缺陷：
→ invalid mutation

若操作符明确测试构建防御：
→ killed by build
```

不能把所有编译失败都计为成功杀死。

---


禁止：

```text
对关键变异只运行随机测试子集
```

## 8. 等价变异流程

```text
自动静态分析
→ 对照编译
→ 运行扩大场景
→ 人工复核
→ equivalent-confirmed
```

模型只能提供建议，不能最终确认关键等价变异。

## 2. 通用Fixture语义

执行：

```text
组件身份稳定
无多余网络
无错误
```

类似Smoke Test覆盖全部30个方向。

# 五、30个验证器的代码组织

30个验证器只包含配置和规则，不包含重复引擎。

示例：

```text
validators/vue3-to-flutter/
├── manifest.yaml
├── rules/
│   ├── state.yaml
│   ├── effects.yaml
│   ├── component-identity.yaml
│   ├── lifecycle.yaml
│   ├── navigation.yaml
│   ├── layout.yaml
│   ├── gestures.yaml
│   └── platform.yaml
├── mutations/
│   ├── state.yaml
│   ├── effects.yaml
│   └── lifecycle.yaml
├── scenarios/
│   ├── state.yaml
│   ├── lifecycle.yaml
│   └── navigation.yaml
├── normalization/
├── capability-map.yaml
└── evidence-requirements.yaml
```

Manifest：

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ValidatorManifest

metadata:
  name: vue3-to-flutter-validator
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  sourceAdapter:
    id: vue3-semantic-adapter
    version: 1.0.0

  targetAdapter:
    id: flutter-semantic-adapter
    version: 1.0.0

  rulePacks:
    - rules/state.yaml
    - rules/effects.yaml
    - rules/lifecycle.yaml

  mutationPacks:
    - mutations/state.yaml
    - mutations/lifecycle.yaml

  scenarioPacks:
    - scenarios/state.yaml
    - scenarios/navigation.yaml
```

# 六、代码生成

Schema和IR生成SDK：

```text
Rust Types
TypeScript Types
Dart Types
JSON Schema
CUE Definitions
Documentation
```

命令：

```text
fev codegen schemas \
  --rust crates/fev-types/src/generated \
  --typescript packages/adapter-sdk-ts/src/generated \
  --dart dart/adapter_sdk/lib/generated
```

禁止手工维护三套结构定义。

生成文件头：

```text
DO NOT EDIT
Generated from Semantic IR Schema v1alpha1
```

# 七、CLI工作流

## 7.1 提取IR

```bash
fev ir extract \
  --framework vue3 \
  --repository ./source \
  --out .fev/source-ir
```

## 7.2 编译验证器

```bash
fev validator compile \
  --validator vue3-to-flutter \
  --source-ir .fev/source-ir \
  --target-ir .fev/target-ir \
  --domain ecommerce-payment \
  --out .fev/compiled
```

## 7.3 静态规则

```bash
fev rules run \
  --plan .fev/compiled/rule-plan.json
```

## 7.4 差分场景

```bash
fev diff run \
  --plan .fev/compiled/scenario-plan.json \
  --source-runtime source \
  --target-runtime target
```

## 7.5 变异

```bash
fev mutation run \
  --plan .fev/compiled/mutation-plan.json \
  --workers 4
```

## 7.6 Evidence

```bash
fev evidence assemble \
  --run-dir .fev/runs/run-001 \
  --out .fev/evidence
```

# 八、端到端代码执行示例

## 8.1 Vue 3源代码

```ts
watch(
  () => productId.value,
  async (id, _, onCleanup) => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    onCleanup(() => controller.abort());

    product.value = await loadProduct(
      id,
      controller.signal,
    );
  },
  {
    immediate: true,
  },
);
```

## 8.2 Vue 3 Adapter Facts

```yaml
facts:
  - kind: EffectFact
    id: fact://product/load-watch

    trigger:
      dependency: productId

    initialRun: true

    concurrency:
      cancellationDetected: true

    writes:
      - product

    platformCalls:
      - network
```

## 8.3 Semantic IR

```yaml
id: effect://product/load

trigger:
  kind: dependency-change
  dependencies:
    - state://product/id
  initialRun: true

concurrency:
  mode: latest-wins
  cancellation: required
  staleResultPolicy: discard

writes:
  - state://product/data
```

## 8.4 Rule Engine

匹配：

```text
latest-wins Effect
```

要求Flutter目标：

```text
可取消Future
或
generation token
或
switch-latest流
```

## 8.5 Mutation Engine

生成：

```text
删除Flutter目标请求取消逻辑
```

## 8.6 Differential Runtime

执行：

```text
打开Product A
立即切换Product B
让A请求晚于B返回
```

断言：

```text
最终显示Product B
```

## 8.7 Evidence

```text
正向差分通过
变异被杀死
Android真机通过
iOS真机通过
```

形成：

```text
Claim：latest-request-wins
→ E3/E4 Evidence
```

## 12.3 Mutation安全

变异只能发生在：

```text

或
Overlay文件系统
```

不得修改用户原始工作目录。

# Batch 9：六种Runtime Instrumentation、设备实验室、网络/时间/权限虚拟化、视觉与Semantic Tree差分及生产Shadow Agent实现Skills

## 一、Batch 9总体目标

Batch 9负责解决最后一个关键问题：

```text
Vue 2 Runtime ─────────────┐

React Runtime ─────────────┤

                ┌────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐
                ▼                        ▼                         ▼
       Environment Virtualization   Device Laboratory      Production Shadow
                │                        │                         │
                └────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┘
                                         ▼
                      Visual / Semantic / State / Effect Diff
                                         │
                                         ▼
                              Evidence Graph与E1-E5
```

Batch 9必须实现：

```text
1. 六种运行时Instrumentation；
2. 统一Runtime Probe Protocol；
3. 网络、时间、随机数、权限和平台能力虚拟化；
4. 浏览器、微信客户端、HarmonyOS、Android和iOS设备实验室；
5. Visual Differential Engine；
6. Semantic Tree Differential Engine；
7. 生产Shadow Agent；
8. 影子副作用安全隔离；
9. 运行时探针对被测系统影响的定量验证；
10. 所有运行结果进入Evidence Graph。
```

# Skill FEV-900：Runtime Probe Protocol

建议路径：

```text
skills/runtime-probe-protocol/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

定义所有运行时探针必须遵守的统一事件、命令、快照、错误和版本协议。

六个Runtime Adapter可以内部实现不同，但输出必须进入统一协议。

---

## 2. Probe运行模式

```text
STATIC_ONLY
TEST_INSTRUMENTED
DEVICE_INSTRUMENTED
SHADOW_OBSERVE_ONLY
SHADOW_DUAL_EXECUTION
PRODUCTION_MINIMAL
```

定义：

### STATIC_ONLY

不启动运行时，只使用Batch 8静态分析结果。

### TEST_INSTRUMENTED

允许高粒度状态、生命周期和组件事件。

### DEVICE_INSTRUMENTED

在模拟器或真机上运行专用测试构建。

### SHADOW_OBSERVE_ONLY

生产系统只记录脱敏操作意图和关键状态，不在客户端执行目标系统。

### SHADOW_DUAL_EXECUTION

在隔离环境对真实输入进行源目标双执行。

### PRODUCTION_MINIMAL

只允许低开销、低基数、经过隐私审查的遥测。

---

## 3. Probe Event Envelope

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RuntimeEvent

metadata:
  eventId: evt-019283
  runtimeSessionId: runtime-source-001
  scenarioInstanceId: checkout-payment-001
  side: source

spec:
  sequence: 182
  eventType: state.transaction.committed

  timestamp:
    monotonicNs: 82487127634
    controlledWallTime: "2026-07-30T09:53:00+08:00"

  causality:
    traceId: trace-001
    spanId: span-183
    parentSpanId: span-181
    actionId: action-step-4
    transactionId: state-tx-28
    correlationId: order-1001

  semantic:
    entityId: operation://checkout/recalculate-total

  payload: {}

  sourceMap:
    file: src/checkout/store.ts
    line: 82
    column: 4
```

---

## 4. 必备关联ID

```text
runtimeSessionId
scenarioInstanceId
traceId
spanId
parentSpanId
actionId
transactionId
requestId
resourceId
componentInstanceId
routeInstanceId
correlationId
```

用途：

```text
actionId
→ 将用户操作与后续状态、网络、导航和副作用关联

transactionId
→ 将一次原子状态提交中的多个字段关联

componentInstanceId
→ 验证组件身份与生命周期

correlationId
→ 关联订单、支付、设备命令等领域操作
```

---

## 5. 事件顺序

每个运行时会话必须维护单调递增：

```text
sequence
```

不能只使用墙上时钟排序，因为：

```text
不同设备时钟可能不一致
时间可能被虚拟化
系统时钟可能回拨
多个线程事件可能具有相同时间
```

统一排序：

```text
runtimeSessionId
→ sequence
```

跨运行时因果关系使用：

```text
actionId
requestId
correlationId
controlledWallTime
```

---

## 6. 标准事件命名

遥测字段采用稳定命名空间：

```text
fev.runtime.*
fev.component.*
fev.state.*
fev.effect.*
fev.lifecycle.*
fev.navigation.*
fev.ui.*
fev.input.*
fev.network.*
fev.storage.*
fev.platform.*
fev.permission.*
fev.identity.*
fev.payment.*
fev.performance.*
fev.error.*
```

OpenTelemetry的语义约定强调对Span、Metric、Log、Event使用共同名称、类型和含义，以便跨代码库及平台关联数据；Batch 9沿用这一思想，但将前端迁移专用字段放在独立`fev.*`命名空间中。

---

## 7. 标准事件类型

### Runtime

```text
runtime.session.started
runtime.session.ready
runtime.session.stabilized
runtime.session.failed
runtime.session.stopped
```

### Component

```text
component.instance.created
component.instance.mounted
component.instance.updated
component.instance.deactivated
component.instance.reactivated
component.instance.destroyed
component.instance.reused
component.instance.reset
```

### State

```text
state.read
state.write.requested
state.transaction.started
state.transaction.committed
state.transaction.rejected
state.snapshot.captured
state.persistence.requested
state.persistence.completed
state.restored
```

### Effect

```text
effect.scheduled
effect.started
effect.cancelled
effect.cleaned
effect.completed
effect.failed
effect.stale-result-discarded
effect.stale-result-applied
```

### Navigation

```text
navigation.push
navigation.replace
navigation.pop
navigation.pop-to
navigation.clear
navigation.tab-switched
navigation.external-entry
navigation.stack-restored
navigation.snapshot.captured
```

### Input

```text
input.pointer.down
input.pointer.move
input.pointer.up
input.pointer.cancel
input.gesture.recognized
input.focus.changed
input.keyboard.shown
input.keyboard.hidden
input.ime.composition-started
input.ime.composition-updated
input.ime.composition-ended
```

### Platform

```text
platform.call.started
platform.call.completed
platform.call.failed
platform.event.received
platform.subscription.started
platform.subscription.cancelled
```

## 8. Snapshot协议

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RuntimeSnapshot

metadata:
  snapshotId: snap-001
  sessionId: source-001

spec:
  checkpoint: after-step-4

  channels:
    state:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/state

    componentTree:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/components

    semanticTree:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/semantics

    layoutTree:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/layout

    navigation:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/navigation

    visual:
      artifactRef: artifact://snap/screenshot
```

## 9. Probe命令

```text
probe.initialize
probe.start
probe.pause
probe.resume
probe.setContext
probe.beginAction
probe.endAction
probe.captureSnapshot
probe.flush
probe.health
probe.stop
```

虚拟化命令：

```text
environment.setClock
environment.advanceClock
environment.setRandomSeed
environment.setNetworkProfile
environment.setPermissions
environment.setIdentity
environment.setStorage
environment.injectFault
```

---

## 10. Backpressure

探针不得因事件过多阻塞被测UI线程。

缓冲策略：

```yaml
buffer:
  memoryLimitBytes: 8388608
  strategy: bounded-ring-buffer

  overflow:
    criticalEvents: block-and-fail-run
    normalEvents: spill-to-disk
    debugEvents: sample
```

关键事件不得被静默丢弃：

```text
支付
权限
导航
组件销毁
错误
副作用
状态事务提交
```

---

# Skill FEV-901：Runtime Instrumentation Governor

建议路径：

```text
skills/runtime-instrumentation-governor/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

保证Instrumentation本身不会显著改变被测系统行为。

必须验证：

```text
功能不被改变
事件顺序不被改变
异步竞态不被掩盖
内存不显著增加
帧性能不显著恶化
生产最小探针不泄露敏感数据
```

---

## 2. 探针构建档位

```yaml
instrumentation_profiles:
  full-test:
    stateReads: true
    stateWrites: true
    componentLifecycle: true
    semanticSnapshots: true
    visualSnapshots: true
    networkBodies: fixture-governed

  device-test:
    stateReads: sampled
    stateWrites: true
    componentLifecycle: true
    semanticSnapshots: true

  shadow:
    stateReads: false
    domainTransitions: true
    sideEffectIntents: true
    semanticSnapshots: critical-only

  production-minimal:
    stateReads: false
    rawInput: false
    domainTransitions: sampled
    errors: true
    performance: sampled
```

---

## 3. 探针开销预算

```yaml
overhead_budget:
  test_build:
    maximumCpuOverheadPercent: 20
    maximumMemoryOverheadPercent: 20

  shadow_build:
    maximumCpuOverheadPercent: 5
    maximumMemoryOverheadPercent: 5
    maximumP95InteractionIncreasePercent: 5

  production_minimal:
    maximumCpuOverheadPercent: 2
    maximumMemoryOverheadPercent: 2
```

具体阈值应由项目风险和设备等级配置。

---

## 4. 探针对照实验

每个运行时必须执行：

```text
无探针Baseline
vs
启用探针
```

比较：

```text
测试结果
网络请求
状态终值
导航栈
副作用数量
帧时间
内存
启动时间
```

硬门槛：

```text
任何关键功能差异
→ Instrumentation无效

探针使竞态消失或出现
→ Instrumentation无效
```

---

## 5. 禁止依赖私有内部结构

探针优先使用：

```text
公开插件接口
公开生命周期
构建期AST变换
应用级Wrapper
测试框架
外部黑盒自动化
```

避免将以下作为唯一证据：

```text
未公开Fiber字段
未公开Vue内部实例字段
编译器私有AST结构
运行时私有全局变量
```

---

Web侧可使用浏览器Context路由拦截、API Mock和HAR类重放；Playwright能够监控、修改、阻断HTTP/HTTPS请求，并模拟离线状态。

## 1. 总体架构

```text
Application
    │
Network Gateway / Test Proxy
    │
    ├── Fixture Response
    ├── Recorded Response
    ├── Fault Injection
    ├── Shadow Endpoint
    └── Real Allowed Endpoint
```

---

## 2. 网络模式

```text
REAL
RECORD
REPLAY
SCRIPTED
FAULT_INJECTION
SHADOW
BLOCK_ALL
ALLOWLIST
```

---

## 3. Network Profile

```yaml
apiVersion: fev.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: NetworkProfile

metadata:
  name: slow-intermittent

spec:
  connectivity: online

  latency:
    baseMs: 400
    jitterMs: 100

  bandwidth:
    downKbps: 512
    upKbps: 128

  packet:
    lossPercent: 3
    duplicatePercent: 0
    reorderPercent: 2

  dns:
    delayMs: 100

  transitions:
    - at: 10s
      connectivity: offline

    - at: 15s
      connectivity: online
```

不能假设所有应用流量都可以透明中间人代理。


# Skill FEV-911：Time、Random与Scheduler Virtualization

建议路径：

```text
skills/time-random-scheduler-virtualization/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

控制：

```text
当前时间
单调时间
时区
定时器
延时任务
动画时间
随机数
重试退避
Token过期
缓存过期
```

---

## 2. 双时钟模型

```text
Controlled Wall Clock
Monotonic Scheduler Clock
```

墙上时间用于：

```text
日期
Token过期
业务日切
时区
```

单调时间用于：

```text
超时
动画
持续时间
性能
事件排序
```

不能混用。

---

## 3. Clock接口

```ts
interface ControlledClock {
  now(): Instant;
  monotonicNow(): Duration;
  sleep(duration: Duration): Promise<void>;
  schedule(task: ScheduledTask): TaskHandle;
  advance(duration: Duration): Promise<void>;
}
```

---

## 4. 虚拟化层次

### 应用层

优先注入：

```text
Clock
Scheduler
RandomSource
```

### JavaScript运行时

测试环境可控制：

```text
Date
定时器
部分调度任务
随机种子
```

但必须验证不会破坏框架自身调度。

### Native运行时

不能可靠替换整个操作系统时钟时，采用：

```text
业务Clock抽象
受控服务端时间
测试调度器
真实系统生命周期
```

---

## 5. 随机数

```yaml
random:
  algorithm: deterministic
  seed: 84192

  streams:
    ui: 100
    retry: 200
    fixture: 300
```

不同用途使用独立子流，防止新增一次UI随机调用改变网络重试序列。

## 6. 场景

```text
Token刚好过期
优惠券跨日失效

倒计时暂停

```

## 5. Reset等级

### Soft Reset

```text

清理应用数据
重启应用
```

### Application Reset

```text
卸载
安装
重置权限
清理测试账户
```

### Device Reset

```text
重启设备
恢复网络
恢复时区

```

### Full Reprovision

```text
设备重新配置
证书重新安装
自动化服务重建
```

Android端采用：


UI Automator适合应用外黑盒控制、系统设置、多窗口、截图及应用稳定等待。

## 3. 采集前校准

```text
屏幕尺寸
Pixel Ratio
方向
字体缩放
主题
语言
时区
系统栏
安全区
键盘状态
动画设置
颜色配置
```

## 4. 比较层次

### Level V1：Exact Pixel

适合：

```text
同浏览器
同设备
同渲染引擎
Golden Test
```

### Level V2：Perceptual Pixel

允许：

```text
抗锯齿
轻微字体栅格差异
颜色微差
```

### Level V3：Region Structure

比较：

```text
控件边界
相对位置
尺寸
间距
遮挡
```

### Level V4：Semantic Visual

比较：

```text
同一业务控件是否可见

```

```yaml
difference:
  id: visual-diff-101
  semanticTarget: ui://checkout/pay-button

  category: occlusion
  severity: blocking

  source:
    visiblePercent: 100

  target:

    targetImage: artifact://target.png
```


## 1. 统一Semantic Node

```ts
interface UnifiedSemanticNode {
  id?: string;
  runtimeId?: string;

  role: string;

  };

  bounds?: {
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };

  order: number;
  children: UnifiedSemanticNode[];
}
```

---

## 2. 源树

### Web

```text
DOM
ARIA
可访问性属性
可见性和边界
```

### 微信小程序

```text
可操作组件
文本
可访问属性
页面结构
运行时组件映射
```

### ArkUI

```text
ArkUI无障碍语义
UITest控件树
应用Semantic ID
```

### Flutter

```text
Semantics Tree
Widget Semantic ID映射
边界和Action
```

---

## 3. 规范化

允许：

```text
平台自动生成Runtime ID
容器性中间节点
无语义装饰节点
平台特有根节点
```

不得删除：

```text
Button
Link
Input
Dialog
Error
Selected State
Checked State
Disabled State
Focus Order
Action
```

---

## 4. 节点匹配顺序

```text
1. Semantic ID完全相同
2. 业务ID相同
3. Role + Name + 父语义路径
4. Role + Value + 邻接关系
5. 受限树编辑匹配
```

禁止仅按：

```text
节点索引
屏幕坐标
框架实例ID
```

匹配。

---

## 5. 差异分类

```text
NODE_MISSING
NODE_ADDED
ROLE_CHANGED
NAME_CHANGED
VALUE_CHANGED
STATE_CHANGED
ACTION_MISSING
FOCUS_ORDER_CHANGED
TREE_ORDER_CHANGED
BOUNDS_CHANGED
VISIBILITY_CHANGED
DUPLICATE_CONTROL
```

---

## 6. 关键门槛

```text
关键控件缺失
→ Blocking

按钮变成无动作文本
→ Blocking

禁用控件错误启用
→ Blocking

对话框焦点逃逸
→ Blocking

普通装饰节点层次不同
→ Informational或Approved
```

---

## 7. 跨树断言

```text
所有可见业务按钮必须具有可访问名称

所有错误信息必须位于对应输入或全局Alert范围

Modal打开后背景操作不得存在于可操作语义集合

焦点顺序必须覆盖所有关键表单字段

同一业务ID不得出现两个可操作控件
```

---

## 8. Tree Diff算法

```text
Canonicalize
→ Build Stable Semantic Paths
→ Exact ID Match
→ Business-Key Match
→ Role/Name Match
→ Constrained Tree Edit
→ Difference Classification
```

匹配必须有：

```text
最大搜索范围
相似度阈值
歧义检测
```

出现多个同分候选：

```text
AMBIGUOUS_MATCH
→ 不得静默选择
```
