建议路径：

```text
skills/cache-stampede-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证Cache命中、失效、并发刷新、Eviction和Stampede行为。

---

## 2. Cache性能指标

```text
Hit Rate
Miss Rate
Load Time
Value Size
Key Count
Eviction Rate
Stale Read Rate
Refresh Concurrency
```

---

## 3. Stampede场景

```text
热门Key同时过期
Cache节点重启
大量新Tenant启动
权限Cache失效
Pack Metadata集中刷新
```

---

## 4. 防护

```text
Single Flight
Distributed Lock候选
Jitter
Stale-While-Revalidate
Request Coalescing
Prewarming
```

---

## 5. Stampede正确性

防护不能导致：

```text
跨Tenant共享结果
无限Stale
权限撤销延迟
单点Lock阻塞
```

---

## 6. Cache容量

验证：

```text
最大Key
最大Value
Memory上限
Eviction策略
```

---

## 7. 热Key

检测单个Key造成：

```text
网络热点
单线程热点
Lock热点
```

---

## 8. 缓存失效风暴

批量配置或权限变化可能产生大量失效，需要限速和分批。

---

# Skill FRT-2713：Database Hotspot and Query Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/database-hotspot-query-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

发现慢Query、锁争用、热点行、热点索引和事务瓶颈。

---

## 2. Query Registry

每个关键Query绑定：

```text
Requirement
API
Expected Cardinality
Index
Latency Budget
Tenant Scope
```

---

## 3. 检测对象

```text
Full Scan
Missing Index
Over-Indexing
N+1
Large Sort
Hot Row
Lock Wait
Deadlock
Connection Wait
Long Transaction
```

---

## 4. 热点行

例如：

```text
全局Quota记录
单一计数器
单一Configuration行
```

可能成为并发瓶颈。

---

## 5. Tenant Hotspot

大Tenant不能通过共享索引布局拖慢所有Tenant候选。

---

## 6. Query Plan Regression

Release前比较：

```text
Plan
Rows
Cost
Index Usage
Execution Time
```

---

## 7. Transaction Boundaries

验证事务是否：

```text
过长
包含外部调用
锁住不必要记录
```

---

## 8. Pagination

大表使用：

```text
稳定Cursor
索引
明确排序
```

避免深Offset。

---

## 9. Write Amplification

检查：

```text
主表
索引
Outbox
Audit
Projection
```

写放大是否可接受。

---

## 10. Database Saturation

记录：

```text
CPU
IO
Buffer Hit
Lock
Connection
Replication Lag候选
```

---

# Skill FRT-2714：Connection Pool and Resource Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/connection-pool-resource-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证数据库、HTTP、消息、文件和线程资源池配置与释放。

---

## 2. Resource Pool

```text
Database Connections
HTTP Connections
Model Provider Connections
Queue Consumers
Threads
Processes
Device Sessions
File Handles
Temporary Disk
```

---

## 3. Pool Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResourcePoolContract

metadata:
  id: pool://database/control-plane

spec:
  limits:
    minimum: 10
    maximum: 100

  acquisition:
    timeout: policy://db-acquire-timeout

  health:
    validationQuery: enabled

  release:
    required: true
```

---

## 4. Pool耗尽行为

必须：

```text
有界等待
明确Timeout
不无限创建
不阻塞全部线程
```

---

## 5. Connection Leak

故障、取消和Timeout路径都需验证释放。

---

## 6. Pool Sizing

结合：

```text
Worker Concurrency
Transaction Duration
Database Capacity
```

计算，而非盲目增大。

---

## 7. Thread Pool

防止：

```text
Blocking Call占满异步Worker
无限任务提交
Priority Inversion
```

---

## 8. Temporary Disk

Build、Test和Artifact任务需限制临时磁盘，避免节点被写满。

---

## 9. Resource Isolation

不同Tenant和Job可使用：

```text
Quota
Namespace
Worker Pool
```

限制互相影响。

---

# Skill FRT-2715：Capacity Planning Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/capacity-planning-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

根据Workload、基准、SLO和冗余要求生成容量计划。

---

## 2. Capacity输入

```text
Normal Load
Peak Load
Growth Forecast
Failure Redundancy
Maintenance
Autoscaling Delay
Provider Limits
Data Growth
```

---

## 3. Capacity Plan Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: CapacityPlan

metadata:
  id: capacity://frt-platform/production

spec:
  horizon:
    months: 12

  workloads:
    - workload://migration-jobs/peak

  resources:
    controlPlane:
      replicas: policy-derived

    buildWorkers:
      minimum: policy-derived
      maximum: policy-derived

    proofWorkers:
      minimum: policy-derived
      maximum: policy-derived

  limits:
    maximumConcurrentMigrations: policy-derived
    maximumArtifactIngress: policy-derived

  headroom:
    requiredPercent: policy-derived
```

---

## 4. 容量类别

```text
Steady-State Capacity
Peak Capacity
Failure Capacity
Recovery Capacity
Batch Capacity
```

---

## 5. Headroom

必须定义安全余量，而非长期运行在接近饱和点。

---

## 6. Growth Forecast

考虑：

```text
用户增长
Repository规模增长
Artifact保留增长
Pack数量增长
历史Evidence增长
```

---

## 7. Provider Capacity

包括：

```text
模型Token
API Rate
设备池
代码托管API
Package Registry
```

---

## 8. 成本输出

容量计划附带：

```text
基础成本
峰值成本
单位Migration成本
扩容触发点
```

---

## 9. 容量风险

```text
Database First Bottleneck
Provider Quota
Artifact Storage
Device Pool
Proof Compute
```

---

# Skill FRT-2716：Autoscaling Policy Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/autoscaling-policy-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证Worker、服务和Consumer的扩缩容Policy是否及时、稳定且不会压垮下游。

---

## 2. Scaling对象

```text
API Service
Workflow Worker
Build Worker
Test Worker
Proof Worker
Event Consumer
Search Worker
```

---

## 3. Scaling信号

```text
CPU
Memory
Queue Depth
Oldest Message Age
Job Wait Time
Active Lease
Throughput
Provider Quota
```

---

## 4. Policy Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AutoscalingPolicy

metadata:
  id: autoscaling://build-workers

spec:
  minimumReplicas: policy-derived
  maximumReplicas: policy-derived

  scaleOut:
    signals:
      - queue-oldest-age
      - queue-depth

  scaleIn:
    cooldown: policy-derived
    requireNoActiveLease: true

  downstreamConstraints:
    databaseConnections:
      maximumAggregate: policy-derived
```

---

## 5. Scale-Out验证

测试：

```text
触发及时性
冷启动时间
新Worker就绪
任务重新分配
下游负载变化
```

---

## 6. Scale-In验证

缩容必须：

```text
Drain
等待Lease完成
保存Checkpoint
避免中断不可逆步骤
```

---

## 7. Thrashing

防止负载波动导致频繁扩缩容。

---

## 8. 下游Constraint

最大Worker数量受：

```text
Database
Object Store
Provider
Device Pool
```

容量限制。

---

## 9. Region和Trust Zone

敏感任务只能扩容到批准Pool。

---

# Skill FRT-2717：Graceful Degradation Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/graceful-degradation-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证资源不足或依赖异常时，系统能够安全降级并保留关键能力。

---

## 2. Degradation等级

```text
D0 Normal
D1 Reduced Non-Critical Features
D2 Queue New Heavy Work
D3 Read-Only / Limited Operations
D4 Critical Operations Only
D5 Safe Shutdown
```

---

## 3. Degradation Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DegradationPolicy

metadata:
  id: degradation://model-provider-limited

spec:
  trigger:
    - model-rate-limit-high

  disabled:
    - optional-documentation-generation
    - additional-candidate-generation

  preserved:
    - job-cancellation
    - artifact-download
    - security-operations
    - existing-proof-verification

  userExperience:
    message: model-capacity-limited
```

---

## 4. 可降级功能

候选：

```text
额外代码候选
非关键推荐
复杂KPI
可延迟报表
视觉预览
非关键Background Analysis
```

---

## 5. 不可降级控制

```text
Authentication
Authorization
Tenant Isolation
Audit
Idempotency
Payment Reconciliation
Device Safety
Certificate Integrity
```

---

## 6. Degradation触发

来自：

```text
Queue
Provider
Database
Storage
Worker Capacity
Security Incident
```

---

## 7. 降级入口

需要：

```text
明确状态
用户说明
功能矩阵
恢复条件
审计
```

---

## 8. 恢复

恢复正常服务时避免：

```text
队列瞬时释放
Retry Storm
Cache Stampede
```

应渐进恢复。

---

## 9. 业务优先级

R5 Reconciliation和取消操作优先于新建低优先级Migration。

---

# Skill FRT-2718：Performance Budget Governor

建议路径：

```text
skills/performance-budget-governor/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为每个服务、页面、任务和资源设定非补偿式性能预算。

---

## 2. Budget类型

```text
Latency
Throughput
Error Rate
Queue Age
CPU
Memory
Connection
Bundle Size
Startup
Artifact Size
```

---

## 3. Budget Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PerformanceBudget

metadata:
  id: budget://migration/job-status

spec:
  criticality: R3

  metrics:
    p95Latency:
      maximum: policy-derived

    errorRate:
      maximum: policy-derived

    queueAge:
      maximum: policy-derived

  enforcement:
    releaseGate: true
```

---

## 4. Budget层次

```text
Global
Business Line
Service
Endpoint
Journey
Platform
```

---

## 5. Budget分配

端到端延迟分配到：

```text
Gateway
Application
Database
Cache
External Provider
```

便于定位。

---

## 6. Budget变化

放宽Budget需要：

```text
原因
影响
产品批准
SRE批准
历史趋势
```

不能为了让Release通过而临时提高阈值。

---

## 7. 关键Budget

```text
Job Status
Cancel
Approval
Certificate Verify
Security Action
Payment Reconciliation
```

单独治理。

## 8. Budget趋势

持续观察性能逐版本小幅退化的累积效应。

# Skill FRT-2719：Performance and Capacity Certificate

建议路径：

```text
skills/performance-capacity-certificate/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为特定Release、环境、Workload和容量范围签发性能认证。

---

## 2. 认证等级

```text
PC0：Unprofiled
PC1：Baseline Measured
PC2：Target Load Passed
PC3：Concurrency and Stress Passed
PC4：Spike, Soak and Degradation Passed
PC5：Capacity and Autoscaling Certified
PC6：Continuously Re-Certified
```

---

## 3. Certificate Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PerformanceCapacityCertificate

metadata:
  id: certificate://performance/release-g27
  version: 1

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g27-candidate

  environment:
    ref: environment://performance-test
    digest: sha256

  workloads:
    - ref: workload://interactive-users/standard
    - ref: workload://migration-jobs/peak
    - ref: workload://event-processing/peak

  qualification:
    requested: PC5
    achieved: PC5

  results:
    concurrencyCorrectness: pass
    targetLoad: pass
    stress: pass
    spike: pass
    soak: pass
    autoscaling: pass
    degradation: pass

  capacity:
    safeConcurrentMigrations: policy-derived
    safeRequestRate: policy-derived
    headroom: policy-derived
```

---

## 4. 证书范围

必须声明：

```text
Workload
Data Size
Topology
Hardware
Provider Quota
Release
Configuration
Duration
```

不能把某环境测试结果泛化为所有环境。

---

## 5. 证书失效

以下变化使证书STALE：

```text
关键代码变化
Query变化
Cache变化
Worker资源变化
Autoscaling变化
Provider Limit变化
Workload增长
环境变化
```

---

## 6. Inconclusive

测试环境噪声、外部Provider异常或数据污染时，应标记：

```text
INCONCLUSIVE
```

而非通过。

---

# 六、统一Concurrency Scenario

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ConcurrencyScenario

metadata:
  id: concurrency-scenario://certificate/issue-revoke

spec:
  initial:
    certificateState: proposed
    version: 10

  actors:
    - issuer
    - security-reviewer

  operations:
    - actor: issuer
      command: issue-certificate
      expectedVersion: 10

    - actor: security-reviewer
      command: revoke-certificate
      expectedVersion: 10

  invariants:
    - one-valid-final-state
    - no-active-and-revoked-simultaneously
    - complete-audit
```

---

# 七、统一Load Test Plan

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: LoadTestPlan

metadata:
  id: load-test://frt-platform/peak

spec:
  workload:
    ref: workload://migration-jobs/peak

  phases:
    - name: warmup
      duration: 10m
      loadPercent: 20

    - name: steady
      duration: 60m
      loadPercent: 100

    - name: peak
      duration: 20m
      loadPercent: 150

    - name: recovery
      duration: 20m
      loadPercent: 20

  correctness:
    requiredAssertions:
      - no-duplicate-effective-job
      - no-cross-tenant-data
      - no-invalid-job-state

  metrics:
    - api-latency
    - queue-age
    - worker-utilization
    - database-connections
```

# 十一、G27 CLI

## 注册Workload

```bash
frt performance workload register \
  --file .frt/workloads/migration-peak.yaml
```

---

## 生成Workload

```bash
frt performance workload generate \
  --project frt-platform \
  --source production-traces \
  --anonymized
```

---

## 验证并发正确性

```bash
frt performance concurrency verify \
  --suite critical-business-operations
```

---

## 检测Race

```bash
frt performance race detect \
  --scenarios cancel-complete,approve-stale,account-switch
```

---

## 验证幂等

```bash
frt performance idempotency test \
  --operations payment,refund,delivery,certificate \
  --concurrency 100
```

---

## 运行Load

```bash
frt performance load run \
  --plan .frt/performance-capacity/load/plans/peak.yaml
```

---

## 运行Stress

```bash
frt performance stress run \
  --workload workload://migration-jobs/peak \
  --until saturation
```

---

## 运行Spike

```bash
frt performance spike run \
  --multiplier 10 \
  --rise-time 5s
```

---

## 运行Soak

```bash
frt performance soak run \
  --workload workload://platform/steady \
  --duration policy-defined
```

---

## 验证Queue

```bash
frt performance queue verify \
  --queues migration,build,test,proof,event
```

---

## 验证限流

```bash
frt performance rate-limit test \
  --scopes user,workspace,organization
```

---

## 验证Cache Stampede

```bash
frt performance cache stampede \
  --keys permission,job-status,pack-metadata
```

---

## 分析数据库

```bash
frt performance database analyze \
  --workload workload://migration-jobs/peak
```

---

## 验证连接池

```bash
frt performance resources verify \
  --pools database,http,event,model
```

---

## 生成容量计划

```bash
frt performance capacity plan \
  --horizon 12m \
  --growth-profile expected
```

---

## 验证Autoscaling

```bash
frt performance autoscaling verify \
  --policies .frt/performance-capacity/autoscaling/policies
```

---

## 验证降级

```bash
frt performance degradation test \
  --scenarios model-rate-limit,database-saturation,queue-overload
```

---

## 验证Budget

```bash
frt performance budget verify \
  --release release://g27-candidate
```

---

## 签发证书

```bash
frt performance certify \
  --release release://g27-candidate \
  --level PC5
```

# 十二、G27 Diagnostics

错误前缀：

```text
FRT-WORKLOAD
FRT-CONCURRENCY
FRT-RACE
FRT-IDEMPOTENCY-LOAD
FRT-THROUGHPUT
FRT-LOAD
FRT-STRESS
FRT-SPIKE
FRT-SOAK
FRT-QUEUE
FRT-BACKPRESSURE
FRT-RATE-LIMIT
FRT-CACHE-PERFORMANCE
FRT-DATABASE-PERFORMANCE
FRT-RESOURCE-POOL
FRT-CAPACITY
FRT-AUTOSCALING
FRT-DEGRADATION
FRT-PERFORMANCE-BUDGET
FRT-PERFORMANCE-CERT
```

示例：

```text
FRT-WORKLOAD-0012
Workload声明1000并发，
但没有定义业务操作比例和数据规模。

FRT-CONCURRENCY-0018
Cancel与Complete并发时产生两个终态Event。

FRT-CONCURRENCY-0021
同一Certificate同时处于Active和Revoked Projection。

FRT-RACE-0008
管理员更新Policy时发生Lost Update。

FRT-RACE-0014
旧账号请求在账号切换后提交到新账号Store。

FRT-IDEMPOTENCY-LOAD-0011
100个并发Delivery请求创建了3个Draft PR。

FRT-IDEMPOTENCY-LOAD-0017
相同Idempotency Key不同Payload被错误复用旧结果。

FRT-THROUGHPUT-0006
负载工具存在Coordinated Omission，
P99结果不可信。

FRT-LOAD-0013
目标负载下业务成功率符合要求，
但Payment Audit缺失。

FRT-STRESS-0007
Queue饱和后Producer仍无限提交任务。

FRT-STRESS-0019
系统进入Retry Storm并导致数据库崩溃。

FRT-SPIKE-0005
10倍流量Spike期间取消操作被非关键任务饿死。

FRT-SOAK-0016
运行8小时后数据库连接数持续增长且不回落。

FRT-QUEUE-0009
Proof Queue没有最大Depth和Age Policy。

FRT-BACKPRESSURE-0014
队列积压未反馈到Job创建入口。

FRT-RATE-LIMIT-0008
用户通过多个Session绕过Workspace级Quota。

FRT-CACHE-PERFORMANCE-0011
Permission Cache同时过期导致数据库请求放大500倍。

FRT-CACHE-PERFORMANCE-0018
Stampede防护错误地跨Tenant共享结果。

FRT-DATABASE-PERFORMANCE-0006
Job状态更新竞争单一热点行。

FRT-DATABASE-PERFORMANCE-0013
Critical Query在大Tenant下退化为Full Scan。

FRT-RESOURCE-POOL-0009
HTTP Timeout路径未释放数据库Connection。

FRT-CAPACITY-0015
扩容Build Worker后总连接需求超过数据库容量。

FRT-AUTOSCALING-0004
Scale-In终止了仍持有有效Lease的Worker。

FRT-AUTOSCALING-0017
CPU较低但Queue Age已超过业务SLO，未触发扩容。

FRT-DEGRADATION-0010
高负载降级模式关闭了Audit写入。

FRT-DEGRADATION-0018
恢复正常模式时瞬间释放积压任务，形成二次Spike。

FRT-PERFORMANCE-BUDGET-0007
为通过Release临时放宽P95 Budget，缺少审批。

FRT-PERFORMANCE-CERT-0002
并发正确性失败，无法签发PC5证书。
```

# 十五、G27安全与治理

## 15.1 性能环境隔离

压力测试不能默认运行在共享Production。

需要：

```text
独立环境
批准测试窗口
专用Sandbox
明确限流
Kill Switch
```

---

## 15.2 Production Testing

确需Production验证时，仅允许：

```text
低风险只读
Shadow
受控Canary
明确审批
```

---

## 15.3 Test Data

使用Synthetic或批准脱敏数据，不复制真实Secret和敏感记录。

---

## 15.4 DoS防护

性能测试工具本身必须有：

```text
Maximum Load
Abort Condition
Target Allowlist
Credential Scope
```

避免误伤其他系统。

---

## 15.5 高风险副作用

支付、退款、设备和能源操作仅使用：

```text
Sandbox
Fake
Simulation
```

真实验证另行治理。

---

## 15.6 性能结果不可伪造

禁止：

```text
删除失败样本
只报告成功请求
缩短测试时间
修改Workload但沿用旧名称
```

---

## 15.7 Budget修改

性能Budget变化必须审批并保留历史。

---

## 15.8 多租户公平性

验证Hot Tenant不会完全占用共享资源，使其他Tenant饥饿。

---

# 十六、G27实施顺序

建议顺序：

```text
1. FRT-2701 Workload Model Registry

2. FRT-2702 Concurrency Correctness Validator

3. FRT-2703 Race and Lost-Update Detector

4. FRT-2704 Idempotency Under Load Validator

5. FRT-2705 Throughput and Latency Test Generator

6. FRT-2710 Queue and Backpressure Validator

7. FRT-2711 Rate Limit and Quota Validator

8. FRT-2712 Cache Performance and Stampede Validator

9. FRT-2713 Database Hotspot and Query Validator

10. FRT-2714 Connection Pool and Resource Validator

11. FRT-2706 Load Test Coordinator

12. FRT-2707 Stress Test Coordinator

13. FRT-2708 Spike Test Coordinator

14. FRT-2709 Soak and Memory Leak Test Coordinator

15. FRT-2715 Capacity Planning Generator

16. FRT-2716 Autoscaling Policy Validator

17. FRT-2717 Graceful Degradation Validator

18. FRT-2718 Performance Budget Governor

19. FRT-2719 Performance and Capacity Certificate

20. FRT-2700 Performance and Capacity Orchestrator
```

必须先建立Workload和并发正确性模型，再进行吞吐和容量测试。否则可能只是在更高负载下快速地产生错误结果。

---

# 十七、G27阶段里程碑

## Milestone 1：Workload Foundation

完成：

```text
Interactive
Migration
Regression
Event
Artifact
Model
Admin
```

核心Workload。

---

## Milestone 2：Concurrency Correctness

消除：

```text
Race
Lost Update
Duplicate Effective Side Effect
Stale Commit
```

---

## Milestone 3：Queue、Rate Limit与Cache

建立有界负载和Backpressure。

---

## Milestone 4：Database与Resource

完成Query、Lock、Connection和资源池治理。

---

## Milestone 5：Target Load

所有关键Workload在正常和峰值负载下通过。

---

## Milestone 6：Stress与Spike

找到饱和点、失败模式和恢复能力。

---

## Milestone 7：Soak

消除资源泄漏和长期性能衰减。

---

## Milestone 8：Capacity与Autoscaling

形成12个月候选容量计划和扩缩容策略。

---

## Milestone 9：Graceful Degradation

验证超载和依赖不足下关键业务仍安全运行。

---

## Milestone 10：PC5 Certification

签发Performance and Capacity Certificate。

---

# 二十、G27完成后的系统状态

完成G27后，系统将从：

```text
全系统已经具备稳定、并行、可重复的回归资格认证
```

推进到：

```text
系统在声明的数据规模、并发用户、任务并发、
事件吞吐和长时间运行压力下，
仍能保持业务正确性、资源稳定性、
可预测延迟和安全降级能力。
```

系统能够确保：

```text
所有性能声明都基于明确Workload；

并发操作不会产生Lost Update和非法状态；

重复请求不会产生重复有效副作用；

目标负载和峰值负载下业务不变量仍成立；

超过容量时系统有界拒绝而不是级联崩溃；

Spike之后队列和延迟可以恢复；

Soak期间资源不会持续泄漏；

所有关键Queue都有界并具有Backpressure；

Rate Limit和Quota不会被多Session或多节点绕过；

Cache不会发生跨租户Stampede或权限Stale；

数据库热点、锁和慢Query得到治理；

连接池和临时资源不会无限增长；

容量计划考虑故障冗余、增长和外部Provider限制；

Autoscaling不会终止有效任务或压垮下游；

降级模式不会关闭权限、审计、幂等和安全控制；

每个Release携带明确Workload范围的PC级性能证书。
```

下一批 **Generation Batch G28** 将专门展开：

```text
Dependency Failure Model Registry
Timeout、Retry与Circuit Breaker
Bulkhead与故障隔离
Graceful Degradation Runtime
Queue Durability与Replay
Stateful Failover
Control Plane High Availability
Worker Pool High Availability
Artifact与Evidence Store Resilience
Database Failover
Region Failure
Chaos Engineering
Backup and Restore
Disaster Recovery Drill
RTO / RPO
Safe Mode / Read-Only Mode
Partial-Service Availability
Resilience Runbook
Resilience Certification
```

也就是从：

```text
系统在目标并发和压力下能够稳定运行
```

推进到：

```text
系统在服务、数据库、队列、Worker、存储、
Provider、设备和Region发生故障时，
仍能够隔离故障、保护数据、维持关键能力、
安全恢复并满足声明的RTO与RPO。
```

# Generation Batch G28：高可用、故障隔离、Chaos、灾难恢复与持续韧性认证 Skills

## 一、G28总体定位

G27已经完成：

```text
Workload Model
→ Concurrency Correctness
→ Load / Stress / Spike / Soak
→ Queue and Backpressure
→ Capacity Planning
→ Autoscaling
→ Graceful Degradation
→ Performance Certification
```

使系统能够在声明的：

```text
并发用户
任务并发
事件吞吐
数据规模
长时间运行压力
```

下保持业务正确性和资源稳定。

但性能稳定不等于故障韧性。

即使系统在正常压力下表现良好，仍可能因以下故障失去服务或破坏数据：

```text
数据库主节点故障；
消息队列暂时不可用；
Artifact Store写入失败；
Evidence Graph部分不可读；
Worker执行中宕机；
模型Provider大面积超时；
Git Provider限流或不可用；
Device Farm失联；
网络分区导致双主；
Region整体不可用；
备份存在但无法恢复；
Failover后重复执行副作用；
恢复后旧Worker继续提交过期结果；
降级状态关闭了关键审计；
只恢复数据库但丢失Artifact和Evidence；
RTO、RPO存在于文档中，却从未演练。
```

G28负责建立：

> 从依赖故障建模、Timeout、Retry、Circuit Breaker、Bulkhead、队列持久化、状态故障转移、控制面高可用、Worker高可用、Artifact和Evidence韧性、数据库和Region故障、Chaos、备份恢复、灾备演练、RTO/RPO、Safe Mode、Read-Only和Partial-Service Availability，到最终韧性认证的完整体系。

总体闭环：

```text
Dependency Inventory
        │
        ▼
Failure Model Registry
        │
        ├── Failure Detection
        ├── Timeout
        ├── Retry
        ├── Circuit Breaker
        ├── Bulkhead
        └── Degradation
        │
        ▼
Failure Containment
        │
        ├── Service Isolation
        ├── Queue Durability
        ├── Worker Failover
        ├── Stateful Failover
        └── Region Isolation
        │
        ▼
State Protection
        │
        ├── Database
        ├── Artifact
        ├── Evidence
        ├── Audit
        └── Certificate
        │
        ▼
Recovery
        │
        ├── Restart
        ├── Replay
        ├── Restore
        ├── Reconcile
        └── Re-Certify
        │
        ▼
Chaos and DR Drill
        │
        ▼
Resilience Certificate
```

# 二、G28最终目标

完成G28后，系统必须能够回答：

```text
每个关键依赖可能怎样失败？

故障如何被检测？

请求等待多久后超时？

哪些错误允许重试？

重试是否会扩大故障？

何时打开Circuit Breaker？

一个依赖故障能影响多少Tenant、Job和Worker？

关键队列中的消息会不会丢失？

Worker中途故障后从哪里恢复？

数据库Failover时是否会出现双写或旧主回归？

Artifact和Evidence损坏如何发现和修复？

Region故障时哪些服务可以切换？

哪些数据允许跨Region复制？

恢复顺序是什么？

恢复后如何处理重复Event和旧Lease？

备份是否真的可以恢复？

实际RTO和RPO是多少？

安全模式下哪些功能保留？

Read-Only模式是否仍可查询、审计和导出？

局部服务不可用时，平台是否还能完成关键操作？

故障恢复后，旧Certificate是否需要重新认证？
```

---

# 三、G28核心原则

## 3.1 高可用不是“所有组件都多副本”

真正的高可用需要：

```text
故障检测
状态Authority
Leader治理
数据复制
Failover
幂等
恢复
对账
```

仅增加副本可能产生：

```text
双主
重复消费
重复副作用
数据分叉
```

---

## 3.2 故障必须先建模，再设计恢复

不能只写：

```text
“数据库挂了就重试”
```

必须明确：

```text
数据库连接失败；
事务提交结果未知；
只读副本延迟；
主节点切换；
网络分区；
部分写入；
连接池污染；
```

这些故障具有不同业务语义。

---

## 3.3 Timeout必须端到端分配

如果上层Timeout为30秒，下层三个依赖各自Timeout 30秒，实际请求可能远超预算。

必须建立：

```text
End-to-End Deadline
→ Service Budget
→ Database Budget
→ Provider Budget
→ Retry Budget
```

---

## 3.4 Retry只能处理瞬态且幂等的故障

允许重试的前提：

```text
错误被识别为Transient；
操作具备Idempotency；
仍在Deadline内；
没有成功但响应丢失的业务风险；
Retry Budget未耗尽。
```

禁止自动重试：

```text
支付结果Unknown；
危险设备命令Unknown；
证书签发结果Unknown；
数据删除结果Unknown；
```

应先Reconcile。

---

## 3.5 Circuit Breaker保护系统，不保证业务成功

Circuit Breaker打开后：

```text
快速失败
使用Fallback
进入Queue
进入Safe Mode
```

但不能返回假成功。

---

## 3.6 Bulkhead限制故障半径

不同业务线、Tenant、任务类型和风险等级应具有隔离资源。

例如：

```text
Build Worker故障
不能阻止Certificate Revoke；

模型Provider过载
不能阻止Job Cancellation；

大Tenant事件积压
不能拖死其他Tenant。
```

---

## 3.7 队列持久化必须与业务状态协调

消息存在不代表业务事务存在。

业务事务、Outbox、Inbox和Queue必须通过明确协议协调。

---

## 3.8 Failover后必须重新确认Authority

恢复后不能直接接受：

```text
旧Leader结果
过期Worker Lease
迟到Callback
旧缓存
旧路由状态
```

必须比较：

```text
Epoch
Term
Version
Lease
Fence Token
```

---

## 3.9 Artifact和Evidence与数据库同等关键

平台即使恢复了Job数据库，但丢失：

```text
Source Snapshot
Proof Artifact
Evidence Lineage
Certificate Dependency
```

也无法证明迁移交付可信。

---

## 3.10 RTO和RPO必须针对业务能力定义

不能只声明整个平台：

```text
RTO = 1小时
RPO = 5分钟
```

应分别定义：

```text
Job Status Query
Cancellation
Security Containment
Artifact Download
New Migration Creation
Certificate Verification
```

的恢复目标。

---

## 3.11 Safe Mode不能绕过安全

Safe Mode可以减少功能，但必须保留：

```text
Authentication
Authorization
Tenant Isolation
Audit
Certificate Integrity
Cancellation
Security Containment
```

---

## 3.12 Read-Only模式不等于全部不可用

数据库写入不可用时，系统可保留：

```text
查看历史Job
下载已验证Artifact
验证Certificate
查看Audit
查看Incident
```

但必须明确数据新鲜度。

---

## 3.13 恢复完成不等于服务恢复

技术组件恢复后还必须：

```text
重放必要消息
对账数据
处理Dead Letter
清理旧Lease
重建Cache
重新验证Proof和Certificate
```

才能正式退出Recovery状态。

---

## 3.14 Chaos必须有明确假设和停止条件

Chaos不是随机破坏。

每个实验必须声明：

```text
要验证什么假设；
故障范围；
最大影响；
观测指标；
中止条件；
恢复步骤。
```

---

## 3.15 灾备必须演练

未经真实恢复演练的备份，不能视为有效备份。

---

# Skill FRT-2800：Resilience Orchestrator

建议路径：

```text
skills/resilience-orchestrator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

统一编排故障模型、隔离、Failover、Chaos、Backup、DR、RTO/RPO和韧性认证。

---

## 2. 输入

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilienceAssuranceRequest

metadata:
  projectId: project://frt-platform
  runId: resilience://release-g28-001

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g28-candidate

  performanceCertificate:
    ref: certificate://performance/release-g27

  environments:
    primary:
      ref: environment://production-primary

    recovery:
      ref: environment://production-recovery

  criticalCapabilities:
    - job-cancellation
    - security-containment
    - artifact-download
    - certificate-verification
    - migration-execution

  requiredLevel:
    critical: RC5
    nonCritical: RC4
```

---

## 3. 输出

```text
Failure Model Set
Timeout / Retry Plan
Circuit Breaker Plan
Isolation Matrix
Queue Durability Report
Failover Plans
HA Reports
Chaos Results
Backup Restore Results
DR Drill Results
RTO / RPO Report
Safe Mode Plan
Partial Availability Matrix
Runbooks
Resilience Certificate
```

---

## 4. 工作流

```text
发现关键依赖
→ 注册Failure Model
→ 验证Timeout / Retry / Circuit Breaker
→ 验证Bulkhead
→ 验证队列持久化
→ 验证Stateful Failover
→ 验证Control Plane HA
→ 验证Worker HA
→ 验证Artifact / Evidence韧性
→ 验证Database Failover
→ 验证Region Failure
→ 运行Chaos
→ 验证Backup / Restore
→ 执行DR Drill
→ 测量RTO / RPO
→ 验证Safe / Read-Only / Partial模式
→ 生成Runbook
→ 签发Certificate
```

---

## 5. 状态机

```text
PLANNED
→ FAILURE_MODELS_REGISTERED
→ CONTAINMENT_VALIDATED
→ FAILOVER_VALIDATED
→ CHAOS_VALIDATED
→ RESTORE_VALIDATED
→ DR_VALIDATED
→ RTO_RPO_VALIDATED
→ CERTIFIED
```

阻断状态：

```text
BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_FAILURE_MODE
BLOCKED_BY_UNSAFE_RETRY
BLOCKED_BY_FAILOVER_SPLIT_BRAIN
BLOCKED_BY_DATA_LOSS
BLOCKED_BY_UNRESTORABLE_BACKUP
BLOCKED_BY_RTO_RPO_FAILURE
BLOCKED_BY_UNSAFE_SAFE_MODE
```

---

## 6. 增量韧性验证

以下变化触发局部重测：

```text
依赖新增或替换
Timeout变化
Retry Policy变化
Queue配置变化
Database拓扑变化
Artifact Store变化
Region策略变化
Backup策略变化
Worker Lease协议变化
```

# Skill FRT-2801：Dependency Failure Model Registry

建议路径：

```text
skills/dependency-failure-model-registry/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为所有内部和外部依赖建立结构化故障模型。

---

## 2. 依赖类别

```text
Database
Cache
Message Broker
Object Storage
Artifact Store
Evidence Graph
Identity Provider
Model Provider
Git Provider
Package Registry
Device Farm
Notification Provider
Payment Provider
Internal Service
Region Network
DNS
Secret Manager
```

---

## 3. Failure Model Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DependencyFailureModel

metadata:
  id: failure-model://artifact-store
  version: 1

spec:
  dependency:
    ref: dependency://artifact-store

  failureModes:
    - id: unavailable
      type: hard-failure

    - id: slow-write
      type: latency

    - id: acknowledged-but-not-durable
      type: unknown-result

    - id: partial-read
      type: data-corruption

    - id: region-partition
      type: network-partition

  detection:
    - health-check
    - write-read-verification
    - digest-check

  impact:
    capabilities:
      - artifact-upload
      - certificate-issuance

  recovery:
    ref: recovery-plan://artifact-store
```

---

## 4. Failure类别

```text
UNAVAILABLE
SLOW
PARTIAL
STALE
CORRUPT
DUPLICATE
OUT_OF_ORDER
UNKNOWN_RESULT
RATE_LIMITED
PARTITIONED
SPLIT_BRAIN
DATA_LOSS
```

---

## 5. 故障可观察性

必须明确：

```text
客户端可见
服务端可见
仅通过对账可见
不可即时判定
```

---

## 6. Unknown Result

例如：

```text
Artifact上传请求超时
```

可能表示：

```text
未写入
已写入但响应丢失
部分写入
```

恢复前应通过Digest和Artifact ID对账。

---

## 7. Failure Dependency Graph

识别依赖故障传播：

```text
Secret Manager不可用
→ 新Worker无法启动
→ Queue积压
→ Job延迟
```

---

## 8. Common Cause Failure

多个服务可能共享：

```text
同一Region
同一数据库
同一DNS
同一Identity Provider
同一Secret
```

不能把它们误认为独立冗余。

---

## 9. Criticality

每个依赖按影响划分：

```text
R0 可忽略
R1 低影响
R2 局部功能
R3 核心业务
R4 数据和平台
R5 安全、支付、证据、设备
```

# Skill FRT-2802：Timeout、Retry and Circuit Breaker Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/timeout-retry-circuit-breaker-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

建立全链路Deadline、Retry Budget和Circuit Breaker治理。

---

## 2. Resilience Call Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilientCallContract

metadata:
  id: resilient-call://model/generate-code

spec:
  caller:
    ref: skill://code-generation

  dependency:
    ref: provider://model

  deadline:
    total: policy://generation-total-deadline

  attempt:
    timeout: policy://generation-attempt-timeout

  retry:
    maximumAttempts: 2
    backoff: exponential-jitter
    retryable:
      - rate-limited
      - transient-network

  circuitBreaker:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: policy-derived
    openDuration: policy-derived

  fallback:
    - alternate-provider
    - queue-for-later
```

---

## 3. Timeout层次

```text
User Request Deadline
Workflow Step Deadline
Service Call Deadline
Database Query Deadline
Provider Attempt Timeout
```

---

## 4. Deadline传播

使用Context或协议字段传播剩余Deadline。

下游不得忽略上游Deadline。

---

## 5. Retry分类

```text
NO_RETRY
SAFE_RETRY
RETRY_WITH_IDEMPOTENCY
RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY
MANUAL_ONLY
```

---

## 6. Retry Storm检测

检查：

```text
客户端重试
Gateway重试
Service重试
Queue重试
Worker重试
Provider SDK重试
```

是否叠加。

---

## 7. Jitter

重试必须使用Jitter，避免同步重试。

---

## 8. Circuit Breaker状态

```text
CLOSED
OPEN
HALF_OPEN
```

---

## 9. Half-Open治理

限制探测请求数量，避免恢复瞬间再次压垮依赖。

---

## 10. Circuit Scope

可以按：

```text
Provider
Endpoint
Tenant
Region
Operation
```

划分，避免单一Tenant错误打开全局Circuit。

---

## 11. Fallback治理

Fallback必须保持明确语义：

```text
Alternate Provider
Queue
Cached Read
Read-Only
Unavailable
```

禁止Fallback为假成功。

---

## 12. 测试场景

```text
Slow Dependency
Timeout
Intermittent Failure
Hard Failure
Rate Limit
Recovery
Half-Open Failure
```

---

# Skill FRT-2803：Bulkhead and Failure Isolation Validator

```text

```

## 1. 目标

限制故障对业务线、Tenant、任务类型和资源池的影响范围。

---

## 2. Bulkhead维度

```text
Tenant
Workspace
Risk Level
Job Type
Worker Type
Provider
Region
Queue
Connection Pool
Thread Pool
```

---

## 3. Isolation Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: FailureIsolationContract

metadata:
  id: isolation://proof-workers

spec:
  workload:
    ref: workload://proof

  resources:
    workerPool: proof-workers
    queue: proof-queue
    databasePool: proof-metadata-pool

  maximumImpact:
    capabilities:
      - proof-generation

  protectedCapabilities:
    - job-cancellation
    - security-containment
    - certificate-verification
```

---

## 4. Worker Bulkhead

```text
Build
Test
Proof
Model
Device
Delivery
```

使用独立Pool。

---

## 5. Tenant Isolation

大Tenant不能耗尽：

```text
全局Worker
Queue
Connection
Artifact带宽
```

需要Tenant Quota和公平调度。

---

## 6. Risk Isolation

R5任务可使用：

```text
Trusted Pool
独立Queue
独立Audit
更严格Retry
```

---

## 7. Failure Radius

每个故障实验必须计算：

```text
Affected Tenant
Affected Jobs
Affected Capabilities
Affected Regions
```

---

## 8. Isolation Leak

检测：

```text
共享线程池饥饿
共享连接池耗尽
全局Circuit误触发
共享Cache污染
```

# Skill FRT-2804：Graceful Degradation Runtime

建议路径：

```text
skills/graceful-degradation-runtime/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

将G27的降级策略实现为运行时可执行状态机。

---

## 2. Runtime状态

```text
NORMAL
DEGRADED_LEVEL_1
DEGRADED_LEVEL_2
READ_ONLY
SAFE_MODE
RECOVERING
```

---

## 3. Degradation Runtime Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DegradationRuntimePolicy

metadata:
  id: degradation-runtime://platform

spec:
  transitions:
    - from: normal
      to: degraded-level-1
      trigger:
        queueAgeAbove: policy-derived

    - from: degraded-level-2
      to: read-only
      trigger:
        databaseWritesUnavailable: true

  preserved:
    - authentication
    - authorization
    - audit
    - certificate-verification
    - cancellation

  disabled:
    - new-heavy-migrations
    - optional-candidate-generation
```

---

## 4. 触发Authority

降级状态由Control Plane或Resilience Controller管理。

普通业务服务不能自行修改全局降级等级。

---

## 5. 功能矩阵

每个Level明确：

```text
允许读
允许写
允许创建
允许取消
允许审批
允许下载
允许安全操作
```

---

## 6. 用户反馈

所有入口返回一致：

```text
当前模式
不可用功能
预计或未知恢复状态
替代操作
```

---

## 7. 恢复状态

恢复过程中逐步开放：

```text
Read
Critical Write
Queued Write
Heavy Work
Full Service
```

---

## 8. 反复振荡防护

使用：

```text
Cooldown
Hysteresis
Minimum Stable Period
Manual Override候选
```

---

# Skill FRT-2805：Queue Durability and Replay Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/queue-durability-replay-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证消息、任务和事件队列在Broker故障、Consumer故障和恢复后不丢失关键业务语义。

---

## 2. Queue Durability Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DurableQueueContract

metadata:
  id: durable-queue://migration-steps

spec:
  durability:
    persistentMessages: true
    replicated: true

  delivery:
    semantics: at-least-once

  consumer:
    idempotencyRequired: true

  retention:
    maximumAge: policy-derived

  replay:
    allowed:
      - workflow-recovery

    forbidden:
      - irreversible-side-effect-without-reconciliation
```

---

## 3. 故障场景

```text
Producer Ack丢失
Broker主节点失败
消息复制延迟
Consumer处理后Ack前失败
Consumer Group Rebalance
Partition不可用
```

---

## 4. Message Authority

Queue不是最终业务Authority。

业务状态仍由：

```text
Database / State Store
```

决定。

---

## 5. Replay分类

```text
SAFE_PROJECTION_REPLAY
IDEMPOTENT_COMMAND_REPLAY
RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED
FORBIDDEN
```

---

## 6. Duplicate Handling

Consumer必须基于：

```text
Message ID
Business Operation ID
Aggregate Version
```

去重。

---

## 7. Queue Recovery

恢复后验证：

```text
积压顺序
Tenant Scope
Dead Letter
重复数量
处理速率
```

---

## 8. Queue Data Loss Detection

通过：

```text
Producer Sequence
Outbox Count
Broker Count
Consumer Inbox
Business Projection
```

对账。

---

# Skill FRT-2806：Stateful Failover Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/stateful-failover-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证带状态服务、Workflow、Lease、Session和Leader在节点故障后正确转移。

---

## 2. Stateful对象

```text
Workflow Orchestrator
Scheduler
Leader Election
Worker Lease
Distributed Lock
Session
Reconciliation Job
Bulk Operation
```

---

## 3. Failover Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: StatefulFailoverContract

metadata:
  id: failover://workflow-orchestrator

spec:
  stateStore:
    ref: database://workflow-state

  leader:
    election: lease-based

  fencing:
    tokenRequired: true

  recovery:
    replayFrom: committed-event

  duplicateProtection:
    required: true
```

---

## 4. Epoch / Term

每个Leader和Lease操作绑定：

```text
Epoch
Term
Fence Token
```

旧Leader恢复后不能继续写入。

---

## 5. In-Flight Operation

节点故障时分类：

```text
NOT_STARTED
STARTED_NOT_COMMITTED
COMMITTED_RESULT_NOT_REPORTED
UNKNOWN
```

---

## 6. Recovery行为

```text
重新读取Authority State
检查Side Effect Journal
对账
恢复未完成步骤
拒绝旧Lease结果
```

---

## 7. Split-Brain测试

模拟网络分区，确保只有具备当前Fence Token的节点可提交。

---

## 8. Session Failover

Session Store故障转移后：

```text
Session不能跨Tenant
撤销状态不能丢失
权限版本不能回退
```

---

# Skill FRT-2809：Artifact and Evidence Store Resilience

建议路径：

```text
skills/artifact-evidence-store-resilience/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

保护Artifact、Evidence Graph、Proof和Certificate依赖数据。

---

## 2. 数据类别

```text
Source Snapshot
Semantic IR
Migration Plan
Generated Repository
Build Artifact
Test Result
Proof
Counterexample
Evidence Graph
Certificate
Delivery Bundle
```

---

## 3. Resilience策略

```text
Content Addressing
Replication
Checksum
Versioning
Immutable Storage
Periodic Scrub
Backup
Region Copy候选
```

---

## 4. Artifact Write

写入完成必须满足：

```text
Content Uploaded
Digest Verified
Metadata Committed
Parent Lineage Recorded
Replication Policy Satisfied
```

---

## 5. Partial Write

检测并清理：

```text
临时对象
Metadata存在但内容缺失
内容存在但Metadata缺失
```

---

## 6. Read Corruption

读取时重新验证Digest。

损坏对象进入：

```text
CORRUPTED
```

并尝试从Replica或Backup恢复。

---

## 7. Evidence Graph韧性

Graph恢复后必须保持：

```text
节点
边
不可变历史
失效关系
Certificate依赖
```

---

## 8. Certificate保护

签发前检查所有引用Artifact的：

```text
可用性
Digest
Replication
Retention
```

---

## 9. Artifact Store降级

写不可用时：

```text
禁止新Certificate签发
禁止正式Delivery
允许读取已有验证Artifact候选
```

# Skill FRT-2810：Database Failover Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/database-failover-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证Metadata、Workflow、Audit、Billing和业务数据库在Failover时保持一致和安全。

---

## 2. 故障类型

```text
Primary Crash
Replica Promotion
Network Partition
Replication Lag
Disk Failure
Connection Reset
Transaction Unknown
Failback
```

---

## 3. Database Failover Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DatabaseFailoverContract

metadata:
  id: db-failover://control-plane

spec:
  topology:
    mode: primary-replica

  consistency:
    criticalWrites: strong

  promotion:
    maximumLag: policy-derived

  fencing:
    oldPrimaryWritesRejected: true

  recovery:
    reconciliationRequired: true
```

---

## 4. Transaction Unknown

客户端连接在Commit阶段中断时：

```text
不得简单重试非幂等Command；
应根据Operation ID查询事务结果。
```

---

## 5. Read Replica

读取副本延迟不能用于：

```text
权限判断
证书有效性
支付状态
撤销状态
```

等强一致决策。

---

## 6. Promotion测试

验证：

```text
Promotion Time
Data Lag
Connection Reconnect
Write Resume
Old Primary Fencing
```

---

## 7. Failback

旧主恢复后不能直接重新成为主节点。

需：

```text
重新同步
验证
受控切换
```

---

## 8. Schema Migration与Failover

数据库迁移期间故障必须支持：

```text
安全恢复
幂等Migration
Expand-Contract
```

---

## 9. Audit数据库

审计数据丢失属于Critical Failure。

---

# Skill FRT-2811：Region Failure Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/region-failure-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证整个Region不可用、网络隔离或部分服务不可用时的业务连续性。

---

## 2. Region模式

```text
Active-Active
Active-Passive
Warm Standby
Cold Standby
Single Region with Backup
```

---

## 3. Region Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RegionResilienceContract

metadata:
  id: region-resilience://enterprise

spec:
  primary:
    region: region-a

  recovery:
    region: region-b
    mode: warm-standby

  replicatedData:
    - metadata
    - artifacts
    - evidence
    - certificates

  restrictedData:
    - regulated-source-code

  failover:
    approvalRequired: true
```

---

## 4. 数据驻留

不是所有数据都允许复制到Recovery Region。

必须按：

```text
Classification
Customer Policy
Regulation
```

决定。

---

## 5. Region Failover

流程：

```text
Detect
→ Confirm
→ Freeze or Fence Primary
→ Promote Recovery
→ Update Routing
→ Restore Critical Services
→ Reconcile
→ Notify
```

---

## 6. DNS与Routing

验证：

```text
TTL
Client Cache
Session
Webhook Endpoint
Worker Registration
```

---

## 7. Active-Active冲突

必须定义：

```text
写入Owner
Conflict Resolution
Global ID
Event Ordering
```

---

## 8. Region Return

原Region恢复后：

```text
不能自动双向写；
先作为Replica；
完成对账后再决定Failback。
```

---

# Skill FRT-2812：Chaos Experiment Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/chaos-experiment-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

从Failure Model和Resilience Contract自动生成受控Chaos实验。

## 2. Chaos Experiment Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosExperiment

metadata:
  id: chaos://worker-pool/zone-loss

spec:
  hypothesis:
    - critical-job-cancellation-remains-available
    - running-jobs-recover-from-checkpoint

  fault:
    type: terminate-zone-workers
    scope:
      workerPool: general-workers
      percentage: 50

  duration:
    maximum: 10m

  abortConditions:
    - cross-tenant-error
    - duplicate-critical-effect
    - control-plane-unavailable

  recovery:
    runbook:
      ref: runbook://worker-zone-loss
```

---

## 3. 故障注入类型

```text
Process Kill
Node Loss
Zone Loss
Network Delay
Packet Loss
Network Partition
Dependency Error
Dependency Latency
Disk Full
Clock Skew
Queue Pause
Database Failover
Cache Flush
Credential Revocation
```

---

## 4. Blast Radius

实验必须限制：

```text
Environment
Tenant
Service
Worker Pool
Region
Duration
```

---

## 5. Steady State Hypothesis

实验前定义：

```text
哪些指标代表系统正常；
哪些关键功能必须维持；
```

---

## 6. 自动终止

达到Abort Condition立即停止并执行Recovery。

---

## 7. Chaos成熟度

```text
C0 Manual Lab
C1 Scheduled Non-Production
C2 Automated Staging
C3 Controlled Production Canary
```

---

## 8. Production Chaos

仅限：

```text
已认证实验
低Blast Radius
明确审批
实时监控
立即停止能力
```

# Skill FRT-2814：Disaster Recovery Drill Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/disaster-recovery-drill-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

生成并执行完整灾难恢复演练，而不是单组件Failover。

---

## 2. DR场景

```text
Primary Region Loss
Database and Queue Loss
Artifact Store Corruption
Control Plane Compromise
Credential Compromise
Large-Scale Worker Loss
Data Corruption Incident
```

---

## 3. DR Drill Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DisasterRecoveryDrill

metadata:
  id: dr-drill://region-loss/2026-q3

spec:
  scenario:
    type: primary-region-loss

  scope:
    capabilities:
      - certificate-verification
      - artifact-download
      - job-status
      - job-cancellation

  participants:
    - incident-commander
    - platform-sre
    - security
    - database-owner

  objectives:
    rto:
      ref: policy://critical-rto

    rpo:
      ref: policy://critical-rpo

  evidence:
    required: true
```

---

## 4. Drill阶段

```text
Declare Incident
→ Assess
→ Contain
→ Activate DR
→ Restore Data
→ Restore Critical Services
→ Reconcile
→ Validate
→ Resume
→ Postmortem
```

---

## 5. Roles

```text
Incident Commander
Operations Lead
Security Lead
Database Lead
Application Lead
Communications Lead
```

---

## 6. Communication

演练包含：

```text
内部通知
客户通知模板
Status Page候选
监管通知候选
```

---

## 7. Recovery Validation

必须实际执行关键Journey：

```text
登录
查看Job
取消Job
下载Artifact
验证Certificate
```

---

## 8. Post-Drill

生成：

```text
Gap
Owner
Deadline
Runbook Change
Architecture Change
```

---

# Skill FRT-2815：RTO and RPO Compliance Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/rto-rpo-compliance-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

定义、测量和验证业务能力级RTO与RPO。

---

## 2. RTO

```text
从故障发生或确认，
到业务能力恢复到声明状态的最大时间。
```

---

## 3. RPO

```text
故障后允许丢失或需要重建的数据时间窗口。
```

---

## 4. Capability-Level Policy

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RecoveryObjective

metadata:
  id: recovery-objective://certificate-verification

spec:
  capability:
    ref: capability://certificate/verify

  priority: critical

  rto:
    maximum: policy-derived

  rpo:
    maximum: zero-or-policy-derived

  recoveryMode:
    - secondary-region
    - cached-verification-data
```

---

## 5. 不同能力目标

例如：

```text
Security Containment：
极低RTO

Certificate Verification：
低RTO、极低RPO

New Migration Creation：
可接受更高RTO

非关键KPI：
可接受更高RTO和RPO
```

---

## 6. 测量起点

必须明确：

```text
故障发生
故障检测
Incident声明
Failover开始
```

哪个时刻作为RTO起点。

---

## 7. RPO验证

通过：

```text
最后已恢复事务
最后Artifact
最后Evidence Event
最后Audit Event
```

计算。

---

## 8. Reconstructable Data

部分数据可通过Event或Artifact重建，但重建时间计入RTO。

---

## 9. 目标变更

放宽RTO/RPO需要业务、SRE和安全审批。

---

```text
WRITE_RESTRICTED
READ_ONLY
```

```text
签发Certificate

Delivery
```

## 5. Security Safe Mode

```text
禁用用户
撤销Pack
隔离Worker
撤销Certificate
```

```text
数据时间
数据来源
```

# Skill FRT-2817：Partial-Service Availability Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/partial-service-availability-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证部分依赖或业务线不可用时，其他能力仍能独立工作。

---

## 2. Capability Dependency Matrix

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PartialAvailabilityMatrix

metadata:
  id: partial-availability://frt-platform

spec:
  capabilities:
    certificate-verification:
      requires:
        - certificate-store
        - artifact-metadata

      independentOf:
        - model-provider
        - build-workers

    job-cancellation:
      requires:
        - control-plane
        - workflow-state

      independentOf:
        - artifact-upload
```

---

## 3. 关键隔离场景

```text
Model Provider Down
→ 已有Job查看和取消可用；

Build Pool Down
→ Approval和Certificate验证可用；

Artifact Write Down
→ 新Certificate禁止，但已有Certificate可验证候选；

Analytics Down
→ 核心Migration不受影响。
```

---

## 4. Dependency Inversion验证

如果非关键Service被错误地放在同步关键路径中，生成Finding。

---

## 5. Partial Result

页面和API明确返回：

```text
可用部分
不可用部分
数据是否完整
是否可重试
```

---

## 6. Critical Path Minimalism

关键安全和取消能力的依赖链应尽可能短。

---

# Skill FRT-2818：Resilience Runbook Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/resilience-runbook-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为每个关键故障生成可执行、可测试的恢复Runbook。

---

## 2. Runbook Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilienceRunbook

metadata:
  id: runbook://database-primary-failure

spec:
  symptoms:
    - write-errors
    - primary-unreachable

  confirm:
    - check-replication-status
    - check-region-network

  contain:
    - stop-new-heavy-writes
    - enable-write-restricted-mode

  recover:
    - promote-approved-replica
    - fence-old-primary
    - reconnect-services

  reconcile:
    - verify-last-committed-operations
    - replay-outbox
    - validate-audit

  exitCriteria:
    - critical-writes-pass
    - replication-healthy
    - reconciliation-complete
```

---

## 3. Runbook内容

```text
适用故障
检测方式
影响范围
安全检查
命令或操作
回滚
对账
验证
升级联系人
```

---

## 4. 自动与人工步骤

明确区分：

```text
AUTOMATED
HUMAN_APPROVAL
MANUAL
```

---

## 5. 命令安全

Runbook命令必须：

```text
版本化
受权限控制
支持Dry Run候选
避免复制真实Secret
```

---

## 6. Runbook测试

定期在演练环境中执行。

---

## 7. Stale Runbook

拓扑、命令、角色或策略变化后自动标记STALE。

---

# Skill FRT-2819：Resilience Certification

建议路径：

```text
skills/resilience-certification/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为Release、拓扑和恢复目标签发韧性证书。

---

## 2. 认证等级

```text
RC0：Unmodeled
RC1：Failure Models Defined
RC2：Local Failover Validated
RC3：HA and Queue Durability Validated
RC4：Chaos and Backup Restore Validated
RC5：DR and RTO/RPO Certified
RC6：Continuously Re-Certified
```

---

## 3. Certificate Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ResilienceCertificate

metadata:
  id: certificate://resilience/release-g28
  version: 1

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g28-candidate

  topology:
    ref: topology://production
    digest: sha256

  objectives:
    criticalCapabilities:
      rto: pass
      rpo: pass

  validations:
    timeoutRetry: pass
    bulkhead: pass
    queueDurability: pass
    statefulFailover: pass
    controlPlaneHa: pass
    workerHa: pass
    artifactEvidence: pass
    databaseFailover: pass
    regionFailure: pass
    chaos: pass
    backupRestore: pass
    drDrill: pass
    safeMode: pass
    partialAvailability: pass

  level:
    requested: RC5
    achieved: RC5
```

---

## 4. 证书范围

必须声明：

```text
Region
Topology
Database
Queue
Artifact Store
Worker Pools
Backup Policy
Release
RTO / RPO
```

---

## 5. 证书失效

以下变化使证书STALE：

```text
拓扑变化
数据库架构变化
Queue变化
Region变化
Backup变化
Timeout / Retry变化
Failover协议变化
关键Runbook变化
```

---

# 六、统一Failure Response Model

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: FailureResponsePlan

metadata:
  id: failure-response://model-provider

spec:
  detect:
    - timeout-rate
    - provider-errors

  contain:
    - open-circuit
    - stop-new-optional-candidates

  preserve:
    - current-job-state
    - existing-artifacts
    - cancellation

  recover:
    - alternate-provider
    - queue-for-later

  reconcile:
    - verify-in-flight-request-results

  notify:
    - affected-users
    - platform-operations
```

---

# 七、统一Recovery State Machine

```text
NORMAL
→ DEGRADED
→ INCIDENT_CONFIRMED
→ CONTAINING
→ FAILING_OVER
→ RECOVERING
→ RECONCILING
→ VALIDATING
→ NORMAL
```

异常终局：

```text
MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED
DATA_LOSS_CONFIRMED
SAFE_SHUTDOWN
```

---

# 八、恢复顺序

推荐恢复顺序：

```text
1. Identity and Authorization
2. Policy and Security Controls
3. Metadata Database
4. Workflow State
5. Audit
6. Artifact Metadata
7. Artifact Content
8. Evidence Graph
9. Queue and Event Consumers
10. Critical Read APIs
11. Critical Write APIs
12. Workers
13. Heavy Workloads
14. Optional Features
```

不能先恢复大量Worker，再恢复数据库和Backpressure。

---

# 九、故障后Reconciliation

恢复后必须检查：

```text
过期Lease
重复Execution
未知事务
未发布Outbox
未处理Inbox
Dead Letter
Partial Artifact
Stale Certificate
Pending Approval
Unclosed Manual Case
```

---

# 十二、G28 Diagnostics

错误前缀：

```text
FRT-FAILURE-MODEL
FRT-TIMEOUT
FRT-RETRY
FRT-CIRCUIT-BREAKER
FRT-BULKHEAD
FRT-DEGRADATION-RUNTIME
FRT-QUEUE-DURABILITY
FRT-STATEFUL-FAILOVER
FRT-CONTROL-PLANE-HA
FRT-WORKER-HA
FRT-ARTIFACT-RESILIENCE
FRT-EVIDENCE-RESILIENCE
FRT-DATABASE-FAILOVER
FRT-REGION-FAILURE
FRT-CHAOS
FRT-BACKUP
FRT-RESTORE
FRT-DR
FRT-RTO-RPO
FRT-SAFE-MODE
FRT-PARTIAL-AVAILABILITY
FRT-RESILIENCE-RUNBOOK
FRT-RESILIENCE-CERT
```

示例：

```text
FRT-FAILURE-MODEL-0012
Payment Provider Timeout没有区分Failed与Unknown Result。

FRT-TIMEOUT-0018
下游单次Timeout大于上游剩余Deadline。

FRT-RETRY-0021
Gateway、Service和Provider SDK同时执行3次重试，
最大可能放大27倍请求。

FRT-RETRY-0011
危险设备命令在Timeout后被自动重试。

FRT-CIRCUIT-BREAKER-0009
单一Tenant失败打开了全局Provider Circuit。

FRT-BULKHEAD-0017
Proof任务耗尽共享数据库连接，
导致Job Cancellation不可用。

FRT-DEGRADATION-RUNTIME-0006
Read-Only模式仍允许签发Certificate。

FRT-DEGRADATION-RUNTIME-0013
Safe Mode关闭了Audit写入。

FRT-QUEUE-DURABILITY-0007
Consumer处理成功、Ack前故障后产生重复Delivery。

FRT-QUEUE-DURABILITY-0019
Broker恢复后消息顺序丢失，
Aggregate Version 14先于13执行。

FRT-STATEFUL-FAILOVER-0005
旧Workflow Leader恢复后仍能提交Step结果。

FRT-CONTROL-PLANE-HA-0016
Policy Service不可用时系统默认允许操作。

FRT-WORKER-HA-0008
Zone故障导致全部Build Worker同时不可用。

FRT-ARTIFACT-RESILIENCE-0013
Artifact Metadata存在，但对象内容缺失。

FRT-EVIDENCE-RESILIENCE-0004
Evidence Graph恢复后丢失Certificate依赖边。

FRT-DATABASE-FAILOVER-0018
Replica Promotion后旧Primary仍接受写入。

FRT-DATABASE-FAILOVER-0022
事务结果Unknown后系统直接重复执行非幂等操作。

FRT-REGION-FAILURE-0010
Recovery Region缺少最新Pack Registry数据。

FRT-REGION-FAILURE-0017
受数据驻留限制的源码被复制到未批准Region。

FRT-CHAOS-0009
Chaos实验没有Abort Condition。

FRT-BACKUP-0014
备份文件存在但无法解密。

FRT-RESTORE-0006
恢复数据库成功，但Artifact和Evidence版本不匹配。

FRT-DR-0019
Region故障演练仅恢复基础设施，
未验证关键用户Journey。

FRT-RTO-RPO-0008
Certificate Verification实际RTO超过声明目标。

FRT-SAFE-MODE-0011
Read-Only页面未显示数据Snapshot时间。

FRT-PARTIAL-AVAILABILITY-0005
Model Provider不可用时Job Cancellation也不可用。

FRT-RESILIENCE-RUNBOOK-0016
Runbook引用已废弃命令。

FRT-RESILIENCE-CERT-0002
备份恢复未通过，无法签发RC5证书。
```

```text
Mode Entry
Capability Matrix
Audit
User Feedback
Recovery
```

---

## 13.17 Partial Availability Tests

逐个关闭非关键依赖并验证关键能力。

---

## 13.18 Resilience Mutation Tests

攻击：

```text
删除Fence Token
无限Retry
关闭Circuit Breaker
共享所有Worker Pool
关闭Queue持久化
允许旧Leader写入
跳过Artifact Digest
跳过Backup Restore
Read-Only仍允许写
Safe Mode关闭Audit
```

# 十五、G28安全与治理

## 15.1 Failover权限

数据库、Region和Safe Mode切换属于高风险操作，必须：

```text
最小权限
MFA候选
审批
Reason
Audit
```

---

## 15.2 Chaos权限

只有批准角色可在指定环境运行实验。

---

## 15.3 故障注入边界

测试工具必须有：

```text
Target Allowlist
Maximum Blast Radius
Maximum Duration
Kill Switch
```

---

## 15.4 Backup访问

备份通常包含大量敏感数据，需要：

```text
独立权限
加密
访问审计
下载限制
```

---

## 15.5 Recovery Credential

DR环境的Credential：

```text
提前准备
定期轮换
可用性测试
不与Primary完全共因
```

---

## 15.6 Safe Mode安全

Safe Mode不能成为绕过审批和权限的后门。

---

## 15.7 Region治理

跨Region复制必须符合数据驻留和客户Policy。

---

## 15.8 Audit不可丢失

故障期间无法写主Audit Store时，可使用：

```text
受控本地Durable Buffer
备用Audit通道
```

恢复后重放。

不能静默放弃审计。

---

# 十六、G28实施顺序

建议顺序：

```text
1. FRT-2801 Dependency Failure Model Registry

2. FRT-2802 Timeout, Retry and Circuit Breaker Validator

3. FRT-2803 Bulkhead and Failure Isolation Validator

4. FRT-2805 Queue Durability and Replay Validator

5. FRT-2806 Stateful Failover Validator

6. FRT-2807 Control Plane High Availability

7. FRT-2808 Worker Pool High Availability

8. FRT-2809 Artifact and Evidence Store Resilience

9. FRT-2810 Database Failover Validator

10. FRT-2804 Graceful Degradation Runtime

11. FRT-2816 Safe Mode and Read-Only Mode Generator

12. FRT-2817 Partial-Service Availability Validator

13. FRT-2813 Backup and Restore Validator

14. FRT-2811 Region Failure Validator

15. FRT-2812 Chaos Experiment Generator

16. FRT-2815 RTO and RPO Compliance Validator

17. FRT-2814 Disaster Recovery Drill Generator

18. FRT-2818 Resilience Runbook Generator

19. FRT-2819 Resilience Certification

20. FRT-2800 Resilience Orchestrator
```

必须先明确Failure Model、Timeout、Retry、Bulkhead和状态Authority，再进行Chaos和DR。否则Chaos只能暴露混乱，而不能验证设计假设。

---

# 十七、G28阶段里程碑

## Milestone 1：Failure Model Foundation

完成所有关键依赖及Common Cause Failure建模。

---

## Milestone 2：Timeout、Retry与Circuit Breaker

消除：

```text
无限等待
Retry Storm
Unknown Result误判
全局Circuit误伤
```

---

## Milestone 3：Bulkhead与队列持久化

完成故障半径控制和消息恢复。

---

## Milestone 4：Stateful Failover

完成Leader、Lease、Fence和Checkpoint恢复。

---

## Milestone 5：Control Plane与Worker HA

关键控制和执行能力具备多实例与故障转移。

---

## Milestone 6：Artifact、Evidence和Database韧性

确保证据链和业务状态可恢复。

---

## Milestone 7：Safe Mode与Partial Availability

完成数据库或依赖异常下的关键服务保留。

---

## Milestone 8：Backup、Region与Chaos

完成备份恢复、Region切换和Chaos实验。

---

## Milestone 9：DR Drill与RTO/RPO

实际完成完整灾备演练并测量目标。

---

## Milestone 10：RC5 Certification

签发Resilience Certificate。

---

# 二十、G28完成后的系统状态

完成G28后，系统将从：

```text
系统在目标并发和压力下能够稳定运行
```

推进到：

```text
系统在服务、数据库、队列、Worker、存储、
Provider、设备和Region发生故障时，
仍能够隔离故障、保护状态、维持关键能力、
安全恢复并满足声明的RTO与RPO。
```

系统能够确保：

```text
所有关键依赖具有明确Failure Model；

Timeout、Retry和Circuit Breaker具有全链路预算；

故障被限制在明确Tenant、Pool和业务范围内；

关键Queue消息可以持久化、去重和安全Replay；

旧Leader、旧Lease和迟到结果不能污染恢复状态；

Control Plane和关键Worker Pool具备真实Failover；

Artifact、Evidence、Proof和Certificate依赖可恢复；

数据库Failover不会产生双主和未知事务重复执行；

Region故障时关键能力可以按策略切换；

备份经过真实恢复验证，而非仅确认文件存在；

Chaos实验有假设、Blast Radius、Abort和Recovery；

DR Drill验证真实业务Journey，而非只恢复基础设施；

每个关键能力具有可测量的RTO和RPO；

Safe Mode和Read-Only模式不削弱安全和审计；

非关键依赖失败时，关键取消、安全和验证能力仍可用；

所有故障恢复流程都有可执行Runbook和Evidence。
```

```text
系统在各类基础设施和依赖故障下仍能安全恢复
```

推进到：

```text
系统面对恶意用户、越权、注入、供应链攻击、
```

# Generation Batch G29：威胁建模、身份权限、供应链、AI安全、隐私合规与持续安全认证 Skills

## 一、G29总体定位

G21–G27已经分别完成：

```text
需求与功能追踪闭环
业务流程闭环
数据生命周期闭环
管理端治理闭环
真实用户可用性闭环
全系统回归资格认证
高并发、性能与容量认证
```

G28进一步建立：

```text
Failure Model
→ Timeout / Retry / Circuit Breaker
→ Bulkhead
→ Queue Durability
→ Stateful Failover
→ High Availability
→ Backup / Restore
→ Disaster Recovery
→ RTO / RPO
```

使系统能够在基础设施、依赖、Worker、数据库、存储和Region故障时安全恢复。

但是：

```text
系统能够从故障中恢复
```

并不等于：

```text
系统能够抵御主动攻击者。
```

主动攻击者可能故意利用：

```text
身份验证缺陷
权限校验缺失
跨租户对象引用
Token泄漏
Session固定
API批量滥用
SQL / Command / Template Injection
恶意文件
路径穿越
SSRF
依赖投毒
恶意Skill
恶意Pack
模型Prompt Injection
Tool Capability Escalation
Artifact篡改
Certificate伪造
管理员权限
供应链密钥泄漏
数据导出
删除流程缺口
```

攻击系统。

G29负责建立：

> 从资产识别、威胁建模、攻击面清单、身份认证、授权与租户隔离、Session与Token、API、输入和文件安全、Secret与密钥、供应链、SBOM、漏洞治理、SAST、DAST、Fuzzing、协议滥用、Bot和Rate Abuse、隐私与Consent、删除合规、安全事件响应、渗透测试证据、安全管理端和持续重新认证的完整安全闭环。

总体安全闭环：

```text
Business and Technical Assets
            │
            ▼
      Threat Modeling
            │
            ├── Actors
            ├── Trust Boundaries
            ├── Entry Points
            ├── Abuse Cases
            └── Security Objectives
            │
            ▼
      Security Controls
            │
    ┌───────┼────────┬──────────┐
    ▼       ▼        ▼          ▼
 Identity  Access    Data     Supply Chain
    │       │        │          │
    └───────┼────────┴──────────┘
            ▼
      Security Verification
            │
    ┌───────┼──────────────┐
    ▼       ▼              ▼
  SAST     DAST        Fuzz / Abuse
            │
            ▼
    Findings and Response
            │
            ├── Containment
            ├── Remediation
            ├── Evidence
            └── Re-Certification
            │
            ▼
      Security Certificate
```

---

# 二、G29最终目标

完成G29后，系统必须能够回答：

```text
系统中有哪些高价值资产？

哪些地方跨越了Trust Boundary？

攻击者可以从哪些入口进入？

恶意用户能够伪造或盗用身份吗？

权限是在UI、API还是Domain层验证？

Tenant A是否可能访问Tenant B的数据？

Token或Session泄漏后如何限制损害？

API能否被批量枚举和滥用？

所有外部输入是否都有明确验证策略？

上传文件是否可能导致代码执行、路径穿越或恶意内容传播？

Secret是否进入代码、日志、模型Prompt或Artifact？

Skill、Pack、Container和Dependency是否经过签名与来源验证？

依赖漏洞如何发现、分级、修复和重新认证？

恶意Repository内容能否诱导模型绕过系统规则？

恶意Pack能否获得未声明权限？

模型能否通过Prompt Injection调用高风险Tool？

管理员是否能绕过审批、审计或Tenant Scope？

隐私数据是否按Purpose和Consent使用？

删除请求是否覆盖所有派生和缓存数据？

发生安全事件时如何检测、隔离、调查和恢复？

渗透测试结果是否绑定具体Release和环境？

代码、依赖、Policy或模型变化后，安全结论是否自动失效？
```

---

# 三、G29核心原则

## 3.1 安全从资产和业务影响开始

不能只按技术组件列漏洞。

必须先识别：

```text
身份
账号
租户数据
源代码
生成代码
支付与退款
医疗信息
设备命令
能源控制
Artifact
Evidence
Proof
Certificate
Secret
模型能力
Delivery权限
```

等资产。

每个资产必须声明：

```text
Owner
Classification
Integrity Requirement
Confidentiality Requirement
Availability Requirement
Retention
Allowed Actors
Allowed Operations
```

---

## 3.2 默认拒绝

以下任一未知时默认拒绝：

```text
Actor未知
Role未知
Scope未知
Tenant未知
Permission未知
Tool Capability未知
Pack权限未知
Data Classification未知
```

---

## 3.3 身份认证与业务账号分离

必须区分：

```text
Identity
User
Business Account
Organization
Workspace
Tenant
Role
Session
```

外部登录身份不能直接等于业务Account Authority。

---

## 3.4 前端不可成为安全Authority

前端可以：

```text
隐藏按钮
显示权限状态
引导申请权限
```

但最终安全决策必须由：

```text
API
Application Service
Domain Command
Policy Engine
```

执行。

---

## 3.5 每个请求都必须携带并验证Scope

关键Scope包括：

```text
Environment
Organization
Workspace
Tenant
Project
Account
Resource
Capability
```

Scope缺失不能默认使用当前第一个或全局值。

---

## 3.6 ID难猜不等于授权

即使对象ID为UUID，也必须验证对象归属和Actor权限。

---

## 3.7 输入在进入每个信任边界时重新验证

数据通过以下边界时都可能需要验证：

```text
Browser → API
API → Domain
Event → Consumer
Repository → Model Context
Pack → Runtime
File → Parser
Provider → Callback
Admin UI → Command
```

---

## 3.8 输出编码与输入验证职责不同

防止XSS不能只依赖输入过滤。

应根据输出上下文执行：

```text
HTML Encoding
Attribute Encoding
URL Validation
JavaScript Context禁止或安全编码
Template Escaping
```

---

## 3.9 Repository内容全部视为不可信

源码中的：

```text
README
注释
字符串
Prompt文件
测试描述
文档
```

都可能包含：

```text
“忽略系统规则”
“关闭测试”
“上传Secret”
“直接调用Production Tool”
```

等Prompt Injection。

这些内容不能修改系统Policy和Capability。

---

## 3.10 模型输出是候选，不是Authority

模型不能自行决定：

```text
权限通过
安全测试通过
Certificate有效
漏洞可接受
高风险Tool可执行
```

---

## 3.11 Tool Capability必须在服务端再次检查

即使Agent Planner已检查权限，Tool执行服务仍须检查：

```text
Actor
Run
Approval
Capability
Scope
Input Schema
Expiry
Idempotency
```

---

## 3.12 Secret永不作为普通数据传递

Secret只通过：

```text
Secret Reference
Short-Lived Token
Scoped Credential
```

传递。

不能写入：

```text
Prompt
日志
Trace
Artifact
错误信息
Repository
测试Fixture
```

---

## 3.13 供应链组件必须可追踪

所有：

```text
Skill
Pack
Plugin
Container
Compiler
Dependency
Model
Toolchain
Build Artifact
```

必须绑定：

```text
Publisher
Version
Digest
Signature
SBOM
Provenance
License
Security Status
```

---

## 3.14 安全Finding不能只按CVSS式分数处理

风险还需结合：

```text
业务资产
是否可利用
攻击前置条件
Tenant影响范围
数据分类
是否存在补偿
是否可检测
```

---

## 3.15 隐私不仅是加密

完整隐私治理包括：

```text
Purpose
Consent
Data Minimization
Access
Retention
Deletion
Export
Correction
Audit
```

---

## 3.16 安全事件Containment优先于完整诊断

若检测到：

```text
跨租户访问
Secret泄漏
恶意Pack
Certificate伪造
```

可先：

```text
撤销Session
禁用Pack
隔离Worker
阻止Delivery
撤销Certificate
```

再完成深入调查。

---

## 3.17 安全控制在高负载和故障时不能降级

不得因：

```text
性能
Queue积压
Audit Store故障
Provider不可用
```

关闭：

```text
Authorization
Tenant Isolation
Idempotency
Audit
Secret保护
```

---

## 3.18 安全认证绑定精确Release

Certificate必须绑定：

```text
Commit Digest
Pack Lock
Dependency Lock
Container Digest
Policy Digest
Model Routing Policy
Environment
```

---

# Skill FRT-2900：Security Assurance Orchestrator

建议路径：

```text
skills/security-assurance-orchestrator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

统一编排资产、威胁、攻击面、安全控制、静态和动态测试、漏洞、事件响应和安全认证。

---

## 2. 输入

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SecurityAssuranceRequest

metadata:
  projectId: project://frt-platform
  runId: security://release-g29-001

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g29-candidate

  closureArtifacts:
    product:
      ref: artifact://product-closure

    business:
      ref: artifact://business-closure

    data:
      ref: artifact://data-integrity

    admin:
      ref: artifact://admin-completeness

    resilience:
      ref: artifact://resilience-assurance

  environments:
    test:
      ref: environment://security-test

    target:
      ref: environment://production-profile

  requiredLevel:
    critical: SC5
    nonCritical: SC4
```

---

## 3. 输出

```text
Asset Registry
Threat Models
Attack Surface Inventory
Authentication Report
Authorization Report
Tenant Isolation Report
Session and Token Report
API Security Report
Injection Report
File Security Report
Secrets Report
Supply Chain Report
SBOM
Vulnerability Findings
SAST Report
DAST Report
Fuzzing Report
Abuse Report
Privacy Report
Incident Response Plans
Penetration Evidence
Security Qualification
Security Certificate
```

---

## 4. 工作流

```text
发现资产与信任边界
→ 生成Threat Model
→ 建立Attack Surface
→ 解析Security Requirements
→ 验证Identity和Session
→ 验证Authorization和Tenant Isolation
→ 验证API、Input和File
→ 验证Secret和Key
→ 验证Supply Chain和SBOM
→ 运行SAST
→ 运行DAST
→ 运行Fuzzing和Abuse
→ 验证Privacy和Deletion
→ 验证Incident Response
→ 导入Penetration Evidence
→ 执行Security Regression
→ 签发Certificate
```

---

## 5. 状态机

```text
PLANNED
→ ASSETS_REGISTERED
→ THREATS_MODELED
→ CONTROLS_MAPPED
→ STATIC_VALIDATED
→ DYNAMIC_VALIDATED
→ ABUSE_VALIDATED
→ PRIVACY_VALIDATED
→ RESPONSE_VALIDATED
→ CERTIFIED
```

阻断状态：

```text
BLOCKED_BY_UNKNOWN_CRITICAL_ASSET
BLOCKED_BY_AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE
BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORIZATION_BYPASS
BLOCKED_BY_TENANT_LEAK
BLOCKED_BY_SECRET_EXPOSURE
BLOCKED_BY_SUPPLY_CHAIN_FAILURE
BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITY
BLOCKED_BY_INCIDENT_RESPONSE_GAP
```

---

## 6. 安全运行模式

支持：

```text
FULL_SECURITY_ASSESSMENT
IMPACTED_SECURITY_REGRESSION
SUPPLY_CHAIN_ONLY
PRIVACY_ONLY
PENETRATION_RETEST
INCIDENT_RECERTIFICATION
```

# Skill FRT-2901：Threat Model Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/threat-model-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

从架构、数据流、业务能力和权限模型生成结构化威胁模型。

---

## 2. Threat Model输入

```text
Asset Registry
Business Capability Map
Data Lineage
Trust Boundaries
Actors
Entry Points
External Dependencies
Admin Capabilities
Agent Tools
Skill Permissions
```

---

## 3. Threat Model Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ThreatModel

metadata:
  id: threat-model://artifact-delivery
  version: 1

spec:
  capability:
    ref: capability://delivery/create-pr

  assets:
    - source-code
    - generated-code
    - delivery-credential
    - certificate

  actors:
    trusted:
      - approved-delivery-worker

    untrusted:
      - repository-content
      - external-user

  trustBoundaries:
    - control-plane-to-worker
    - worker-to-git-provider

  threats:
    - id: malicious-repository-instruction
      category: prompt-injection

    - id: credential-exfiltration
      category: secret-disclosure

    - id: unauthorized-delivery
      category: privilege-escalation

  controls:
    - capability-filtering
    - short-lived-credential
    - approval
    - target-repository-allowlist
```

---

## 4. 威胁类别

建议统一：

```text
Spoofing
Tampering
Repudiation
Information Disclosure
Denial of Service
Elevation of Privilege
Prompt Injection
Tool Abuse
Supply Chain Compromise
Privacy Misuse
Cross-Tenant Access
Business Logic Abuse
```

---

## 5. Abuse Case

每项关键Capability至少生成：

```text
合法使用
越权使用
重复使用
过量使用
错误Scope使用
恶意输入使用
故障下滥用
```

---

## 6. Trust Boundary

关键边界包括：

```text
User → Web Console
Web Console → API
API → Domain
Control Plane → Worker
Worker → Model Provider
Worker → Git Provider
Repository → Parser
Repository → Model Context
Pack → Runtime
Event Bus → Consumer
Admin → High-Risk Command
```

---

## 7. Threat优先级

结合：

```text
Asset Criticality
Exploitability
Tenant Blast Radius
Privilege Required
Detectability
Recovery Difficulty
```

---

## 8. Threat Coverage

每个Critical Threat必须至少绑定：

```text
Preventive Control
Detective Control
Response Control
Verification Test
Owner
```

---

## 9. 威胁变更

以下变化触发Threat Model更新：

```text
新API
新Tool
新Pack权限
新外部Provider
新数据分类
新Admin Command
新Region
新Delivery入口
```

---

# Skill FRT-2902：Attack Surface Inventory

建议路径：

```text
skills/attack-surface-inventory/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

维护系统所有可被攻击者接触的入口、协议、数据和能力清单。

---

## 2. Surface类型

```text
Public Web
Admin Web
Public API
Internal API
Webhook
WebSocket / SSE
File Upload
Git Repository
Package
Container
Skill
Pack
Model Prompt
Tool
Worker RPC
Database
Queue
Artifact Download
Backup
Device Interface
```

---

## 3. Surface Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AttackSurface

metadata:
  id: surface://api/artifact-download

spec:
  entryPoint:
    ref: api://artifacts/download

  exposure:
    network: authenticated-public

  assets:
    - source-code
    - generated-code
    - proof-artifact

  authentication:
    required: true

  authorization:
    policy:
      ref: policy://artifact-download

  input:
    - artifactId
    - workspaceId

  abuseCases:
    - id-enumeration
    - cross-workspace-access
    - token-replay
    - bulk-exfiltration
```

---

## 4. Surface属性

```text
Network Reachability
Authentication
Authorization
Input Types
Output Types
Rate Limit
Data Classification
Side Effects
Dependencies
Owner
Last Test
```

---

## 5. 未登记入口

检测：

```text
新增Route
新增API
新增Port
新增Webhook
新增Tool
新增Admin Command
新增File Handler
```

但Attack Surface Registry无记录。

---

## 6. Debug和测试入口

Production必须检测并禁用：

```text
Debug API
Test Credential
Mock Login
Local File Browser
Unsafe Health Endpoint
```

---

## 7. 隐藏Admin API

即使无UI，也必须登记、授权和测试。

---

## 8. Surface Reduction

标记可：

```text
删除
内网化
合并
限制Scope
改为异步
```

的入口。

---

# Skill FRT-2903：Authentication Security Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/authentication-security-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证身份验证、登录、MFA、身份绑定、恢复和异常检测。

---

## 2. Authentication Flow

```text
Start Login
→ Redirect / Challenge
→ Provider Authentication
→ Credential Exchange
→ Backend Validation
→ Identity Resolution
→ Account Resolution
→ Session Creation
```

---

## 3. Authentication Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AuthenticationContract

metadata:
  id: authentication://enterprise-sso

spec:
  provider:
    ref: identity-provider://enterprise

  validation:
    issuer: required
    audience: required
    signature: required
    nonce: required
    state: required
    expiry: required

  accountBinding:
    mode: explicit

  session:
    ref: session-policy://enterprise
```

---

## 4. 验证内容

```text
Issuer
Audience
Signature
Expiry
Not-Before
Nonce
State
Redirect URI
PKCE候选
MFA
Identity Binding
```

---

## 5. Account Enumeration

登录和恢复错误不能泄漏：

```text
账号是否存在
具体MFA状态
内部User ID
```

---

## 6. Brute Force

支持：

```text
Rate Limit
Progressive Delay
Risk-Based Challenge
Account Lock Policy候选
Alert
```

锁定策略不能形成简单DoS入口。

---

## 7. Credential Stuffing

检测：

```text
异常IP
设备
失败分布
已泄漏Credential候选
```

---

## 8. Account Recovery

恢复流程必须：

```text
强身份验证
短期Token
单次使用
重新验证关键Session
撤销旧Credential候选
完整审计
```

---

## 9. Identity Linking

将多个外部Identity绑定同一User需要：

```text
当前Session确认
目标Identity确认
冲突检测
审计
```

---

## 10. MFA Reset

管理员重置MFA属于高风险操作，需要审批或加强认证。

---

## 11. Authentication Failure UX

避免区分：

```text
用户不存在
密码错误
账号已注册
```

除非业务明确允许。

---

# Skill FRT-2904：Authorization and Policy Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/authorization-policy-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证RBAC、ABAC、Policy-as-Code、Domain Command和服务端权限执行。

---

## 2. Authorization Decision

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AuthorizationDecisionRequest

spec:
  actor:
    userId: user-001
    roles:
      - migration-reviewer

  action:
    id: certificate.issue

  resource:
    type: certificate
    workspaceId: workspace-001

  context:
    environment: production
    risk: R5
```

---

## 3. 决策因素

```text
Identity
Role
Permission
Organization
Workspace
Tenant
Project
Resource Ownership
Environment
Risk
Time
Approval
Break-Glass
```

---

## 4. Policy结果

```text
ALLOW
DENY
ALLOW_WITH_APPROVAL
ALLOW_WITH_CONSTRAINTS
```

---

## 5. 权限验证层次

必须在：

```text
API Gateway候选
Application Service
Domain Command
Tool Execution
Data Access
```

适当层次验证。

---

## 6. Permission Matrix Test

对每个关键Action自动生成：

```text
允许Role
缺少Role
错误Workspace
错误Tenant
错误Environment
过期Approval
撤销Permission
Break-Glass
```

---

## 7. Object-Level Authorization

不仅验证类型权限：

```text
artifact.read
```

还必须验证具体Artifact属于当前Scope。

---

## 8. Field-Level Authorization

敏感字段可根据Role：

```text
显示
脱敏
隐藏
拒绝
```

---

## 9. Separation of Duties

检测：

```text
提出者与批准者
退款操作与财务复核
Pack Publisher与Final Approver
Certificate Proposer与Issuer
```

冲突。

---

## 10. Policy Cache

权限变化后必须：

```text
失效Cache
提升Policy Version
拒绝旧Version候选
```

---

## 11. Policy Failure

Policy Engine不可用时默认拒绝高风险操作。

---

# Skill FRT-2905：Tenant Isolation Security Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/tenant-isolation-security-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证Organization、Workspace、Tenant、Project和Account的端到端隔离。

---

## 2. 隔离层

```text
UI
API
Application Service
Database
Cache
Event
Search
Artifact
Offline Store
Analytics
Model Context
Logs
```

---

## 3. Isolation Test Profile

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TenantIsolationTestProfile

metadata:
  id: tenant-isolation://artifact

spec:
  tenants:
    - tenant-a
    - tenant-b

  resources:
    conflictingIds: true

  attacks:
    - replace-tenant-id
    - enumerate-resource-id
    - reuse-download-token
    - replay-event
    - stale-account-callback
```

---

## 4. 服务端Scope来源

Tenant Scope应从受信任Session或Token Claim解析，并与Resource归属校验。

不能只信任请求参数。

---

## 5. Cross-Tenant Cache

验证：

```text
相同Resource ID
相同Query
相同Locale
```

在不同Tenant下不会共享错误结果。

---

## 6. Cross-Tenant Event

Consumer检查：

```text
Event Tenant
Resource Tenant
Consumer Scope
```

一致。

---

## 7. Artifact URL

临时下载Token绑定：

```text
Artifact
Workspace
Actor
Expiry
Operation
```

---

## 8. Model Context

模型调用中不得混入其他Tenant的：

```text
Source
Memory
Examples
Artifact
Retrieval Result
```

---

## 9. Noninterference

对R4/R5数据生成形式化或属性测试：

```text
改变Tenant A私有状态，
Tenant B可观察输出不变。
```

---

# Skill FRT-2906：Session and Token Security Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/session-token-security-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证Session、Access Token、Refresh Token、API Key和临时Credential生命周期。

---

## 2. Token类型

```text
Browser Session
Access Token
Refresh Token
API Key
Worker Lease Token
Artifact Download Token
Approval Token
Tool Capability Token
Webhook Signature
```

---

## 3. Token Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TokenContract

metadata:
  id: token://artifact-download

spec:
  audience:
    - artifact-service

  scope:
    - artifact.read

  resourceBinding:
    artifactId: required
    workspaceId: required

  lifetime:
    maximum: policy-derived

  replay:
    singleUse: optional

  storage:
    browserPersistentStorageForbidden: true
```

---

## 4. Token验证

```text
Signature
Issuer
Audience
Expiry
Not-Before
Scope
Resource Binding
Tenant
Session Version
Revocation
```

---

## 5. Session Fixation

登录后Session ID必须按策略轮换。

---

## 6. Token Storage

前端不得将高敏感Token持久化到不安全存储。

---

## 7. Refresh Token

需要：

```text
Rotation
Reuse Detection
Revocation
Account and Tenant Binding
```

---

## 8. Logout

Logout必须：

```text
撤销Session
清理前端状态
清理Cache
关闭Realtime
取消旧请求
```

---

## 9. Privilege Change

权限提升或降低后：

```text
提升Session Version
刷新或撤销相关Session
```

---

## 10. Artifact Token

下载完成或过期后不能再次用于其他Artifact。

---

## 11. Worker Lease Token

Lease过期后结果不得作为正式Evidence。

---

# Skill FRT-2907：API Security Validator

```text
skills/api-security-validator/SKILL.md
```

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ApiSecurityContract

metadata:
  id: api-security://certificates/revoke

spec:
  endpoint:
    ref: api://certificates/revoke

  authentication:
    required: true

  authorization:
    action: certificate.revoke

  idempotency:
    required: true

  version:
    required: true

  rateLimit:
    required: true

  audit:
    required: true
```

---

## 3. 验证项目

```text
Authentication
Authorization
Object Scope
Input Validation
Output Filtering
Idempotency
Rate Limit
Pagination
Error Handling
Audit
```

---

## 4. BOLA / IDOR

对所有对象型API自动替换：

```text
Resource ID
Workspace ID
Tenant ID
Project ID
```

验证越权。

---

## 5. Mass Assignment

客户端不能通过提交额外字段修改：

```text
Role
Status
Tenant
Authority Field
Approval State
Paid State
Certificate State
```

---

## 6. Excessive Data Exposure

API DTO只能返回当前用途所需字段。

---

## 7. Pagination Abuse

限制：

```text
Page Size
Cursor Lifetime
Sort Field
Filter Complexity
```

---

## 8. Graph / Query Complexity

```text
Depth Limit
Cost Limit
Field Allowlist
Timeout
```

---

## 9. WebSocket / SSE

验证：

```text
认证
订阅Scope
重连
Session撤销
跨Tenant Topic
消息大小
```

---

## 10. Webhook

验证：

```text
Signature
Timestamp
Nonce候选
Replay
Source Allowlist候选
Schema
Idempotency
```

---

## 11. Error Response

不暴露：

```text
Stack Trace
SQL
内部路径
Secret
Provider Credential
```

---

# Skill FRT-2908：Input Validation and Injection Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/input-injection-security-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

统一治理所有不可信输入和注入风险。

---

## 2. 输入来源

```text
用户表单
URL
Header
Cookie
File
Repository
API
Event
Webhook
Model Output
Pack Manifest
Admin Reason
Template
Search Query
```

---

## 3. Validation Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: InputValidationContract

metadata:
  id: input://repository/path

spec:
  type: repository-relative-path

  constraints:
    absolutePath: forbidden
    traversal: forbidden
    nullByte: forbidden

  normalization:
    requiredBeforeValidation: true
```

---

## 4. 注入类型

```text
SQL Injection
Command Injection
Template Injection
Expression Injection
Path Traversal
LDAP候选
Header Injection
CRLF
XSS
SSRF
Open Redirect
Log Injection
Prompt Injection
```

---

## 5. SQL

必须使用：

```text
Parameterized Query
Typed Query Builder
Allowlisted Dynamic Identifiers
```

---

## 6. Command

禁止将用户输入拼接到Shell命令。

优先使用：

```text
Structured Process Arguments
No Shell
Allowlist
Sandbox
```

---

## 7. Path

执行：

```text
Normalize
Resolve
Check Within Root
Reject Symlink Escape候选
```

---

## 8. URL / SSRF

外部URL调用需要：

```text
Scheme Allowlist
Host Allowlist
DNS Resolution Check
Private Address Block
Redirect Revalidation
Response Size Limit
Timeout
```

---

## 9. Template

禁止未受控模板执行任意表达式或代码。

---

## 10. XSS

输出到不同Context时采用对应编码。

---

## 11. Prompt Injection

Repository和用户内容必须：

```text
标记为Untrusted
与System Policy隔离
不允许声明Capability
不允许修改Tool Allowlist
```

---

## 12. Model Output Validation

模型生成：

```text
Code
SQL
Command
Tool Arguments
Patch
```

必须经过Schema、Policy、Sandbox和Verifier。

---

# Skill FRT-2909：File Upload and Content Security Validator

建议路径：

```text

```

## 1. 目标

---

## 2. File Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: FileUploadContract

metadata:
  id: upload://repository-archive

spec:
  size:
    maximum: policy-derived

  types:
    allowed:
      - zip
      - tar

  processing:
    sandboxRequired: true
    recursiveArchiveLimit: policy-derived
    pathTraversalCheck: true
    symlinkPolicy: reject-or-controlled

  storage:
    quarantineBeforeScan: true
```

---

## 3. 验证内容

```text
文件大小
扩展名
MIME
Magic Bytes
压缩比
嵌套深度
文件数量
路径
Symlink
权限位
```

---

## 4. Zip Bomb

限制：

```text
解压总大小
文件数
嵌套层数
压缩比
CPU时间
```

---

## 5. 路径穿越

拒绝：

```text
../
绝对路径
设备路径
异常编码路径
```

---

## 6. 恶意代码

Repository本身可能包含恶意Build Script。

默认：

```text
扫描和解析阶段不执行仓库代码；
Build在Sandbox运行；
网络默认关闭；
Secret默认不可用。
```

---

## 7. 文件预览

```text
安全Content-Type
Attachment
Sandboxed Frame候选
HTML Sanitization
```

---

## 8. 对象存储

```text
Digest
Owner
Tenant
Classification
Retention
```

必须登记。

---

## 9. 下载

下载响应设置安全Header，并验证Actor与Scope。

# Skill FRT-2912：SBOM and Vulnerability Governance

建议路径：

```text
skills/sbom-vulnerability-governance/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

生成多层SBOM，并治理漏洞发现、影响、修复和例外。

---

## 2. SBOM范围

```text
Application Dependencies
Container Packages
Build Toolchain
Skill Dependencies
Pack Dependencies
Native SDK
Flutter / ArkUI Plugin
Model Runtime
```

---

## 3. Component Record

```yaml
component:
  name: controlled-component
  version: controlled
  digest: sha256
  source: registry://approved
  license: controlled
  dependencies: []
```

---

## 4. Vulnerability Finding

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: VulnerabilityFinding

metadata:
  id: vulnerability://component/001

spec:
  component:
    ref: component://controlled

  affectedArtifacts:
    - artifact://application-image

  reachability:
    status: reachable

  exploitability:
    status: plausible

  businessImpact:
    - source-code-access

  remediation:
    targetVersion: controlled
```

---

## 5. Reachability

漏洞存在于依赖中，不一定可达。

但“不可达”判断需要Evidence，不能由开发者口头声明。

---

## 6. 漏洞优先级

结合：

```text
Severity
Reachability
Exposure
Privileges
Asset
Exploit Availability
Mitigation
```

---

## 7. 修复SLA

按Criticality定义：

```text
Critical
High
Medium
Low
```

修复时间。

---

## 8. Exception

暂不修复需要：

```text
原因
不可升级原因
补偿控制
Owner
Expiry
Revalidation
```

---

## 9. License

SBOM同时检查不兼容或未批准License。

---

## 10. 新漏洞事件

新漏洞影响已签发Certificate时：

```text
Certificate → STALE / REVOKED候选
→ 创建Remediation
→ 重新测试
```

---
