建议路径：

```text
skills/rate-abuse-bot-protection-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

防止账号枚举、资源枚举、批量抓取、自动化滥用和成本攻击。

---

## 2. Abuse类型

```text
Credential Stuffing
Account Enumeration
Resource Enumeration
Artifact Scraping
API Flood
Expensive Query Abuse
Model Cost Abuse
Bulk Operation Abuse
Notification Spam
Approval Spam
```

---

## 3. Abuse Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AbuseProtectionContract

metadata:
  id: abuse://artifact-download

spec:
  signals:
    - request-rate
    - unique-artifact-count
    - failed-scope-checks
    - data-volume

  responses:
    - throttle
    - require-reauthentication
    - suspend-token
    - security-alert
```

---

## 4. Rate Limit层次

```text
IP
Identity
Session
API Key
Account
Tenant
Workspace
Organization
Capability
```

---

## 5. 成本攻击

攻击者可能大量触发：

```text
Model Invocation
Build
Proof
Device Test
Artifact Generation
```

需要成本和Quota保护。

---

## 6. 高价值数据抓取

限制：

```text
Artifact Download
Audit Export
Billing Export
Source Download
```

速率和总量。

---

## 7. Bot判断

避免只依赖单一指纹。

结合：

```text
行为
失败模式
速度
设备
身份历史
```

---

## 8. 可访问性

Bot Protection不能无差别阻断辅助技术用户。

---

## 9. 安全响应

可执行：

```text
限速
强制重新认证
暂时冻结
撤销Token
创建Incident
```

---

# Skill FRT-2917：Privacy and Consent Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/privacy-consent-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证个人、敏感、金融、临床和行为数据的Purpose、Consent和最小化使用。

---

## 2. Privacy Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PrivacyContract

metadata:
  id: privacy://model-code-analysis

spec:
  data:
    - source-code
    - repository-metadata

  purpose:
    - code-migration

  allowedProcessors:
    - approved-model-provider

  retention:
    - no-provider-retention

  consentOrBasis:
    policy:
      ref: policy://enterprise-code-processing

  prohibitedUses:
    - model-training
    - advertising
```

---

## 3. Purpose Limitation

同一数据不能因已收集而任意用于：

```text
Analytics
Model Training
Marketing
Cross-Customer Benchmark
```

---

## 4. Data Minimization

每个流程只请求所需字段。

---

## 5. Consent状态

```text
NOT_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY
REQUESTED
GRANTED
DENIED
REVOKED
EXPIRED
```

---

## 6. Consent撤销

撤销后：

```text
停止未来处理
清理相关Cache
调整模型路由
执行删除或保留政策
记录审计
```

---

## 7. Privacy UI

用户应理解：

```text
收集什么
为何收集
传给谁
保留多久
如何撤销
```

---

## 8. Model Provider

需要明确：

```text
Data Region
Retention
Training Use
Subprocessor候选
```

---

## 9. Privacy Impact

新高风险数据处理生成Privacy Review和Approval。

---

## 10. Data Subject Operations

候选支持：

```text
Access
Export
Correction
Deletion
Restriction
```

并与G23数据生命周期绑定。

---

# Skill FRT-2918：Retention and Deletion Compliance

建议路径：

```text
skills/retention-deletion-compliance/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

从安全、隐私、审计和业务约束角度验证数据保留与删除。

---

## 2. 覆盖位置

```text
Primary Database
Replica
Cache
Search
Artifact
Evidence
Analytics
Log
Trace
Offline Store
Backup
Model Context Cache
```

---

## 3. Deletion Request

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: CompliantDeletionRequest

metadata:
  id: deletion://account/001

spec:
  subject:
    accountId: account-001

  scope:
    - profile
    - sessions
    - cached-data
    - model-context

  exceptions:
    - required-financial-audit
    - legal-hold

  verification:
    required: true
```

---

## 4. Retention冲突

例如：

```text
用户请求删除
vs
财务审计保留
```

必须明确：

```text
保留哪些最小字段
以什么形式保留
谁可访问
保留多久
```

---

## 5. Cryptographic Erasure

加密数据可通过销毁专用Key实现不可恢复候选，但需证据。

---

## 6. Tombstone

防止离线或延迟Event重新创建已删除数据。

---

## 7. Log和Trace

日志中的个人数据必须最小化，不能因“日志”无限期保留。

---

## 8. Backup

备份按自然过期或受控恢复后重新执行删除。

---

## 9. Deletion Certificate

包含：

```text
请求
位置
执行结果
保留例外
失败位置
验证结果
```

---

# Skill FRT-2919：Security Incident Response Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/security-incident-response-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为安全告警、数据泄漏、供应链和权限事件生成正式响应Workflow。

---

## 2. Incident类型

```text
Unauthorized Access
Cross-Tenant Leak
Credential Compromise
Malicious Pack
Malicious Skill
Worker Escape
Prompt Injection
Tool Abuse
Artifact Tampering
Certificate Forgery
Data Exfiltration
Dependency Compromise
```

---

## 3. Incident状态

```text
OPEN
TRIAGED
INVESTIGATING
CONTAINING
ERADICATING
RECOVERING
MONITORING
CLOSED
```

---

## 4. Incident Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SecurityIncident

metadata:
  id: incident://cross-tenant-artifact/001

spec:
  severity: critical

  affectedAssets:
    - artifact-store

  suspectedScope:
    tenants:
      - tenant-a
      - tenant-b

  containment:
    - revoke-download-tokens
    - disable-affected-endpoint

  evidencePreservation:
    required: true

  owners:
    incidentCommander: team://security
```

---

## 5. Triage

判断：

```text
真实性
Severity
资产
Tenant范围
攻击持续性
Containment需求
通知义务候选
```

---

## 6. Containment动作

```text
撤销Token
禁用账号
暂停Workspace
禁用Pack
隔离Worker
关闭Endpoint
撤销Certificate
阻止Delivery
```

---

## 7. Evidence Preservation

保留：

```text
Audit
Trace
Artifact
请求
Token Metadata
Worker Image
Pack Digest
```

同时避免破坏证据。

---

## 8. Eradication

```text
修复漏洞
移除恶意组件
轮换Secret
更新Policy
清理Persistence
```

---

## 9. Recovery

```text
恢复服务
对账数据
重新扫描
重新测试
重新认证
逐步开放
```

---

## 10. Post-Incident

生成：

```text
Root Cause
Timeline
Impact
Detection Gap
Control Gap
Test
Mutation
Runbook
Owner
Deadline
```

---

## 11. Incident到回归

真实Incident必须转化为：

```text
Regression Test
Mutation
Threat Model Update
Attack Surface Update
```

---

# Skill FRT-2920：Penetration Test Evidence Manager

建议路径：

```text
skills/penetration-test-evidence-manager/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

管理人工渗透测试Scope、Finding、Retest和安全证书绑定。

---

## 2. Penetration Scope

```text
Release
Environment
Domains
APIs
Roles
Tenants
Excluded Operations
Test Window
Rules of Engagement
```

---

## 3. Evidence Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PenetrationTestEngagement

metadata:
  id: pentest://release-g29

spec:
  scope:
    release:
      ref: release://g29-candidate

    environment:
      ref: environment://security-test

  testers:
    - approved-security-team

  rules:
    productionSideEffectsForbidden: true

  findings:
    artifactRef: artifact://pentest-findings
```

---

## 4. Finding内容

```text
Title
Asset
Entry Point
Preconditions
Steps
Impact
Evidence
Severity
Remediation
Owner
```

---

## 5. Retest

Finding只有在：

```text
修复部署
原步骤失败
变体测试通过
回归测试加入
```

后才能关闭。

---

## 6. Scope Drift

Release或环境变化后，旧Pentest Evidence可能STALE。

---

## 7. 人工Finding保护

敏感漏洞细节按最小权限访问。

---

## 8. Certificate绑定

SC5候选要求关键攻击面具备近期、匹配Scope的人工渗透证据。

# Skill FRT-2921：Secure Admin Console Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/secure-admin-console-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

专门验证管理端、高风险操作、批量处理、导出和Break-Glass安全。

---

## 2. 管理端风险

```text
高权限
高信息密度
批量操作
数据导出
人工修复
证书撤销
用户权限
安全Containment
```

---

## 3. Admin Security Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AdminSecurityContract

metadata:
  id: admin-security://certificate-revoke

spec:
  authentication:
    reauthenticationRequired: true

  authorization:
    roles:
      - security-reviewer

  separationOfDuties:
    required: true

  impactPreview:
    required: true

  reason:
    required: true

  audit:
    required: true
```

---

## 4. 高风险操作

需要候选：

```text
MFA
重新认证
双审批
短期Session
设备限制
```

---

## 5. 导出

验证：

```text
Scope
字段脱敏
Watermark
Expiry
下载次数
审计
```

---

## 6. Bulk Operation

防止：

```text
Scope漂移
全选误操作
隐藏失败
无上限执行
重放
```

---

## 7. Impersonation

Impersonation下默认禁止：

```text
权限提升
Certificate签发
Secret管理
高金额退款
```

---

## 8. Break-Glass

持续显示状态，并记录全部操作。

---

## 9. Admin XSS

管理端显示的：

```text
Repository名
Pack描述
错误
备注
审计字段
```

均不可信。

---

## 10. Audit防篡改

管理员不能删除或修改自己的高风险审计。

# Skill FRT-2922：Security Regression and Recertification

建议路径：

```text
skills/security-regression-recertification/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

把G29所有安全结论纳入每次变更和Release的持续重新认证。

---

## 2. 触发条件

```text
Code Change
API Change
Permission Change
Schema Change
Pack Change
Skill Change
Dependency Change
Container Change
Model Change
Policy Change
Environment Change
New Vulnerability
Security Incident
```

---

## 3. Impacted Security Selection

根据变化选择：

```text
Threat Model
SAST
DAST
Authorization Matrix
Tenant Isolation
Supply Chain
Fuzz
Privacy
Pentest Retest
```

---

## 4. Security等级

建议定义：

```text
SC0：Unassessed
SC1：Assets and Threats Modeled
SC2：Identity, Access and API Controls Verified
SC3：SAST, DAST and Supply Chain Verified
SC4：Fuzz, Privacy and Incident Response Verified
SC5：Penetration-Tested and Release Certified
SC6：Continuously Re-Certified
```

---

## 5. Re-Certification状态

```text
VALID
STALE
RETEST_REQUIRED
REVOKED
SUPERSEDED
```

---

## 6. Security Certificate

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SecurityCertificate

metadata:
  id: certificate://security/release-g29
  version: 1

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g29-candidate

  scope:
    commitDigest: sha256
    packLockDigest: sha256
    dependencyLockDigest: sha256
    containerDigest: sha256
    policyDigest: sha256
    environmentDigest: sha256

  qualification:
    requested: SC5
    achieved: SC5

  validations:
    threatModel: pass
    authentication: pass
    authorization: pass
    tenantIsolation: pass
    apiSecurity: pass
    injection: pass
    fileSecurity: pass
    secrets: pass
    supplyChain: pass
    sbom: pass
    sast: pass
    dast: pass
    fuzzing: pass
    privacy: pass
    incidentResponse: pass
    penetrationTest: pass
```

---

## 7. Critical Finding

任何Critical未解决Finding阻断SC5。

---

## 8. 新漏洞

影响运行Artifact时：

```text
Security Certificate → STALE
Release → Requalification Required
```

---


```text
Signing Key
```

```text
Payment

```

# 六、核心攻击者模型

## 6.1 Anonymous External Attacker

目标：

```text
发现入口
枚举对象
注入
DoS
窃取数据
```

---

## 6.2 Authenticated Low-Privilege User

目标：

```text
权限提升
跨Workspace访问
读取Artifact
创建高成本任务
```

---

## 6.3 Malicious Tenant Administrator

目标：

```text
影响其他Tenant
绕过配额
批量导出
操纵Audit
```

---

## 6.4 Compromised Account

攻击者拥有合法Session或Token。

---

## 6.5 Malicious Repository

通过源码、README、脚本和配置攻击Parser、模型和Build。

---

## 6.6 Malicious Pack / Skill Publisher

尝试：

```text
申请高权限
访问Secret
执行网络调用
修改Policy
关闭验证
```

---

## 6.7 Compromised Worker

尝试读取其他Job或Tenant数据。

---

## 6.8 Compromised Dependency

通过供应链进入Build或Runtime。

---

## 6.9 Prompt Injection Attacker

利用不可信文本诱导Agent扩大Capability或泄漏数据。

---

## 6.10 Insider

拥有合法高权限但滥用访问。

需要：

```text
Separation of Duties
Audit
Approval
Anomaly Detection
```

---

# 七、AI与Agent安全专章

## 7.1 Context分层

```text
System Policy
Security Policy
Task Contract
Approved Context
Untrusted Repository Content
Model Output
```

必须保留来源标签。

---

## 7.2 Prompt Injection规则

不可信内容不得：

```text
修改System Policy
新增Tool
修改Tool Permission
访问其他Tenant Memory
要求输出Secret
关闭测试
改变Certificate状态
```

---

## 7.3 Tool Invocation Gate

```text
Model Proposal
→ Schema Validation
→ Capability Check
→ Tenant Scope
→ Approval Check
→ Risk Policy
→ Idempotency
→ Tool Execution
```

---

## 7.4 Tool输出

Tool结果仍视为外部输入，需要Schema和业务验证。

---

## 7.5 Memory Poisoning

写入长期Memory前需要：

```text
来源验证
Scope
Purpose
Security Label
Expiry
```

---

## 7.6 Retrieval Poisoning

RAG结果需要：

```text
Tenant过滤
来源
Trust Level
Freshness
```

---

## 7.7 Model Exfiltration

检测Prompt是否试图请求：

```text
Secret
System Prompt
其他Tenant内容
内部Policy
```

---

## 7.8 Agent Loop Abuse

限制：

```text
最大步骤
最大Tool调用
最大成本
最大副作用
Deadline
```

---

## 7.9 Approval Token

高风险Tool Approval绑定：

```text
Run
Tool
Arguments Digest
Scope
Expiry
Approver
```

参数改变后Approval失效。

---

## 7.10 Model Provider隔离

敏感任务只能使用批准Provider或本地模型。

---

# 八、统一Security Control Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SecurityControlContract

metadata:
  id: security-control://artifact-download

spec:
  protects:
    assets:
      - source-code-artifact

  prevents:
    - unauthorized-access
    - cross-tenant-access
    - bulk-exfiltration

  implementation:
    - authentication
    - resource-level-authorization
    - scoped-download-token
    - rate-limit

  detects:
    - failed-scope-check-alert
    - abnormal-download-volume

  responds:
    - revoke-token
    - suspend-session
```

---

# 九、统一Security Finding Model

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: SecurityFinding

metadata:
  id: security-finding://artifact-cross-tenant/001

spec:
  source:
    type: dast

  asset:
    ref: asset://artifact-store

  threat:
    ref: threat://cross-tenant-artifact-access

  severity: critical

  exploit:
    preconditions:
      - authenticated-low-privilege-user

    impact:
      - confidential-source-code-disclosure

  evidence:
    artifactRef: artifact://security-reproduction

  remediation:
    owner: team://artifact-platform

  release:
    blocking: true
```

# 十一、G29 CLI

## 发现资产

```bash
frt security assets discover \
  --project frt-platform
```

---

## 生成Threat Model

```bash
frt security threats generate \
  --capabilities critical \
  --output .frt/security-assurance/threat-models
```

---

## 构建Attack Surface

```bash
frt security surface inventory \
  --repositories ./repositories \
  --environments production-profile
```

---

## 验证认证安全

```bash
frt security authentication verify \
  --flows login,sso,recovery,mfa
```

---

## 验证授权

```bash
frt security authorization test \
  --matrix critical-actions
```

---

## 验证Tenant隔离

```bash
frt security tenant-isolation test \
  --layers api,database,cache,event,artifact,model
```

---

## 验证Session和Token

```bash
frt security token verify \
  --types session,refresh,artifact,worker,approval
```

```bash
frt security api test \
  --scope public,admin,internal,webhook
```

---

## 运行注入测试

```bash
frt security injection test \
  --types sql,command,path,ssrf,xss,prompt
```

---

## 验证文件安全

```bash
frt security files test \
  --profiles repository-archive,artifact-upload
```

---

## 扫描Secret

```bash
frt security secrets scan \
  --scope source,history,artifact,logs,images
```

---

## 验证供应链

```bash
frt security supply-chain verify \
  --components skills,packs,containers,dependencies,models
```

---

```bash
frt security sbom generate \
  --release release://g29-candidate
```

---

## 执行漏洞治理

```bash
frt security vulnerabilities assess \
  --sbom .frt/security-assurance/sbom
```

---

## 运行SAST

```bash
frt security sast run \
  --repositories ./repositories \
  --rules release-critical
```

---

## 运行DAST

```bash
frt security dast run \
  --environment environment://security-test \
  --profiles anonymous,user,admin,cross-tenant
```

---

```bash
frt security fuzz run \
  --targets api,event,manifest,repository-parser \
  --duration policy-defined
```

---

## 验证Abuse防护

```bash
frt security abuse test \
  --scenarios credential-stuffing,artifact-scraping,model-cost
```

---

## 验证隐私

```bash
frt security privacy verify \
  --data-flows .frt/data-integrity/lineage
```

---

## 验证删除合规

```bash
frt security deletion verify \
  --subject synthetic-account-001 \
  --full-lifecycle
```

---

## 执行Incident演练

```bash
frt security incident drill \
  --scenario malicious-pack
```

---

## 导入渗透测试

```bash
frt security pentest import \
  --engagement pentest://release-g29
```

---

## 运行安全回归

```bash
frt security regression run \
  --release release://g29-candidate
```

```bash
frt security certify \
  --release release://g29-candidate \
```

# 十二、G29 Diagnostics

错误前缀：

```text
FRT-SEC-ASSET
FRT-THREAT-MODEL
FRT-ATTACK-SURFACE
FRT-AUTHENTICATION
FRT-AUTHORIZATION
FRT-TENANT-SECURITY
FRT-SESSION-TOKEN
FRT-API-SECURITY
FRT-INJECTION
FRT-FILE-SECURITY
FRT-SECRET
FRT-SUPPLY-CHAIN
FRT-SBOM
FRT-VULNERABILITY
FRT-SAST
FRT-DAST
FRT-FUZZ
FRT-ABUSE
FRT-PRIVACY
FRT-DELETION-COMPLIANCE
FRT-SEC-INCIDENT
FRT-PENTEST
FRT-ADMIN-SECURITY
FRT-SECURITY-RECERT
```

示例：

```text
FRT-SEC-ASSET-0012
R5 Source Artifact没有Security Owner。

FRT-THREAT-MODEL-0018
Delivery Tool没有Prompt Injection Abuse Case。

FRT-ATTACK-SURFACE-0021
发现未登记的Production Admin API。

FRT-AUTHENTICATION-0008
登录Callback没有验证State和Nonce。

FRT-AUTHENTICATION-0014
MFA Reset不需要加强认证或审批。

FRT-AUTHORIZATION-0011
前端隐藏Certificate Issue按钮，
但API缺少服务端权限校验。

FRT-AUTHORIZATION-0017
Artifact类型权限通过，
但未验证Artifact所属Workspace。

FRT-TENANT-SECURITY-0006
Model Retrieval混入其他Tenant历史内容。

FRT-TENANT-SECURITY-0013
Artifact Download Token未绑定Workspace。

FRT-SESSION-TOKEN-0007
Refresh Token可重复使用且无Reuse Detection。

FRT-SESSION-TOKEN-0019
权限撤销后旧Session继续拥有原权限。

FRT-API-SECURITY-0005
客户端可通过Mass Assignment修改Role字段。

FRT-API-SECURITY-0016
Admin Search接口允许返回其他Workspace数据。

FRT-INJECTION-0008
Repository路径可通过编码后的Traversal逃逸工作目录。

FRT-INJECTION-0014
模型输出被直接拼接为Shell Command。

FRT-INJECTION-0020
用户URL可访问内部Metadata Endpoint。

FRT-FILE-SECURITY-0006
Repository Archive可通过Symlink读取Sandbox外文件。

FRT-FILE-SECURITY-0013
嵌套压缩包没有深度和总大小限制。

FRT-SECRET-0009
Model Provider Key出现在错误Trace中。

FRT-SECRET-0017
Certificate Signing Key可被普通Worker读取。

FRT-SUPPLY-CHAIN-0005
内部Pack名称可从公共Registry解析同名包。

FRT-SUPPLY-CHAIN-0014
Production Skill未绑定签名和Provenance。

FRT-SBOM-0008
Container中的系统Package未进入SBOM。

FRT-VULNERABILITY-0019
Critical漏洞可达Artifact Download路径且未修复。

FRT-SAST-0011
Generated Code中发现Command Injection，
但Generator Rule未被标记受影响。

FRT-DAST-0007
错误Tenant用户可读取Payment Case详情。

FRT-FUZZ-0016
畸形Pack Manifest导致Parser内存无限增长。

FRT-ABUSE-0009
攻击者可通过多个Session绕过Model Token Quota。

FRT-PRIVACY-0013
Repository源码被发送给未批准的模型Provider。

FRT-PRIVACY-0018
Consent撤销后旧Context Cache仍被模型使用。

FRT-DELETION-COMPLIANCE-0006
账号删除后Search Index和离线副本仍保留个人数据。

FRT-SEC-INCIDENT-0015
Malicious Pack事件没有自动禁用受影响版本。

FRT-PENTEST-0004
渗透测试对应旧Commit，不能覆盖当前Release。

FRT-ADMIN-SECURITY-0012
Impersonation Session可以执行Certificate签发。

FRT-SECURITY-RECERT-0002
新增Critical Dependency漏洞，现有SC5证书已失效。
```

# 十五、G29安全治理

## 15.1 Security Policy修改

高风险Policy变更必须：

```text
独立PR候选
双审批
Impact分析
回归
审计
```

---

## 15.2 Finding Suppression

Critical Finding不能通过普通Comment关闭。

需要正式Exception Policy。

---

## 15.3 Security Tool隔离

SAST、DAST、Fuzz和Pentest Worker使用独立Trust Zone和最小Credential。

---

## 15.4 Evidence访问

漏洞复现、Secret事件和Pentest报告按最小权限访问。

---

## 15.5 Security Data Retention

安全证据根据事件和合规要求保留，但敏感内容应最小化。

---

## 15.6 第三方测试

第三方安全人员使用：

```text
专用账号
专用环境
明确Scope
短期Credential
```

---

## 15.7 Critical Security Action

以下动作需加强控制：

```text
撤销Certificate
撤销Signing Key
禁用Pack
暂停Organization
大规模Session撤销
```

---

# 十六、G29实施顺序

建议顺序：

```text
1. FRT-2901 Threat Model Generator

2. FRT-2902 Attack Surface Inventory

3. FRT-2903 Authentication Security Validator

4. FRT-2904 Authorization and Policy Validator

5. FRT-2905 Tenant Isolation Security Validator

6. FRT-2906 Session and Token Security Validator

7. FRT-2907 API Security Validator

8. FRT-2908 Input Validation and Injection Validator

9. FRT-2909 File Upload and Content Security Validator

10. FRT-2910 Secrets and Key Management Validator

11. FRT-2911 Supply Chain Security Validator

12. FRT-2912 SBOM and Vulnerability Governance

13. FRT-2913 SAST Coordinator

14. FRT-2914 DAST Coordinator

15. FRT-2915 Fuzzing and Protocol Abuse Generator

16. FRT-2916 Rate Abuse and Bot Protection Validator

17. FRT-2917 Privacy and Consent Validator

18. FRT-2918 Retention and Deletion Compliance

19. FRT-2919 Security Incident Response Generator

20. FRT-2920 Penetration Test Evidence Manager

21. FRT-2921 Secure Admin Console Validator

22. FRT-2922 Security Regression and Recertification

23. FRT-2900 Security Assurance Orchestrator
```

必须先建立Asset、Threat Model和Attack Surface，否则后续扫描容易沦为没有业务上下文的工具结果集合。

---

# 十七、G29阶段里程碑

## Milestone 1：Asset、Threat与Surface

完成所有关键资产、信任边界和攻击入口建模。

---

## Milestone 2：Identity and Access

完成：

```text
Authentication
Authorization
Tenant Isolation
Session
Token
```

闭环。

---

## Milestone 3：API、Input和File Security

消除主要外部输入和注入风险。

---

## Milestone 4：Secret与Supply Chain

完成Secret、Key、Skill、Pack、Container和Dependency安全。

---

## Milestone 5：SBOM与漏洞治理

形成从组件到Artifact、Release和Certificate的影响链。

---

## Milestone 6：SAST、DAST与Fuzzing

完成静态、动态和协议滥用验证。

---

## Milestone 7：Abuse与Privacy

完成成本攻击、Bot、Consent、最小化和删除合规。

---

## Milestone 8：Incident Response

完成Critical Incident的检测、Containment、恢复和复盘演练。

---

## Milestone 9：Penetration Test

关键攻击面通过匹配Release的人工渗透与Retest。

---

## Milestone 10：SC5 Certification

签发Security Certificate。

---

# 二十、G29完成后的系统状态

完成G29后，系统将从：

```text
系统在各类基础设施和依赖故障下仍能安全恢复
```

推进到：

```text
系统面对恶意用户、越权、注入、供应链攻击、
恶意Skill和Pack、Prompt Injection、凭证窃取、
数据泄漏与协议滥用时，
仍能够预防、检测、限制、响应并持续重新认证。
```

系统能够确保：

```text
所有高价值资产和Trust Boundary均已识别；

每个关键Capability具有Threat Model和Abuse Case；

所有Production入口均进入Attack Surface Inventory；

身份认证、Session、Token和恢复流程受到统一治理；

权限在服务端、对象级、字段级和Tenant级执行；

跨租户数据、Cache、Event、Artifact和模型Context保持隔离；

API、输入、文件和Repository内容均按不可信输入处理；

模型不能因Prompt Injection扩大Tool Capability；

Secret和Signing Key不会进入源码、日志、Prompt和普通Artifact；

Skill、Pack、Container、Dependency和Model均具备签名、
Digest、SBOM和Provenance；

SAST、DAST、Fuzzing和人工Pentest形成互补验证；

高成本操作、数据导出和批量操作受到Abuse防护；

敏感数据按Purpose、Consent、最小化和Retention使用；

删除请求覆盖主数据、缓存、索引、离线副本和备份策略；

安全事件能够快速Contain、保留Evidence、恢复和重新认证；

任何代码、依赖、Policy、Pack、模型或环境变化，
都会自动使受影响的安全Evidence和Certificate重新验证。
```

下一批 **Generation Batch G30** 将完成最终Production收口，专门展开：

```text
Production Readiness Checklist
Service Catalog
SLI / SLO
Business SLI
Observability Coverage
Alert Quality
Runbook Completeness
On-Call Readiness
Incident Management
Release Train
Canary and Progressive Delivery
Feature Flag Safety
Automated Rollback
Database and Data Cutover
Legacy Coexistence
Customer Support Readiness
Operational Dashboard
Continuous Verification
Continuous Security Recertification
Continuous Performance Recertification
Production Closure Certificate
Post-Release Verification
Production Incident Learning
```

也就是从：

```text
系统的需求、业务、数据、管理、可用性、测试、
性能、韧性和安全均已分别通过认证
```

推进到：

```text
所有认证、运行指标、发布策略、告警、值班、
回滚、数据切换、客户支持和持续重新认证
汇聚成唯一Production Release Gate，
系统可以正式上线、持续运营并从真实事故中进化。
```

## Response:
G30会把前九个闭环证书汇聚成唯一上线决策：服务目录、SLI/SLO、告警、值班、发布、灰度、回滚、数据切换、客户支持和持续再认证将共同决定系统是否真正Production Ready。

下面是最终收口批次 **Generation Batch G30**，它不再增加孤立功能，而是把G21–G29全部认证、运行证据和运营机制汇聚成唯一的Production Release Authority。

**document: **

# Generation Batch G30：Production Readiness、SRE运营、渐进发布、自动回滚与持续认证总收口 Skills

## 一、G30总体定位

G21–G29已经分别完成：

```text
G21  Requirement Traceability与功能闭环
G22  业务状态机、Saga、补偿与对账闭环
G23  数据Contract、Authority与全生命周期闭环
G24  管理端、审批、修正与运营闭环
G25  任务可完成性、Accessibility与多端可用性闭环
G26  全系统回归与Release Qualification
G27  高并发、性能、容量与安全降级认证
G28  高可用、故障隔离、备份恢复与DR认证
G29  身份、权限、供应链、隐私与安全认证
```

系统已经分别获得：

```text
FC：Functional Closure Certificate
BC：Business Closure Certificate
DC：Data Integrity Certificate
AC：Admin Completeness Certificate
UX：Usability Certificate
RQ：Regression Qualification Certificate
PC：Performance and Capacity Certificate
RC：Resilience Certificate
SC：Security Certificate
```

但是，九类证书分别通过，仍不自动等于可以正式上线。

系统仍可能出现：

```text
所有测试都通过，但没有正式Service Owner；

有性能证书，但没有Production SLO和Error Budget；

有告警，但告警无法指导操作；

有Runbook，但值班人员从未演练；

有Canary方案，但无法自动停止错误扩散；

Feature Flag上线后永久保留，形成多套隐藏逻辑；

应用可回滚，但数据库Schema无法回退；

新旧系统并行运行，却存在双写和双Authority；

发布完成后没有验证真实Production Journey；

安全证书有效，但新依赖漏洞上线后未自动失效；

客户遇到问题时，Support无法查询Job、Artifact和Case；

事故解决后没有转化为测试、Mutation和架构改进；

不同团队拥有不同上线结论，没有唯一Release Authority。
```

G30负责建立：

> 将需求、业务、数据、管理、可用性、回归、性能、韧性和安全证书，与Service Catalog、SLI/SLO、业务指标、Observability、告警、Runbook、On-Call、Incident、Release Train、Canary、Feature Flag、Rollback、Data Cutover、Legacy Coexistence、Customer Support和Continuous Recertification统一汇聚为唯一Production Release Gate。

最终闭环：

```text
Service Ownership
      │
      ▼
Production Readiness
      │
      ├── Functional Certificate
      ├── Business Certificate
      ├── Data Certificate
      ├── Admin Certificate
      ├── Usability Certificate
      ├── Regression Certificate
      ├── Performance Certificate
      ├── Resilience Certificate
      └── Security Certificate
      │
      ▼
Release Qualification
      │
      ├── Release Train
      ├── Canary
      ├── Feature Flags
      ├── Data Cutover
      ├── Rollback
      └── Support Readiness
      │
      ▼
Production Deployment
      │
      ▼
Post-Release Verification
      │
      ▼
Continuous Monitoring
      │
      ├── SLI / SLO
      ├── Business SLI
      ├── Error Budget
      ├── Alerts
      └── On-Call
      │
      ▼
Incident / Learning / Re-Certification
```

# 二、G30最终目标

完成G30后，平台必须能够回答：

```text
每个Production Service由谁负责？

服务的用户、依赖、数据和风险是什么？

哪些SLI反映技术健康？

哪些Business SLI反映业务是否真正成功？

SLO是否与用户和业务价值相关？

Error Budget耗尽后是否停止高风险发布？

所有关键操作是否具备Metrics、Logs、Traces和Audit？

告警是否可行动，而不是只制造噪声？

每个Critical Alert是否有Owner和Runbook？

On-Call人员是否具备权限、环境和演练经验？

事故由谁担任Incident Commander？

Release什么时候进入、什么时候退出？

Canary依据哪些技术和业务指标放量？

哪些Feature Flag需要Owner、Expiry和清理计划？

何时自动回滚？

回滚是否覆盖应用、配置、数据和队列？

数据库Cutover如何防止数据丢失和双写？

新旧系统共存期间谁是Authority？

客户支持如何定位Migration、Job、Artifact和Certificate问题？

上线后如何验证关键用户和管理员Journey？

运行中出现的新漏洞、性能回归和业务漂移如何重新认证？

真实事故如何转化为Requirement、Test、Mutation、Threat Model和Runbook？

最终由什么机制决定Production Ready或阻断发布？
```

---

# 三、G30核心原则

## 3.1 Production Ready是运行状态，不是项目阶段

Production Readiness不是一次性检查表。

它必须持续满足：

```text
功能仍然闭环；
业务状态仍然合法；
数据仍然一致；
权限仍然安全；
SLO仍然达标；
证书仍然有效；
Runbook仍然可执行；
On-Call仍然就绪。
```

---

## 3.2 唯一Production Release Authority

任何团队、模型、CI任务或管理员都不能单独宣布Production Ready。

最终Authority必须是：

```text
Production Closure Governor
```

它读取：

```text
九类闭环Certificate
Production Readiness Checklist
Service Ownership
SLO状态
Error Budget
Open Incidents
Blocking Findings
Change Risk
Release Plan
Rollback Plan
Support Readiness
```

后作出唯一决定。

---

## 3.3 Service Catalog是运营语义Anchor

所有：

```text
API
Worker
Queue Consumer
Database
Artifact Store
Admin Console
Domain Service
```

都必须归属一个Service。

每个Service必须具有：

```text
Owner
Business Capability
Criticality
Dependencies
Data
SLI / SLO
Alerts
Runbooks
On-Call
Deployment
Certificates
```

---

## 3.4 SLI必须反映用户体验或业务结果

错误SLI：

```text
服务器进程存活。
```

更有价值的SLI：

```text
用户能够成功查询Job状态；
管理员能够成功撤销Compromised Session；
Migration Step能在Deadline内被调度；
Certificate能被正确验证。
```

---

## 3.5 Business SLI与技术SLI必须同时存在

服务可用不代表业务成功。

例如：

```text
Payment API返回200，
但服务端确认率下降；

Migration Job持续运行，
但最终Certificate签发率下降；

通知Provider接受消息，
但Delivery成功率下降。
```

---

## 3.6 SLO必须驱动决策

SLO不是Dashboard装饰。

必须影响：

```text
Release速度
Canary比例
Feature Flag开放
容量扩展
Incident优先级
技术债偿还
```

---

## 3.7 Alert必须指向行动

告警至少回答：

```text
什么用户或业务受到影响？

影响多大？

谁负责？

先做什么？

在哪里查看证据？

何时升级？

何时可以关闭？
```

---

## 3.8 页面浏览量和日志量不是Observability Coverage

完整Observability必须覆盖：

```text
Metrics
Logs
Traces
Business Events
Audit
Profiles候选
Synthetic Probes
Dependency Health
```

并能关联到：

```text
Tenant
Workspace
Migration
Job
Execution
Artifact
Certificate
```

---

## 3.9 Release必须可停止和可逆

每次Release必须具备：

```text
暂停
停止放量
回滚
降级
Feature Flag关闭
数据Forward Fix
Legacy回切
```

至少一种安全恢复路径。

---

## 3.10 Canary必须根据业务正确性放量

不能只观察：

```text
CPU
Memory
HTTP 500
```

还必须观察：

```text
关键Journey成功率
业务状态异常
数据差异
跨租户Finding
Payment Unknown
Certificate失败
人工Case增长
```

---

## 3.11 Feature Flag不是永久架构层

每个Flag必须有：

```text
Owner
Purpose
Created Date
Expiry
Default
Kill Switch
Targeting
Removal Plan
```

过期Flag必须删除或正式转为配置。

---

## 3.12 自动回滚必须识别数据不可逆性

应用代码可以回滚，不代表：

```text
已写入的新Schema数据
已发布的Event
已发送的通知
已执行的支付
已生成的设备命令
```

可以回滚。

需要区分：

```text
Application Rollback
Configuration Rollback
Traffic Rollback
Data Rollback
Forward Fix
Compensation
```

---

## 3.13 数据Cutover必须有Authority切换点

新旧系统共存时必须明确：

```text
Read Authority
Write Authority
Event Authority
Reconciliation Authority
```

不能两个系统同时自认为最终Authority。

---

## 3.14 发布完成不等于上线成功

发布后必须验证：

```text
真实Production配置
真实Routing
真实权限
真实数据路径
真实监控
关键用户Journey
关键Admin Journey
```

---

## 3.15 Incident关闭不等于学习完成

事故关闭后必须形成：

```text
Root Cause
Requirement变化
Architecture变化
Test
Mutation
Chaos Scenario
Threat Model变化
Runbook变化
Owner与Deadline
```

---

## 3.16 安全、韧性和性能认证必须持续失效传播

以下变化必须使相关Certificate变为STALE或RETEST_REQUIRED：

```text
代码
Dependency
Pack
Skill
Model
Policy
Schema
Topology
Provider
Workload
Incident
```

---

## 3.17 客户支持是Production闭环的一部分

Support必须能够：

```text
确认用户和Scope
查询对象状态
查看脱敏时间线
创建Case
升级工程或安全团队
向客户提供准确状态
```

而不是要求客户联系开发者查数据库。

---

## 3.18 运行期手工操作必须进入Evidence Graph

生产操作、Incident、Rollback、Feature Flag变化、数据修复和Support Case都必须形成Evidence。

---

# Skill FRT-3000：Production Readiness Orchestrator

建议路径：

```text
skills/production-readiness-orchestrator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

统一编排Service Catalog、Readiness、SLO、Observability、Release、Cutover、Support和Continuous Recertification，并作出最终上线判断。

---

## 2. 输入

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ProductionReadinessRequest

metadata:
  projectId: project://frt-platform
  runId: production-readiness://release-g30-001

spec:
  release:
    ref: release://g30-candidate

  certificates:
    functional:
      ref: certificate://functional/current

    business:
      ref: certificate://business/current

    data:
      ref: certificate://data/current

    admin:
      ref: certificate://admin/current

    usability:
      ref: certificate://usability/current

    regression:
      ref: certificate://regression/current

    performance:
      ref: certificate://performance/current

    resilience:
      ref: certificate://resilience/current

    security:
      ref: certificate://security/current

  targetEnvironment:
    ref: environment://production

  requestedLevel:
    critical: PR5
```

---

## 3. 输出

```text
Production Readiness Checklist
Service Catalog
SLI / SLO Registry
Business SLI Registry
Observability Coverage Report
Alert Quality Report
Runbook Report
On-Call Plan
Release Plan
Canary Plan
Feature Flag Plan
Rollback Plan
Data Cutover Plan
Legacy Coexistence Plan
Support Readiness Report
Continuous Verification Plan
Production Closure Decision
Production Closure Certificate
```

---

## 4. 工作流

```text
加载九类Certificate
→ 验证Certificate Scope与Freshness
→ 构建Service Catalog
→ 编译Readiness Checklist
→ 验证SLI / SLO
→ 验证Observability、Alert、Runbook和On-Call
→ 编译Release Train
→ 验证Canary与Feature Flag
→ 验证Rollback
→ 验证Data Cutover与Legacy Coexistence
→ 验证Support Readiness
→ 模拟Release和Incident
→ 作出Production Gate决定
→ 部署
→ Post-Release Verification
→ 启动Continuous Recertification
→ 签发Production Closure Certificate
```

---

## 5. 状态机

```text
DRAFT
→ CERTIFICATES_VALIDATED
→ SERVICES_REGISTERED
→ OPERATIONS_VALIDATED
→ RELEASE_PLAN_VALIDATED
→ CUTOVER_VALIDATED
→ SUPPORT_VALIDATED
→ READY_FOR_RELEASE
→ RELEASING
→ VERIFYING_PRODUCTION
→ PRODUCTION_ACTIVE
→ CONTINUOUSLY_CERTIFIED
```

阻断状态：

```text
BLOCKED_BY_STALE_CERTIFICATE
BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_SERVICE_OWNER
BLOCKED_BY_SLO_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_OBSERVABILITY_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_ALERT_OR_RUNBOOK_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_ROLLBACK_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_CUTOVER_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_SUPPORT_GAP
BLOCKED_BY_PRODUCTION_VERIFICATION
```

---

## 6. 唯一Gate结果

```text
PRODUCTION_READY
READY_FOR_CANARY_ONLY
READY_WITH_APPROVED_EXCLUSIONS
BLOCKED
INCONCLUSIVE
STALE
EMERGENCY_RELEASE_ONLY
```

---

## 7. 非补偿式规则

以下任一存在，不能被其他维度高分补偿：

```text
Critical Certificate失效
Critical Service无Owner
Critical SLO未定义
Critical Alert无Runbook
Critical Rollback不可用
Critical Data Cutover未演练
Critical Security Incident未关闭
Critical Support路径缺失
```

---

```text
Requirement
```

```text
Runbooks
On-Call

Rollback
Cutover
Support
Compliance
```

```text
NOT_EVALUATED
PASS
FAIL
INCONCLUSIVE
APPROVED_EXCEPTION
STALE
NOT_APPLICABLE
```

```text
Runbook
演练
Certificate
或独立Review
```

```text
说明原因
Owner批准
证明不适用
```

```text
风险
范围
有效期
补偿控制
Owner
目标修复时间
```

模板。

# Skill FRT-3002：Service Catalog Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/service-catalog-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

建立所有Production Service、组件、Owner、依赖和运行契约的权威目录。

---

## 2. Service类型

```text
API Service
Control Plane Service
Worker Service
Stateful Service
Queue Consumer
Scheduled Job
Data Service
Artifact Service
Security Service
Admin Application
Client Application
External Adapter
```

---

## 3. Service Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceCatalogEntry

metadata:
  id: service://workflow-engine
  name: Workflow Engine
  version: 1

spec:
  capabilities:
    - migration-orchestration
    - job-control

  criticality: R5

  owners:
    product: team://migration-product
    engineering: team://workflow-runtime
    operations: team://platform-sre
    security: team://platform-security

  dependencies:
    - database://workflow-state
    - queue://workflow-events
    - service://policy-engine

  data:
    contracts:
      - data-contract://workflow-state

  operations:
    sli:
      - sli://workflow/job-control-success

    slo:
      - slo://workflow/job-control

    alerts:
      - alert://workflow/stuck-job

    runbooks:
      - runbook://workflow/stuck-job
```

---

## 4. 服务边界

每个Service必须明确：

```text
输入
输出
Authority
状态
依赖
副作用
数据
权限
```

---

## 5. Owner完整性

Critical Service必须至少有：

```text
Engineering Owner
Operations Owner
Security Owner
Product或Domain Owner
```

---

## 6. 生命周期

```text
PROPOSED
DEVELOPING
PRE_PRODUCTION
ACTIVE
DEPRECATED
DECOMMISSIONING
RETIRED
```

---

## 7. Dependency Graph

Service Catalog生成：

```text
同步依赖
异步依赖
数据依赖
安全依赖
部署依赖
```

图。

---

## 8. Tier

建议定义：

```text
Tier 0：安全、身份、证书、审计
Tier 1：核心迁移与业务
Tier 2：重要辅助
Tier 3：非关键
```

---

## 9. Service Scorecard

只展示分维度状态，不使用单一平均分掩盖Critical Gap。

---

## 10. 未登记服务

检测：

```text
运行中的Deployment
开放的Endpoint
Queue Consumer
Scheduled Job
```

但Service Catalog无记录。

# Skill FRT-3003：SLI and SLO Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/sli-slo-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为每个Service和关键用户能力生成可测量SLI、SLO和Error Budget。

---

## 2. SLI类型

```text
Availability
Latency
Correctness
Freshness
Durability
Coverage
Queue Delay
Completion
```

---

## 3. SLI Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceLevelIndicator

metadata:
  id: sli://workflow/job-cancel-success

spec:
  service:
    ref: service://workflow-engine

  event:
    good:
      condition:
        - cancel-request-accepted
        - no-new-step-after-cancel

    total:
      condition:
        - valid-cancel-request

  dimensions:
    - workspace
    - risk-level
    - environment
```

---

## 4. SLO Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceLevelObjective

metadata:
  id: slo://workflow/job-cancel

spec:
  sli:
    ref: sli://workflow/job-cancel-success

  target:
    value: policy-derived

  window:
    type: rolling
    duration: policy-derived

  errorBudget:
    enabled: true

  criticality: R5
```

---

## 5. SLI质量要求

SLI必须：

```text
可测量
与用户或业务结果相关
避免易被优化作弊
有明确分母
有数据Authority
```

---

## 6. Availability

不能只使用：

```text
HTTP非500比例
```

如果返回200但业务状态错误，仍应计为Bad Event。

---

## 7. Latency

按成功业务操作计算，并同时单独监控错误和Timeout。

---

## 8. Freshness

适用于：

```text
Job状态
Search Index
KPI
Permission
Reconciliation
```

---

## 9. Durability

适用于：

```text
Artifact
Audit
Evidence
Certificate
```

---

## 10. Error Budget

记录：

```text
Budget Remaining
Burn Rate
Forecast Exhaustion
Release Policy
```

---

## 11. Burn Rate

支持：

```text
快速Burn
慢速Burn
多窗口Burn
```

以区分急性和慢性退化。

---

## 12. SLO变更

降低目标或扩大窗口必须经过：

```text
Product
SRE
Domain
Security候选
```

审批。

---

# Skill FRT-3004：Business SLI Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/business-sli-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

为端到端业务价值和关键状态生成Business SLI。

---

## 2. FRT平台Business SLI

```text
Repository Onboarding Success Rate
Compatibility Assessment Completion Rate
Migration Plan Completion Rate
Target Build Success Rate
Verification Pass Rate
Repair Convergence Rate
Approval Completion Time
Certificate Issue Success Rate
Delivery Success Rate
Manual Case Resolution Time
```

---

## 3. 高风险业务SLI

```text
Payment Final Confirmation Rate
Unknown Payment Resolution Time
Cross-Tenant Violation Count
Dangerous Device Command Rejection Accuracy
Certificate Verification Accuracy
```

---

## 4. Business SLI Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: BusinessServiceLevelIndicator

metadata:
  id: business-sli://migration/certified-delivery

spec:
  journey:
    ref: value-stream://migration/request-to-delivery

  good:
    - delivery-completed
    - certificate-active

  total:
    - approved-migration-ready-for-delivery

  exclusions:
    - user-cancelled-before-execution

  dimensions:
    - source-framework
    - target-framework
    - workspace
    - risk-level
```

---

## 5. Funnel

支持阶段漏斗：

```text
Created
→ Planned
→ Generated
→ Built
→ Verified
→ Approved
→ Certified
→ Delivered
```

---

## 6. Unknown与Manual

不能从分母中静默排除：

```text
Unknown
Manual Intervention
Timeout
```

应单独统计。

---

## 7. Business SLI Authority

来源必须是：

```text
Domain Event
Authoritative State
Audit
```

不能仅依赖页面点击。

---

## 8. 客户级SLI

Enterprise Contract可按Workspace或Customer计算，但必须保证数据隔离。

---

# Skill FRT-3005：Observability Coverage Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/observability-coverage-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证每个Service、Journey、数据路径和高风险操作具备完整可观测性。

---

## 2. 四类核心信号

```text
Metrics
Logs
Traces
Business Events
```

另包括：

```text
Audit
Synthetic Probes
Profiles候选
```

---

## 3. Observability Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ObservabilityContract

metadata:
  id: observability://certificate-issue

spec:
  operation:
    ref: command://certificate/issue

  metrics:
    - issue-attempt
    - issue-success
    - issue-failure
    - issue-duration

  traces:
    required: true

  logs:
    structured: true
    secretsProhibited: true

  audit:
    required: true

  correlation:
    - traceId
    - certificateId
    - workspaceId
```

---

## 4. Coverage维度

```text
Request
Background Job
Queue
Database
External Provider
Business Command
Admin Action
Security Event
```

---

## 5. Correlation

全链路必须能通过：

```text
Trace ID
Correlation ID
Causation ID
Migration ID
Job ID
Execution ID
Tenant / Workspace
```

关联。

---

## 6. High Cardinality治理

禁止无界将：

```text
Raw User ID
Artifact Hash
Error Message
```

作为Metric Label。

高基数字段放入Log或Trace。

---

## 7. Structured Logs

必须包含：

```text
Timestamp
Level
Service
Environment
Trace
Event
Error Code
Scope
```

但不得记录Secret和不必要敏感数据。

---

## 8. Sampling

Trace Sampling不能丢失：

```text
Critical Error
Security Incident
R5 Operation
```

关键证据。

---

## 9. Synthetic Probe

持续执行：

```text
Login
Job Status
Certificate Verify
Artifact Metadata Read
```

等只读或安全Journey。

---

## 10. Observability Gap

```text
无Metric
无Correlation
无Owner
无Dashboard
无Alert
日志不可搜索
Trace中断
```

---

# Skill FRT-3006：Alert Quality Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/alert-quality-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

确保告警准确、可行动、有Owner、低噪声并与SLO和业务影响关联。

---

## 2. Alert Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AlertDefinition

metadata:
  id: alert://workflow/job-cancel-failure

spec:
  service:
    ref: service://workflow-engine

  signal:
    ref: sli://workflow/job-cancel-success

  condition:
    type: burn-rate
    policy: controlled

  severity: critical

  impact:
    - users-cannot-cancel-active-jobs

  owner:
    team: platform-sre

  runbook:
    ref: runbook://workflow/cancel-failure

  deduplication:
    key:
      - service
      - region
```

---

## 3. Alert分类

```text
Page
Ticket
Dashboard Only
Security Incident
Business Incident
```

---

## 4. Page条件

只有需要立即人工行动的问题才Page。

---

## 5. Alert质量指标

```text
Precision
Actionability
Time to Acknowledge
Time to Resolve
Repeat Rate
False Positive Rate
Missed Incident Rate
```

---

## 6. Symptom优先

优先告警：

```text
用户无法完成关键任务
业务错误率上升
SLO Burn
数据差异
```

而不是每个底层指标变化都Page。

---

## 7. Cause Alert

根因信号用于诊断，但需避免同一事故触发几十个独立Page。

---

## 8. Deduplication与Grouping

按：

```text
Service
Region
Dependency
Incident
```

聚合。

---

## 9. Silence治理

Silence必须：

```text
有Owner
有Reason
有Expiry
有Scope
```

---

## 10. Alert测试

定期模拟信号，验证：

```text
是否触发
Routing
Runbook链接
权限
通知
关闭
```

---

# Skill FRT-3007：Runbook Completeness Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/runbook-completeness-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

确保每个Critical Alert、Failure Mode和Admin Recovery都有有效Runbook。

---

## 2. Runbook类型

```text
Alert Response
Dependency Failure
Data Reconciliation
Security Incident
Rollback
Database Cutover
Region Failover
Customer Escalation
```

---

## 3. Runbook Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: OperationalRunbook

metadata:
  id: runbook://artifact-store/write-failure

spec:
  symptoms:
    - artifact-write-failure-rate-high

  impact:
    - new-certificates-blocked
    - delivery-blocked

  checks:
    - verify-store-health
    - verify-replication
    - inspect-partial-writes

  mitigations:
    - enable-write-restricted-mode
    - queue-safe-uploads

  recovery:
    - restore-write-path
    - reconcile-partial-artifacts
    - revalidate-certificates

  exitCriteria:
    - write-success-restored
    - no-partial-artifacts
```

---

## 4. 完整内容

```text
Symptoms
Impact
Dependencies
Safety Checks
Diagnosis
Mitigation
Recovery
Reconciliation
Rollback
Escalation
Exit Criteria
```

---

## 5. 命令管理

命令必须：

```text
版本化
受权限控制
支持Dry Run候选
不包含Secret
```

---

## 6. Runbook可执行性

不能只写抽象说明。

应提供：

```text
具体查询
具体Dashboard
具体命令
具体Decision Tree
```

---

## 7. Staleness

以下变化触发STALE：

```text
Service拓扑
命令
权限
Dashboard
Alert
依赖
```

---

## 8. Runbook演练

关键Runbook必须定期执行Game Day或DR Drill。

# Skill FRT-3008：On-Call Readiness Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/on-call-readiness-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

确保人员、排班、权限、工具和升级路径能够实际响应Production事件。

## 2. On-Call对象

# Skill FRT-3009：Incident Management Workflow

建议路径：

```text
skills/incident-management-workflow/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

统一技术、业务、数据、安全和客户事故的声明、指挥、沟通、恢复和复盘。

---

## 2. Incident类型

```text
Availability Incident
Business Correctness Incident
Data Integrity Incident
Security Incident
Performance Incident
Dependency Incident
Customer-Specific Incident
```

---

## 3. Severity

建议：

```text
SEV0：大范围安全或不可逆业务破坏
SEV1：关键服务严重中断
SEV2：重要功能受损
SEV3：局部或可绕过问题
SEV4：低影响
```

---

## 4. Incident Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ProductionIncident

metadata:
  id: incident://production/001

spec:
  severity: SEV1

  affected:
    capabilities:
      - migration-execution

    regions:
      - region-a

  roles:
    incidentCommander:
      ref: user://on-call-commander

    operationsLead:
      ref: team://platform-sre

    communicationsLead:
      ref: team://support

  status: investigating
```

---

## 5. 状态

```text
DECLARED
TRIAGING
MITIGATING
MONITORING
RESOLVED
POSTMORTEM_PENDING
CLOSED
```

安全事件可使用G29更详细状态。

---

## 6. Incident Commander

负责：

```text
协调
决策
优先级
角色分配
状态更新
```

不一定亲自修复。

---

## 7. Incident Timeline

自动聚合：

```text
Alert
Deployment
Feature Flag
Config Change
Admin Action
Dependency Event
Mitigation
Recovery
```

---

## 8. Communication

定义：

```text
内部更新频率
客户更新频率
Status Page候选
Executive更新
监管或合同通知候选
```

---

## 9. Mitigation优先

优先恢复安全业务状态，再追求完整根因。

---

## 10. Resolution

只有当：

```text
关键业务恢复
数据完成对账
安全风险受控
监控稳定
```

时才能标记Resolved。

---

## 11. Incident关闭

必须完成：

```text
Postmortem
Action Items
Owner
Deadline
Test / Mutation
Runbook更新
```

---

# Skill FRT-3010：Release Train Orchestrator

建议路径：

```text
skills/release-train-orchestrator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

管理从Release Candidate、冻结、审批、部署到正式关闭的完整发布流程。

---

## 2. Release Train阶段

```text
PLANNING
SCOPE_FREEZE
BUILD
QUALIFICATION
APPROVAL
SCHEDULED
CANARY
PROGRESSIVE
FULL_RELEASE
POST_RELEASE_VERIFY
CLOSED
```

---

## 3. Release Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ProductionRelease

metadata:
  id: production-release://g30

spec:
  source:
    commitDigest: sha256

  artifacts:
    - artifact://application-image
    - artifact://migration-bundle

  certificates:
    - certificate://functional/current
    - certificate://business/current
    - certificate://data/current
    - certificate://admin/current
    - certificate://usability/current
    - certificate://regression/current
    - certificate://performance/current
    - certificate://resilience/current
    - certificate://security/current

  rollout:
    strategy:
      ref: rollout://g30-progressive

  rollback:
    ref: rollback://g30
```

---

## 4. Release Scope Freeze

冻结：

```text
Commit
Artifact
Pack Lock
Dependency Lock
Schema
Configuration
Policy
Feature Flags
```

---

## 5. Change Risk

按：

```text
代码范围
业务Criticality
数据变化
权限变化
依赖变化
历史事故
```

计算Risk Class。

---

## 6. Release Window

考虑：

```text
On-Call覆盖
Customer活动
外部Provider维护
数据库窗口
地区时区
```

---

## 7. Freeze Exception

紧急变更进入独立Hotfix流程，不直接修改冻结Release。

---

## 8. Release Approval

必须由：

```text
Engineering
Operations
Security候选
Product / Domain
```

按风险批准。

---

## 9. Stop Conditions

任一出现即暂停：

```text
SLO快速Burn
Critical Business SLI下降
Data Difference
Security Finding
Canary Verification失败
```

```text
skills/canary-progressive-delivery/SKILL.md
```

```text
Instance

Tenant
Workspace
Region
User Cohort
Feature
Technology Path
```

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: CanaryPlan

metadata:
  id: canary://release-g30

spec:
  stages:
    - name: internal
      audience:
        workspaces:
          - internal-test

    - name: one-percent
      trafficPercent: 1

    - name: ten-percent
      trafficPercent: 10

    - name: fifty-percent
      trafficPercent: 50

    - name: full
      trafficPercent: 100

  gates:
    - technical-slo
    - business-sli
    - security-findings
    - data-differences
```

## 4. Canary Cohort

## 5. 指标

至少：

```text
Error Rate
P95 / P99
Business Success
Data Reconciliation
Manual Case Rate
Security Events
Resource Use
```

---

## 6. Baseline比较

比较：

```text
Canary
vs
Stable
```

并控制Tenant和Workload差异。

---

## 7. 自动推进

只有在：

```text
最小观察窗口完成
全部Gate通过
无Critical Finding
```

时推进。

---

## 8. 自动停止

触发：

```text
Critical Error
SLO Burn
Data Corruption
Cross-Tenant Finding
Security Incident
```

立即停止放量。

---

## 9. 自动回退

根据风险选择：

```text
流量回退
Flag关闭

```

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: FeatureFlagContract

metadata:
  id: flag://new-proof-engine

spec:
  type: release

    team: proof-platform

```

```text
Tenant
Workspace
```

Scope约束。

```text
删除旧分支
删除Flag读取
更新测试
更新文档
```

## 10. Kill Switch

必须在Incident演练中实际验证。

```text
Audit
```

# Skill FRT-3013：Automated Rollback Generator

建议路径：

```text
skills/automated-rollback-generator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

生成基于技术、业务、数据和安全信号的自动回滚和Forward-Fix计划。

---

## 2. Rollback类型

```text
Traffic Rollback
Application Rollback
Configuration Rollback
Feature Flag Off
Queue Pause
Database Rollback
Data Forward Fix
Compensation
Legacy Read Switch
```

---

## 3. Rollback Plan

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: RollbackPlan

metadata:
  id: rollback://release-g30

spec:
  triggers:
    - canary-critical-error
    - business-sli-drop
    - security-critical-finding

  application:
    strategy: previous-artifact

  configuration:
    strategy: previous-version

  data:
    strategy: forward-fix

  queues:
    action: pause-new-consumption

  validation:
    - critical-journey-smoke
    - data-reconciliation
    - certificate-check
```

---

## 4. 自动触发条件

必须避免过于敏感导致频繁回滚，也不能等待大范围损害。

---

## 5. Rollback Authority

自动系统可执行批准范围内的低风险回退。

高风险数据或跨Region操作需要人工批准候选。

---

## 6. 数据不可逆

如新版本已发布新Event或新Schema数据，应采用：

```text
Forward-Compatible旧版本
Dual Reader
Forward Fix
Compensation
```

---

## 7. 回滚顺序

候选：

```text
停止放量
→ 停止新写入候选
→ 切回流量
→ 回滚应用
→ 回滚配置
→ 对账数据
→ 恢复队列
→ 验证
```

---

## 8. Rollback测试

每个Release Candidate必须在Staging或隔离环境实际演练。

---

## 9. Rollback Evidence

记录：

```text
触发原因
开始时间
完成时间
版本
数据差异
验证结果
```

---

# Skill FRT-3014：Database and Data Cutover Manager

建议路径：

```text
skills/database-data-cutover-manager/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

管理Schema变更、Backfill、Dual Write、Read切换、最终对账和数据Cutover。

---

## 2. Cutover阶段

```text
PREPARE
EXPAND_SCHEMA
BACKFILL
DUAL_READ
DUAL_WRITE
SHADOW_COMPARE
FREEZE
APPLY_DELTA
SWITCH_READ
SWITCH_WRITE
RECONCILE
DECOMMISSION_OLD
```

---

## 3. Cutover Plan

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DataCutoverPlan

metadata:
  id: cutover://metadata-v2

spec:
  source:
    ref: database://metadata-v1

  target:
    ref: database://metadata-v2

  authority:
    initialWrite: source
    finalWrite: target

  phases:
    - expand-schema
    - backfill
    - dual-read
    - dual-write
    - reconcile
    - switch-write
    - switch-read

  rollback:
    beforeWriteSwitch: reversible
    afterWriteSwitch: forward-fix
```

---

## 4. Authority

每个阶段明确：

```text
Read Authority
Write Authority
Reconciliation Authority
```

---

## 5. Dual Write

需要：

```text
Operation ID
一致顺序
失败处理
差异对账
Backpressure
```

---

## 6. Backfill

必须：

```text
可暂停
可恢复
幂等
分片
限速
验证
```

---

## 7. Cutover Freeze

若需要短暂冻结，必须明确：

```text
影响功能
开始时间
最大持续时间
Read-Only模式
用户通知
```

---

## 8. Delta Capture

Backfill期间产生的新写入必须通过：

```text
CDC候选
Outbox
Operation Log
Dual Write
```

捕获。

---

## 9. Final Reconciliation

比较：

```text
记录
业务Key
状态
金额
时间
Tenant Scope
Event Position
```

---

## 10. 失败处理

Cutover任何阶段失败，按阶段决定：

```text
Retry
Pause
Rollback
Forward Fix
Manual Intervention
```

---

## 11. Decommission

旧数据源删除前确认：

```text
无Reader
无Writer
Retention满足
Backup完成
Certificate更新
```

---

# Skill FRT-3015：Legacy Coexistence and Cutover Validator

建议路径：

```text
skills/legacy-coexistence-cutover-validator/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

验证新旧系统在Strangler、Dual Run、Shadow和渐进迁移期间的Authority和一致性。

---

## 2. Coexistence模式

```text
Route by Feature
Route by Tenant
Route by User Cohort
Route by Operation
Dual Read
Dual Write
Shadow
Legacy Fallback
```

---

## 3. Coexistence Contract

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: LegacyCoexistenceContract

metadata:
  id: coexistence://migration-platform-v1-v2

spec:
  routing:
    mode: tenant

  authorities:
    read:
      default: legacy

    write:
      default: legacy

  shadow:
    target: new-system
    sideEffects: prohibited

  comparison:
    ref: comparator://migration-platform
```

---

## 4. 单一写Authority

原则上同一业务事实同一时刻只能有一个最终Write Authority。

Dual Write需要单独对账和失败协议。

---

## 5. Shadow安全

新系统只产生：

```text
Result
Intent
Diff
```

不执行：

```text
支付
通知
设备命令
Production Delivery
```

---

## 6. Fallback

Fallback到Legacy前必须确认请求尚未在新系统有效执行。

---

## 7. Session和State

新旧系统切换时保持：

```text
Identity
Account
Tenant
Navigation候选
Business Correlation
```

---

## 8. Read差异

Dual Read比较：

```text
业务状态
金额
权限
数据Freshness
```

---

## 9. Legacy退役

需要：

```text
流量为零
依赖为零
数据完成迁移
证书更新
Runbook更新
Support更新
```

## 4. 新漏洞

自动：

```text
定位受影响Artifact
定位受影响Release
评估Reachability
创建Finding
使Certificate变STALE候选
```

---

## 5. 威胁变化

新增Tool、Pack权限或模型Provider时更新Threat Model。

---

## 6. Incident后

必须运行：

```text
修复Retest
变体攻击测试
回归
Pentest Retest候选
```

---

## 7. Recertification结果

```text
VALID
VALID_WITH_UPDATED_EVIDENCE
RETEST_REQUIRED
STALE
REVOKED
```

# Skill FRT-3021：Production Closure Certificate

建议路径：

```text
skills/production-closure-certificate/SKILL.md
```

## 1. 目标

生成唯一、最终、可重放的Production Closure Certificate。

---

## 2. 认证等级

建议定义：

```text
PR0：Not Assessed
PR1：Component Ready
PR2：Service Ready
PR3：Release Candidate Ready
PR4：Canary Ready
PR5：Production Ready
PR6：Continuously Certified Production
```

---

## 3. PR5要求

必须具备：

```text
九类Certificate有效；
Critical Service有Owner；
Critical SLI / SLO完整；
Error Budget可用；
Critical Alert有Runbook；
On-Call就绪；
Canary和Rollback通过；
Data Cutover通过；
Support就绪；
Post-Release Verification计划完整。
```

---

## 4. Certificate Schema

```yaml
apiVersion: frt.openai.dev/v1alpha1
kind: ProductionClosureCertificate

metadata:
  id: certificate://production/release-g30
  version: 1

spec:
  release:
    ref: production-release://g30

  qualification:
    requested: PR5
    achieved: PR5

  certificates:
    functional:
      ref: certificate://functional/current

    business:
      ref: certificate://business/current

    data:
      ref: certificate://data/current

    admin:
      ref: certificate://admin/current

    usability:
      ref: certificate://usability/current

    regression:
      ref: certificate://regression/current

    performance:
      ref: certificate://performance/current

    resilience:
      ref: certificate://resilience/current

    security:
      ref: certificate://security/current

  operations:
    serviceOwnership: pass
    sliSlo: pass
    observability: pass
    alerts: pass
    runbooks: pass
    onCall: pass
    rollback: pass
    cutover: pass
    support: pass

  scope:
    commitDigest: sha256
    artifactDigest: sha256
    packLockDigest: sha256
    dependencyLockDigest: sha256
    policyDigest: sha256
    environmentDigest: sha256
```

---

## 5. 证书结果

```text
CERTIFIED
CERTIFIED_FOR_CANARY
CERTIFIED_WITH_APPROVED_EXCLUSIONS
BLOCKED
INCONCLUSIVE
STALE
REVOKED
```

---

## 6. Approved Exclusion

不得用于：

```text
跨租户泄漏
支付安全
危险设备安全
不可恢复数据
Critical Security Finding
无Rollback
```

---

## 7. 证书失效

任何底层Certificate失效时，Production Certificate自动传播失效。

---

## 8. 证书范围

必须明确：

```text
Release
Environment
Region
Feature Flags
Workload
Data Scale
Deployment Topology
Customer Scope候选
```

---

# 九、Error Budget治理

## 9.1 状态

```text
HEALTHY
WARNING
FAST_BURN
EXHAUSTED
RECOVERING
```

---

## 9.2 发布政策

### Healthy

允许正常Release。

### Warning

限制高风险变更。

### Fast Burn

停止放量，优先Incident响应。

### Exhausted

冻结非必要Release，专注可靠性。

---

## 9.3 安全例外

安全Critical修复可在Error Budget耗尽时以Hotfix流程发布，但仍需必要验证。

---

# 十、Release策略矩阵

```text
低风险文案或样式：
Canary可简化

普通功能：
标准Canary

数据Schema：
Canary + Dual Read / Write + Reconciliation

权限和身份：
小范围Canary + 强安全验证

支付、设备、能源：
Shadow / Sandbox + 人工批准 + 强回滚

核心平台Runtime：
逐Region或逐Worker Pool发布
```

---

# 十一、数据库Cutover示例

```text
Expand Schema
→ Deploy Compatible Readers
→ Backfill
→ Verify
→ Enable Dual Write
→ Compare
→ Switch Read
→ Switch Write
→ Reconcile
→ Disable Old Writer
→ Decommission Old Schema
```

任何阶段都需要：

```text
Owner
Deadline
Metric
Rollback或Forward-Fix策略
```

```text
FRT-PRODUCTION-READINESS
FRT-SERVICE-CATALOG
FRT-SLI
FRT-SLO
FRT-BUSINESS-SLI
FRT-OBSERVABILITY
FRT-ALERT
FRT-RUNBOOK
FRT-ONCALL
FRT-INCIDENT
FRT-RELEASE-TRAIN
FRT-CANARY
FRT-FEATURE-FLAG
FRT-ROLLBACK
FRT-DATA-CUTOVER
FRT-LEGACY-COEXISTENCE
FRT-CUSTOMER-SUPPORT
FRT-OPERATIONAL-DASHBOARD
FRT-CONTINUOUS-VERIFY
FRT-CONTINUOUS-SECURITY
FRT-CONTINUOUS-PERFORMANCE
FRT-PRODUCTION-CERT
FRT-POST-RELEASE
FRT-INCIDENT-LEARNING
```

示例：

```text
FRT-PRODUCTION-READINESS-0012
Critical Service的Security Certificate已STALE。

FRT-PRODUCTION-READINESS-0019
Release达到RQ5，但没有经过Rollback演练。

FRT-SERVICE-CATALOG-0008
发现运行中的Queue Consumer，但Service Catalog无记录。

FRT-SERVICE-CATALOG-0014
Certificate Service没有Operations Owner。

FRT-SLI-0021
API返回200即被计为成功，但业务Command实际失败。

FRT-SLO-0011
Critical Service没有Error Budget和Burn Rate策略。

FRT-BUSINESS-SLI-0009
Unknown Migration被从总量中静默排除。

FRT-OBSERVABILITY-0017
Worker Trace在Queue边界后丢失Correlation ID。

FRT-OBSERVABILITY-0006
R5操作日志包含Secret字段。

FRT-ALERT-0013
CPU告警持续Page，但没有明确用户影响和行动。

FRT-ALERT-0007
Critical SLO Burn告警没有On-Call Routing。

FRT-RUNBOOK-0016
Runbook引用已删除的Dashboard和过期命令。

FRT-ONCALL-0005
Primary On-Call无Production访问权限。

FRT-ONCALL-0018
Security Service没有Secondary On-Call。

FRT-INCIDENT-0008
事故被标记Resolved，但数据Reconciliation未完成。

FRT-RELEASE-TRAIN-0014
Scope Freeze后Pack Lock发生变化但未重新Qualification。

FRT-CANARY-0009
Canary仅检查HTTP错误，没有检查Business SLI。

FRT-CANARY-0017
Data Difference出现后仍自动推进放量。

FRT-FEATURE-FLAG-0006
Release Flag已存在18个月且没有Owner和清理计划。

FRT-FEATURE-FLAG-0013
Flag服务故障时默认启用高风险功能。

FRT-ROLLBACK-0007
应用可回滚，但新Schema数据无法被旧版本读取。

FRT-ROLLBACK-0019
自动回滚后Queue继续向旧版本发送新Schema Event。

FRT-DATA-CUTOVER-0005
新旧系统同时声明为Write Authority。

FRT-DATA-CUTOVER-0016
Backfill未捕获执行期间的新写入Delta。

FRT-LEGACY-COEXISTENCE-0008
Shadow系统执行了真实通知副作用。

FRT-CUSTOMER-SUPPORT-0012
Support必须联系数据库管理员才能确认Job状态。

FRT-OPERATIONAL-DASHBOARD-0009
Dashboard指标没有Authority和Freshness定义。

FRT-CONTINUOUS-VERIFY-0015
Artifact Integrity检查失败，但Certificate仍保持ACTIVE。

FRT-CONTINUOUS-SECURITY-0004
新增Critical Dependency漏洞未使SC证书失效。

FRT-CONTINUOUS-PERFORMANCE-0011
Production Workload已超出PC证书范围30%。

FRT-PRODUCTION-CERT-0002
存在无Runbook的Critical Alert，无法签发PR5证书。

FRT-POST-RELEASE-0006
Release已标记完成，但关键Synthetic Journey失败。

FRT-INCIDENT-LEARNING-0013
事故Action仅标记“加强监控”，没有Owner和验证标准。
```

# 十八、G30安全与治理

## 18.1 Production Release权限

需要独立Role：

```text
Release Proposer
Release Approver
Release Operator
Security Approver
```

高风险场景执行Separation of Duties。

---

## 18.2 Rollback权限

Rollback应易于执行，但仍需身份、Scope和审计。

紧急Rollback可使用预批准Policy。

---

## 18.3 Feature Flag权限

Production Flag变化属于配置发布，必须受权限和审计治理。

---

## 18.4 Dashboard访问

不同Dashboard按数据分类和Role授权。

---

## 18.5 Incident数据

安全、客户和医疗事故信息按最小权限访问。

---

## 18.6 Support数据

Support默认查看脱敏内容。

---

## 18.7 Production Synthetic Test

专用账号不得访问真实客户数据。

---

## 18.8 Release Artifact

所有Production Artifact必须：

```text
签名
Digest
Provenance
SBOM
Certificate
```

完整。

---

## 18.9 Emergency Release

紧急发布不能绕过：

```text
身份
权限
Artifact完整性
必要安全检查
Rollback
Post-Release Full Qualification
```

---

# 十九、G30实施顺序

建议顺序：

```text
1. FRT-3002 Service Catalog Generator

2. FRT-3003 SLI and SLO Generator

3. FRT-3004 Business SLI Generator

4. FRT-3005 Observability Coverage Validator

5. FRT-3006 Alert Quality Validator

6. FRT-3007 Runbook Completeness Validator

7. FRT-3008 On-Call Readiness Generator

8. FRT-3009 Incident Management Workflow

9. FRT-3001 Production Readiness Checklist Compiler

10. FRT-3012 Feature Flag Safety Validator

11. FRT-3013 Automated Rollback Generator

12. FRT-3014 Database and Data Cutover Manager

13. FRT-3015 Legacy Coexistence and Cutover Validator

14. FRT-3016 Customer Support Readiness

15. FRT-3010 Release Train Orchestrator

16. FRT-3011 Canary and Progressive Delivery

17. FRT-3017 Operational Dashboard Generator

18. FRT-3018 Continuous Verification Scheduler

19. FRT-3019 Continuous Security Recertification

20. FRT-3020 Continuous Performance Recertification

21. FRT-3022 Post-Release Verification

22. FRT-3023 Production Incident Learning Pack

23. FRT-3021 Production Closure Certificate

24. FRT-3000 Production Readiness Orchestrator
```

Service Catalog、SLI、Observability、Alert、Runbook和On-Call必须先建立，因为没有运行责任和反馈闭环，发布自动化只会更快地扩大错误。

---

# 二十、G30阶段里程碑

## Milestone 1：Service Ownership Foundation

完成全部Critical Service、Owner、Tier和Dependency登记。

---

## Milestone 2：SLI、SLO与Business SLI

完成技术与业务可靠性目标。

---

## Milestone 3：Observability and Alerting

实现从用户影响到根因的可观测和可行动告警。

---

## Milestone 4：Runbook and On-Call

所有Critical Alert具备已演练Runbook和有效On-Call。

---

## Milestone 5：Incident Management

建立统一Incident Command、沟通、恢复和复盘流程。

---

## Milestone 6：Release Safety

完成：

```text
Release Train
Canary
Feature Flag
Automatic Rollback
```

---

## Milestone 7：Data and Legacy Cutover

完成数据库Cutover、新旧系统共存与Authority切换。

---

## Milestone 8：Customer Support

Support可以完整定位、解释和升级客户问题。

---

## Milestone 9：Continuous Certification

持续验证、安全和性能再认证投入运行。

---

## Milestone 10：PR5 Production Closure

完成真实Production部署、Post-Release Verification并签发最终证书。

---

# 二十三、G30完成后的最终系统状态

完成G30后，系统将从：

```text
需求、业务、数据、管理、可用性、测试、
性能、韧性和安全分别通过认证
```

推进到：

```text
所有证书、运行指标、告警、值班、发布策略、
回滚、数据切换、客户支持和持续再认证
被汇聚为唯一Production Release Gate。
```

最终平台可以确保：

```text
每个Production Service都有明确Owner和生命周期；

所有Critical Capability都有技术SLI和Business SLI；

SLO和Error Budget能够实际控制Release速度；

Metrics、Logs、Traces、Audit和Synthetic Probe形成完整Observability；

每个Critical Alert都可行动并关联Runbook和On-Call；

值班人员具备权限、工具、演练和升级路径；

Incident具有统一指挥、沟通、恢复和复盘机制；

Release采用冻结Scope、分阶段Canary和业务指标Gate；

Feature Flag具备安全Default、Kill Switch、Expiry和清理计划；

自动回滚能够区分应用、配置、流量、数据和补偿；

数据库和数据Cutover具有单一Authority、Delta捕获和最终对账；

Legacy与新系统共存期间不存在无治理双写和双Authority；

Customer Support能够安全查询、解释、升级和跟踪客户问题；

上线后通过真实Production配置、Routing、数据和Journey验证；

新漏洞、性能增长、拓扑变化和事故自动触发重新认证；

所有真实Incident都转化为Requirement、Test、Mutation、
Chaos、Threat Model和Runbook改进；

Production Closure Certificate成为整个系统唯一上线Authority。
```

最终全系统能力链：

```text
G1–G2
基础设施与仓库发现

G3–G5
Typed Semantic IR、Source Adapter与Migration Planning

G6–G12
目标架构、代码生成、组件、状态、数据边界、UI和平台能力

G13–G17
六类技术30条有向转换路径

Domain、Framework、Library、Version和Enterprise Overlay

G19
Proof Obligation、Lean、CEGAR、CEGIS与反例驱动修复

G20
Skill Runtime、Registry、Marketplace、Worker、API、
Web Console与One-Click Productization

G21
Requirement Traceability与功能闭环

G22
业务状态机、Saga、补偿、对账与人工接管闭环

G23
Data Contract、Authority、Lineage与生命周期闭环

G24
管理端、权限、审批、修正和审计闭环

任务可完成性、Accessibility、多语言和多设备闭环

G26
全系统回归、Mutation、测试网格和Release Qualification

G27
高并发、性能、容量、Autoscaling和安全降级

G28
高可用、Failover、Chaos、Backup、DR与RTO/RPO

G29
威胁、身份、权限、供应链、隐私和安全认证

G30
SLO、On-Call、Incident、Canary、Rollback、Cutover、
Support和Production Closure
```

最终端到端生命周期：

```text
Connect Repository
→ Discover
→ Understand
→ Model
→ Plan
→ Generate
→ Build
→ Test
→ Prove
→ Repair
→ Validate Business
→ Validate Data
→ Validate Admin
→ Validate Usability
→ Qualify Regression
→ Validate Performance
→ Validate Resilience
→ Validate Security
→ Prepare Operations
→ Canary
→ Cutover
→ Verify Production
→ Certify
→ Monitor
→ Respond
→ Learn
→ Continuously Re-Certify
```

最终系统不再只回答：

```text
“代码是否生成？”
“项目是否能构建？”
“测试是否通过？”
```

而能够持续回答：

```text
“需求是否完整？”
“业务是否闭环？”
“数据是否正确？”
“管理是否可操作？”
“用户是否能完成？”
“高并发是否仍正确？”
“故障是否可恢复？”
“攻击是否可抵御？”
“上线是否可控？”
“运行是否达标？”
“事故后是否真正学习？”
“当前Production Certificate是否仍然有效？”
```

最终产品定义：

> 输入任意一个受支持的大型前端仓库，平台能够识别其架构、业务、数据、权限和风险，生成目标技术的完整可运行系统；通过编译、测试、差分、Mutation、形式证明、并发、性能、Chaos、安全和人工证据验证其正确性；通过管理端、审批、SLO、Canary、Rollback、数据Cutover、On-Call和Incident体系安全上线；并在代码、依赖、配置、数据、模型、Workload和真实事故持续变化时，自动重新验证和重新认证整个Production系统。
